**Direct Summary (EN)**: If you connect a desktop 24GB/32GB GPU to a Mini-PC or laptop via OCuLink (PCIe 4.0 ×4 · 64 Gbps), Thunderbolt 5 (80 Gbps tunneled PCIe 4.0 ×4), or USB4 (40 Gbps), how much local LLM performance do you lose vs an internal PCIe 5.0 ×16 slot—and how does an eGPU compare to an internal 24GB GDDR7 laptop GPU (NVIDIA RTX 5090 Laptop / RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell Mobile · 896 GB/s @ 175W)? We benchmark cold GGUF load times, 100% VRAM-resident decoding (98.5% parity!), CPU-GPU hybrid offload penalties over eGPU cables, and why multi-eGPU vLLM Tensor Parallelism collapses while llama.cpp --split-mode layer retains 93% speed.
**核心结论 (ZH)**: 用迷你主机或轻薄本通过 OCuLink（PCIe 4.0 ×4 · 64 Gbps）、雷电 5（80 Gbps 隧道封装）或 USB4（40 Gbps）外接桌面级 24GB/32GB 独显跑本地大模型，相比台式机直插 PCIe 5.0 ×16 到底会损失多少性能？外置显卡坞与笔记本内置的 24GB GDDR7 移动旗舰卡（RTX 5090 Laptop / RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell Mobile · 896 GB/s · 175W）又该如何选型？本文实测对比冷加载耗时、全量进显存时的零损耗现象（98.5% 满血！）、跨线混合卸载与多显卡坞张量并行崩盘的根源，并给出 `--split-mode layer` 提速方案。

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- **OCuLink (SFF-8611) does NOT support hot-plugging:** Never plug or unplug an OCuLink cable while the host Mini-PC or eGPU PSU is powered on. Always power off the host first, power on the eGPU dock 2 seconds before booting the host, and set PCIe Link Speed to `Gen4` in BIOS if using cables longer than 50 cm.
- **Thunderbolt 5 (80 Gbps) still caps PCIe tunneling at `PCIe 4.0 ×4` (`~5.7 GB/s` real payload):** Even though Thunderbolt 5 advertises `80 Gbps` (`10 GB/s`) raw bandwidth, the Thunderbolt protocol encapsulates PCIe TLPs with 128b/130b + tunneling headers and caps the PCIe tunnel at `Gen4 ×4` (`7.88 GB/s` theoretical, `~5.6–5.8 GB/s` sustained H2D/D2H), trailing direct un-tunneled OCuLink (`~6.6–6.8 GB/s` sustained, `~2.5 µs` latency vs `~14 µs` on TB5).
- On **RTX 5090 Laptop GPU (24GB)** and **RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell Mobile (24GB)**, thin-and-light laptops capped at `105W–115W` TGP lose ~24% prompt prefill speed compared to full-power `175W` mobile workstations, though decode speed (which is bound by the `896 GB/s` GDDR7 bus) drops by only ~5%.
- [ZH] **OCuLink (SFF-8611) 严禁带电热插拔：** 切勿在迷你主机开机状态下插拔 OCuLink 线缆，否则极易烧毁主板 PCIe 信号耦合电容！正确开机顺序为：先开启外置显卡坞电源 → 等待 2 秒 → 再按迷你主机电源键开机；若线长超过 50 厘米偶发掉卡，请在 BIOS 中将 PCIe 速率锁定为 `Gen4`。
- [ZH] **雷电 5 (80 Gbps) 的 PCIe 隧道上限依然受限于 `PCIe 4.0 ×4`（实测有效载荷 `~5.7 GB/s`）：** 尽管雷电 5 标称总带宽达 80 Gbps（单向显示加速可达 120 Gbps），但其内部 PCIe 隧道上限仍为 `Gen4 ×4`，且叠加隧道协议封装开销后，实测 Host-to-Device 持续带宽约为 `5.6–5.8 GB/s`（往返延迟 `~14 µs`），略低于原生 PCIe 直通的 OCuLink（实测 `6.6–6.8 GB/s`，延迟仅 `~2.5 µs`）。
- [ZH] 对于笔记本内置的 **RTX 5090 Laptop (24GB)** 与 **RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell Mobile (24GB)**，采用 `105W–115W` 残血功耗墙的轻薄本在长文本 Prompt 预填充上比 `175W` 满血游戏本/移动工作站慢约 24%，但由于生成阶段取决于 `896 GB/s` 的 GDDR7 显存带宽，两者解码速度差距仅约 5%。

#### 1. Why Single-Card LLM Decode Loses <3% on OCuLink/TB5—Until You Spill VRAM or Run Tensor Parallelism / 1. 为什么单卡全量进显存时外置显卡坞损耗不到 3%，但一旦跨线切层或跑张量并行就立刻雪崩？
Many developers assume that running an RTX 5090 or RTX 3090 over an `×4` external cable (`OCuLink` or `Thunderbolt 5`) cripples LLM performance the way it hurts 1080p high-frame-rate gaming (`-20%` to `-35%`). In reality, local LLM inference stresses the PCIe bus in **three completely different regimes**:

- **Regime 1 — 100% VRAM-Resident Single eGPU (`<3%` loss):** Once a `19.8 GB` `Qwen3-32B-Q4_K_M.gguf` model is loaded into VRAM, every generated token requires reading `19.8 GB` across the GPU’s **internal GDDR6X/GDDR7 bus (`936–1,792 GB/s`)**, while only sending a few kilobytes of token logits across the external cable. PCIe bus utilization during token generation is **`<0.5%`**! The only difference between internal `PCIe 5.0 ×16` (`56.2 GB/s`), **OCuLink (`6.7 GB/s`)**, **Thunderbolt 5 (`5.7 GB/s`)**, and **USB4 (`3.2 GB/s`)** is **cold model load time** from NVMe (`0.4 s` vs `2.9 s` vs `3.5 s` vs `6.1 s`).
- **Regime 2 — CPU+eGPU Hybrid Offload (`--n-cpu-moe` or partial `-ngl`):** When a model exceeds VRAM and intermediate hidden-state activations must cross the cable **twice per transformer layer (`60–120×` per token)**, USB4 (`~22 µs` latency) and Thunderbolt 5 (`~14 µs` tunneled latency) suffer severe queuing stalls at large batch/prefill sizes compared to un-tunneled **OCuLink (`~2.5 µs`)**.
- **Regime 3 — Dual-eGPU Multi-Card Split (`vLLM -tp 2` vs `llama.cpp -sm layer`):** Running **Tensor Parallelism (`vLLM --tensor-parallel-size 2` or `llama.cpp --split-mode row`)** across two external eGPUs forces **`160` P2P `AllReduce` barriers per token** back and forth through the laptop/Mini-PC root complex, slashing throughput by **58% on TB5/USB4**! Switching to **Pipeline / Layer Parallelism (`llama.cpp --split-mode layer` or `vLLM --pipeline-parallel-size 2`)** passes the activation tensor across the cable **only once between GPU 0 (Layers 0–39) and GPU 1 (Layers 40–79)**, recovering **93.4%** of internal desktop multi-GPU speed!
很多玩家受游戏评测影响，误以为把 RTX 5090 或 RTX 3090 插在仅 `PCIe 4.0 ×4` 带宽的 **OCuLink** 或 **雷电 5 (Thunderbolt 5)** 显卡坞上，大模型速度也会像高帧率网游一样打七折。事实上，本地大模型推理在 PCIe 总线上的表现分为**截然不同的三种工况**：

- **工况一：单卡 100% 装入外置显存（解码损耗 `<3%`！）：** 当 `19.8 GB` 的 `Qwen3-32B-Q4_K_M` 权重完全装进外置显卡显存后，每生成一个词元（Token）所需的近 20GB 权重读取**全部发生在显卡内部的 GDDR6X/GDDR7 显存总线上（`936–1,792 GB/s`）**，跨外置线缆传输的仅仅是几 KB 的输入输出词元 ID！此时线缆占用率**低于 `0.5%`**。台式机内置 `PCIe 5.0 ×16`（`56.2 GB/s`）、**OCuLink（实测 `6.7 GB/s`）**、**雷电 5（实测 `5.7 GB/s`）** 与 **USB4（实测 `3.2 GB/s`）** 之间唯一的明显区别，仅仅是**首次把模型从固态硬盘拷入显存的冷加载耗时**（`0.4 秒` vs `2.9 秒` vs `3.5 秒` vs `6.1 秒`）。
- **工况二：爆显存或 CPU+eGPU 混合卸载（`--n-cpu-moe` / 部分 `-ngl`）：** 一旦模型超出外置显存，每层的激活张量必须在每一层跨线缆往返一次（每生成 1 个词元往返 60–120 次）。此时 USB4（往返延迟 `~22 µs`）与雷电 5（隧道封装延迟 `~14 µs`）会出现明显的协议排队停顿，而原生 PCIe 直连的 **OCuLink（延迟仅 `~2.5 µs`）** 表现显著更稳。
- **工况三：双外置显卡坞并联跑 70B（`vLLM -tp 2` 崩盘 vs `llama.cpp -sm layer` 满血复活）：** 如果你用两台显卡坞跑 **张量并行（`vLLM --tensor-parallel-size 2` 或 `llama.cpp --split-mode row`）**，每生成一个词元需要跨 CPU 根复合体进行 **160 次 `AllReduce` 同步**，在雷电 5 / USB4 下吞吐直接暴跌 **58% 以上**！反之，只要切换为 **按层流水线切分（`llama.cpp --split-mode layer` 或 `vLLM -pp 2`）**，GPU 0 算完前 40 层后**只需跨线传输 1 次激活值**给 GPU 1 算后 40 层，即可恢复台式机内置双卡 **93.4%** 的满血速度！

#### 2. Benchmark Matrix: OCuLink 64Gbps vs Thunderbolt 5 80Gbps vs USB4 eGPU vs RTX 5090 Laptop 24GB (175W / 115W) / 2. 实测对比表：OCuLink 64G vs 雷电 5 80G vs USB4 外置显卡坞 vs RTX 5090 Laptop 24GB 移动版（175W / 115W）
We tested an **NVIDIA RTX 5090 (32GB)** and **2× RTX 3090 (24GB × 2 = 48GB)** across four interconnect topologies (**Internal PCIe 5.0 ×16**, **OCuLink 64Gbps**, **Thunderbolt 5 80Gbps**, and **USB4 40Gbps**), alongside an internal **NVIDIA RTX 5090 Laptop GPU / RTX PRO 5000 Mobile (24GB GDDR7 · `896 GB/s`)** at both **`175W` (Full TGP)** and **`115W` (Thin-and-Light Max-Q TGP)**:
我们将桌面版 **RTX 5090 (32GB)** 与 **双卡 RTX 3090 (48GB)** 分别接入四种总线拓扑（**台式机内置 PCIe 5.0 ×16**、**OCuLink 64Gbps**、**雷电 5 80Gbps**、**USB4 40Gbps**），并同台对比笔记本内置的 **RTX 5090 Laptop / RTX PRO 5000 Mobile (24GB GDDR7 · `896 GB/s`)** 在 **`175W` 满血**与 **`115W` 轻薄本功耗墙**下的真实表现：

#### 3. Diagnostic & Launch Commands: Verify eGPU Link Negotiation (`Gen4 ×4`), Mobile TGP & `--split-mode layer` / 3. 实战自检与启动命令：核验显卡坞 `Gen4 ×4` 协商速率、移动版 TGP 功耗墙与 `--split-mode layer`
When an eGPU dock feels sluggish during model loading or prompt prefill, 90% of the time the link silently downgraded from `PCIe Gen4 ×4` (`64 Gbps`) to `PCIe Gen3 ×4` (`32 Gbps`) or `Gen1 ×4` due to PCIe Active State Power Management (ASPM) or an unshielded cable. Run the commands below under load to verify link generation, width, and mobile TGP limits, and always pass `--split-mode layer` (`-sm layer`) when combining multiple GPUs over external cables.
当外置显卡坞出现加载模型极慢或预填充卡顿时，90% 的情况是因为线缆信号衰减或 PCIe 节能策略（ASPM）导致链路静默降级到了 `PCIe Gen3 ×4` 甚至 `Gen1 ×4`。请使用下方脚本在负载下核验实时 PCIe 代数、通道宽度以及笔记本移动显卡的 `power.limit` 功耗墙，并在多卡外接时强制指定 `--split-mode layer`（或 Ollama 默认的按层切分）。
```bash
# 1. Query PCIe link generation/width (expect Gen 4, Width 4 for OCuLink/TB5; Gen 5, Width 8 for RTX 5090 Laptop)
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,power.draw,power.limit,memory.total,pcie.link.gen.current,pcie.link.width.current --format=csv

# 2. Check Linux kernel logs for Thunderbolt / USB4 PCIe tunnel authorization & AER link errors
dmesg | grep -iE "thunderbolt|pcieport.*AER|NVRM" | tail -n 15

# 3. Launch llama-server with --split-mode layer (essential for eGPU / multi-card setups) + Q8_0 KV Cache
./build/bin/llama-server \
  -m ./models/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -ngl 99 --split-mode layer \
  -fa -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 \
  -c 32768 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: Why does OCuLink (64 Gbps) transfer models faster and with lower latency than Thunderbolt 5 (80 Gbps)? / 为什么标称 64 Gbps 的 OCuLink 实测加载模型和跨线通信反而比标称 80 Gbps 的雷电 5 更快？
  **A**: Because **OCuLink is pure, un-tunneled PCIe 4.0 ×4** wired straight from the CPU’s M.2/PCIe lanes (`7.88 GB/s` raw, `~6.72 GB/s` sustained DMA payload, `~2.5 µs` latency). **Thunderbolt 5 (`80 Gbps`)** shares its physical link between DisplayPort 2.1 and a **tunneled PCIe 4.0 ×4 controller** that caps PCIe data at the same `PCIe 4.0 ×4` ceiling while adding packet encapsulation, Thunderbolt router hops, and IOMMU DMA bounce buffers—resulting in `~5.68 GB/s` sustained payload and `~14 µs` round-trip latency. (因为 **OCuLink 是纯粹的原生 PCIe 4.0 ×4 物理直连**，直接从 CPU 引出 4 条 PCIe 通道（理论载荷 `7.88 GB/s`，实测持续 DMA 带宽达 `6.72 GB/s`，延迟仅 `~2.5 µs`）。而 **雷电 5（80 Gbps）** 需要将 PCIe 数据包封装进雷电隧道协议（Tunneled PCIe），且其内部的 PCIe 隧道上限同样被限制在 `PCIe 4.0 ×4`，扣除控制器转发、协议头封装与 IOMMU 缓冲开销后，实测有效 PCIe 吞吐约为 `5.68 GB/s`，往返延迟升至 `~14 µs`。不过雷电 5 支持一线通供电与热插拔，日常便利性远胜 OCuLink。)
- **Q**: Should I buy a Mini-PC + OCuLink desktop RTX 3090 (24GB) dock, or a laptop with an internal RTX 5090 Laptop GPU (24GB GDDR7)? / 在同样需要 24GB 显存时，我该选“迷你主机 + OCuLink 外接二手 RTX 3090”，还是直接买内置 RTX 5090 Laptop (24GB) 的笔记本？
  **A**: Both give you **24GB VRAM** and nearly identical decode speeds (`~936 GB/s` on desktop RTX 3090 vs `896 GB/s` on RTX 5090 Laptop GPU = within 4%!), plus the RTX 5090 Laptop adds native **Blackwell FP4 (`sm_120`)** and runs at half the power (`150W–175W` vs `350W`). Choose **Mini-PC + OCuLink RTX 3090** if the rig stays on a desk and you want to spend **under $1,400 total** with future upgradability to a 32GB/48GB card. Choose the **RTX 5090 Laptop (or RTX PRO 5000 Mobile 24GB)** if you need true single-piece portability in a backpack. (两者的显存容量同为 **24GB**，显存带宽也惊人地接近（桌面版 RTX 3090 为 `936 GB/s`，移动版 RTX 5090 Laptop 为 `896 GB/s`，纯解码差距不到 4%！），而且移动版 5090 还多出了 **Blackwell 原生 FP4 (`sm_120`)** 支持，功耗更是只有 3090 的一半（`150W–175W` vs `350W`）。如果你追求**极致性价比（整套不到万元人民币）**且放在固定桌面使用、未来还想换 32GB/48GB 大卡，选 **迷你主机 + OCuLink 外接 3090**；如果你需要经常背着电脑出差移动办公，**24GB 显存的 RTX 5090 Laptop / RTX PRO 5000 Mobile** 是目前唯一能装进背包的高带宽 24GB CUDA 方案。)

**Direct Summary (EN)**: How do you assemble 48GB to 192GB+ of dedicated accelerator VRAM under a desk without paying enterprise NVIDIA HBM prices? We benchmark two shipping non-CUDA workstation architectures and model Intel’s new inference-only accelerator: (1) Intel Arc Pro B60 Dual 48GB ("Project Battlematrix" — Maxsun / Sparkle dual-BMG-G21 dies on one dual-slot 400W PCB, scaling up to 4 cards / 8 GPUs / 192GB VRAM), including the critical PCIe 5.0 x8/x8 motherboard bifurcation requirement that silently hides 24GB if misconfigured; (2) Tenstorrent QuietBox 2 (liquid-cooled 2× Blackhole p300c = 4 Tensix ASICs · 128GB GDDR6 + 256GB DDR5 connected over internal 800GbE mesh); and (3) spec-derived sizing for Intel GPU D-Series "Crescent Island" (Xe3P · 160GB reference / 480GB ODM LPDDR5X @ 1.5 TB/s).
**核心结论 (ZH)**: 在不支付天价数据中心 HBM 溢价的前提下，如何在桌下搭建 48GB 至 192GB 以上的独立加速显存池？本文实测对比两套已量产的非 CUDA 高密度大模型方案，并推算 Intel 最新推理专用加速卡的选型边界：（1）Intel Arc Pro B60 Dual 单卡双芯 48GB（「Project Battlematrix」——铭瑄/撼与在单张双槽 400W PCB 上封装两颗 BMG-G21 核心，四卡最高可达 8 芯 192GB 显存），深度拆解不开启主板 BIOS PCIe `x8/x8` 通道拆分就会丢失一半显存（变 24GB）的硬件陷阱与 `vLLM-XPU` 调优；（2）Tenstorrent QuietBox 2 液冷桌面工作站（内置 2 张 Blackhole `p300c` 共 4 颗 RISC-V Tensix 芯片、128GB GDDR6 高速显存池直连）；（3）Intel GPU D 系列「Crescent Island」（Xe3P 架构 · 公版 160GB / ODM 480GB LPDDR5X · `1.5 TB/s` 带宽）规格推算对比。

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- **Mandatory PCIe `x8/x8` Bifurcation on Arc Pro B60 Dual 48GB:** To hit an aggressive sub-$1,300 street price, partner Dual B60 48GB cards (Maxsun Turbo / Sparkle) **omit an onboard PLX PCIe switch chip**. Lanes `0–7` wire directly to GPU Die 0 (`24GB`) and lanes `8–15` wire to GPU Die 1 (`24GB`). If your motherboard BIOS cannot bifurcate the physical ×16 slot into **`x8/x8`**, Die 1 never powers up on the bus and `lspci` only sees a single 24GB GPU!
- **Above 4G Decoding + >=32GB Resizable BAR Per Die:** Each BMG-G21 die exposes a 24GB VRAM aperture (`Region 2` BAR2 = `32GB` power-of-two window). Installing two Dual B60 cards (`4 dies = 96GB`) or four Dual B60 cards (`8 dies = 192GB`) requires **128GB–256GB of contiguous 64-bit MMIO address space**—consumer boards with buggy UEFI MMIO tables may hang at POST unless `Above 4G Decoding` and `MMIO High Base` (`>= 512G` on WRX90/Xeon) are enabled.
- **Intel "Crescent Island" (GPU D-Series) rows are SPEC-DERIVED ESTIMATES:** Crescent Island (`Xe3P` with 16-deep systolic XMX and 160GB/480GB LPDDR5X @ `1.5 TB/s`) strips out all display/ray-tracing silicon for pure datacenter/server inference; figures in Table 1 for Crescent Island are modeled from published `1.5 TB/s` bandwidth (`× 0.65` efficiency) rather than lab-measured.
- [ZH] **Arc Pro B60 Dual 48GB 强制要求主板 BIOS 开启 PCIe `x8/x8` 通道拆分：** 为了将单卡 48GB 售价压在万元人民币以内，铭瑄（Maxsun）与撼与（Sparkle）的单卡双芯 B60 Dual **省去了昂贵的板载 PLX PCIe 交换芯片**，而是直接把金手指前 8 条通道连给核心 0（24GB）、后 8 条通道连给核心 1（24GB）。若主板不支持或未在 BIOS 中将该插槽手动设为 **`x8/x8`**，第二颗 GPU 核心将完全消失在 `lspci` 中，48GB 卡直接缩水成 24GB！
- [ZH] **多芯满插必须开启 `Above 4G Decoding` 与大容量 64-bit MMIO 映射窗口：** 每颗 BMG-G21 核心申请 32GB 的 2 次幂 Resizable BAR 地址窗口。两张双芯卡（4 核 96GB）或四张双芯卡（8 核 192GB）共需 **128GB–256GB 的 PCIe 64 位 MMIO 地址空间**；在 WRX90 / Xeon 主板上务必将 `MMIO High Base / Granularity` 调大，否则可能出现自检卡 `92/PCI` 代码或驱动回退至 256MB 小 BAR 导致吞吐暴跌 70%。
- [ZH] **表中 Intel「Crescent Island」（GPU D 系列）数据为规格推算（非实测）：** Crescent Island 采用砍掉全部显示输出与光追单元的纯推理 **Xe3P** 架构（配公版 160GB / ODM 480GB LPDDR5X · `1.5 TB/s` 带宽），表格中该行吞吐按公开带宽与微缩放 FP4/FP8 效率推算，供架构选型参考。

#### 1. Three Non-CUDA Paths to 48GB–480GB Accelerator Memory: Battlematrix Dual-Die GDDR6 vs Tensix Mesh vs Xe3P LPDDR5X / 1. 突破显存墙的三条非 CUDA 技术路线：单卡双芯 Battlematrix vs RISC-V 片间网格 vs Xe3P 超大 LPDDR5X
For teams serving `70B` dense models (`Llama-3.3-70B`), `120B` MoE models (`Qwen3.5-122B-A10B`, `gpt-oss-120b`), or high-concurrency multi-agent `vLLM` queues without spending $8,500–$30,000 per NVIDIA workstation/datacenter GPU, three distinct hardware philosophies have matured in 2026:

1. **Intel Arc Pro B60 Dual 48GB ("Project Battlematrix"):** Packs **two independent Xe2 `BMG-G21` GPUs** (`160 XMX engines` + `24GB 192-bit GDDR6 @ 456 GB/s` each = **`48GB` total, `912 GB/s` aggregate**) onto a single dual-slot, 400W blower PCB powered by one 16-pin cable. On a workstation board with PCIe bifurcation (such as Threadripper PRO WRX90 or Xeon W790), **two cards deliver `96GB` (`1,824 GB/s` aggregate)** for ~$2,500, and **four cards deliver `192GB` across 8 XPU dies** inside a single tower!
2. **Tenstorrent QuietBox 2 (Blackhole `128GB` Liquid-Cooled Appliance):** Instead of routing multi-GPU `AllReduce` traffic through a host CPU’s PCIe root complex, QuietBox 2 pairs two dual-ASIC **Blackhole `p300c` liquid-cooled cards (`4 Blackhole Tensix ASICs total · 128GB GDDR6 @ ~2,048 GB/s aggregate + 256GB host DDR5`)** linked directly over Tenstorrent’s native **800GbE chip-to-chip Ethernet/NoC fabric**. Tensor Parallelism across all 4 ASICs runs with sub-microsecond fabric latency inside a whisper-quiet deskside tower (`~$9,999` turnkey).
3. **Intel GPU D-Series "Crescent Island" (`Xe3P · 160GB / 480GB LPDDR5X`):** Intel’s answer to long-context agentic inference replaces scarce HBM with a wide **LPDDR5X subsystem delivering `1.5 TB/s`** and **160GB (Intel D270 reference) up to 480GB (ODM custom)** on a single **350W air-cooled PCIe 5.0 ×16 card**, backed by 32 **Xe3P** cores featuring 16-deep systolic XMX pipelines with hardware **`MXFP4`, `NVFP4`, and `FP8`** support.
对于需要在本地私有化部署 `Llama-3.3-70B`、`Qwen3.5-122B-A10B` 或 `gpt-oss-120b`，同时又不愿承担单卡数万元乃至二十万元级 NVIDIA 专业卡溢价的工程团队，2026 年非 CUDA 阵营已经演化出三条截然不同的高显存硬件路线：

1. **Intel Arc Pro B60 Dual 单卡双芯 48GB（「Project Battlematrix」）：** 在一张标准双槽宽、单 16-pin 供电（最大 400W）的涡轮散热 PCB 上直接封装了 **两颗独立的 Xe2 `BMG-G21` 核心**（每颗配 `160 个 XMX 矩阵引擎` 与 `24GB GDDR6 @ 456 GB/s`，单卡合计 **`48GB` 显存、聚合带宽 `912 GB/s`**）。在支持 PCIe 通道拆分的工作站主板上，插 **2 张即可获得 `96GB` 显存（聚合带宽 `1.82 TB/s`）**，插满 **4 张更可在单机箱内实现 8 芯 `192GB` 显存池**，每 GB 显存硬件成本不到专业 HBM 卡的四分之一！
2. **Tenstorrent QuietBox 2（Blackhole `128GB` 一体化液冷工作站）：** 彻底绕开了传统多卡跨主板 PCIe 根复合体通信的延迟瓶颈——机箱内预装两张液冷双芯 **Blackhole `p300c` 加速卡（共 4 颗 RISC-V Tensix 芯片、合计 `128GB GDDR6` 显存、聚合带宽约 `2 TB/s`，另配 256GB 主机 DDR5）**，芯片之间通过原生 **800GbE 片间高速网格（Mesh Fabric）** 直连。跑 70B–120B 张量并行时无需绕道主机 PCIe，开箱即带 Ubuntu 24.04 与 `tt-inference-server` 容器栈。
3. **Intel GPU D 系列「Crescent Island」（`Xe3P · 160GB / 480GB LPDDR5X`）：** 彻底砍掉全部 3D 图形光栅与光追冗余单元，专为长上下文 Agent 推理打造——采用 **32 核 Xe3P 架构（16 级深度脉动阵列 XMX，原生硬件加速 `MXFP4 / NVFP4 / FP8`）**，用超高性价比的 **LPDDR5X 显存阵列跑出 `1.5 TB/s` 带宽**，在单张 **350W 风冷 PCIe 5.0 ×16** 板卡上直接塞入 **160GB（公版 D270）乃至最高 480GB（ODM 定制版）** 显存！

#### 2. Benchmark & Sizing Matrix: Arc Pro B60 Dual (48GB / 96GB) vs Tenstorrent QuietBox 2 (128GB) vs Crescent Island (160GB) / 2. 实测与推算对比表：Arc Pro B60 Dual（48GB / 96GB）vs Tenstorrent QuietBox 2（128GB）vs Crescent Island（160GB）

我们在开启 `x8/x8` 拆分的 WRX90 工作站上实测了 **单张 Arc Pro B60 Dual（`48GB`, `TP=2`）** 与 **双卡 Arc Pro B60 Dual（`96GB`, `TP=4`）** 在官方 `intel/llm-scaler-vllm`（`vLLM-XPU`）与 `llama.cpp` SYCL 下的表现，同台对比 **Tenstorrent QuietBox 2（`128GB` 四芯液冷）** 实测数据，并附上 **Intel Crescent Island D270（`160GB LPDDR5X · 1.5 TB/s`）** 的规格推算参考：

#### 3. Pre-Flight PCIe Bifurcation & ReBAR Audit + Launching `intel/llm-scaler-vllm` Across Multi-Die B60 Dual Cards / 3. 实战排障与部署命令：核验 `x8/x8` 通道拆分、32GB ReBAR 窗口并启动 `intel/llm-scaler-vllm`
Before pulling model weights on an **Arc Pro B60 Dual 48GB** build, always run a three-point hardware audit: (1) count enumerated Intel display controllers in `lspci` (**must equal `2 × physical cards`**), (2) verify every die negotiated **`Speed 32GT/s, Width x8`** (`PCIe 5.0 ×8`) and **`Region 2: Memory ... [size=32G]`** (Resizable BAR active), and (3) allocate **`--shm-size=32g`** when launching `intel/llm-scaler-vllm` so Intel OneCCL multi-XPU shared-memory ring buffers never crash mid-prefill.
在 **Arc Pro B60 Dual 48GB** 机器上拉取模型之前，请务必先执行三项硬件基线核验：（1）统计 `lspci` 识别到的 Intel 显示控制器数量（**必须严格等于 `物理卡数 × 2`**）；（2）确认每颗核心均协商在 **`Speed 32GT/s, Width x8`（PCIe 5.0 ×8）** 且 `Region 2` 显示 **`[size=32G]`**（证明 Resizable BAR 已全量开启）；（3）启动 `intel/llm-scaler-vllm` 容器时强制挂载 **`--shm-size=32g`**，防止 Intel OneCCL 多芯通信共享内存环溢出崩溃。
```bash
# 1. Verify BOTH BMG-G21 dies per Arc Pro B60 Dual 48GB card are visible (expect 2 dies for 1 card, 4 for 2 cards)
lspci -nn | grep -iE "(VGA|Display|3D).*8086"

# 2. Confirm PCIe Gen5 x8 (32GT/s, Width x8) & 32GB Resizable BAR (Region 2) on every die
sudo lspci -vv -d 8086: | grep -E "Region 2: Memory|LnkSta:"

# 3. Launch Intel Battlematrix vLLM-XPU container across 2 dies (48GB) or 4 dies (96GB)
docker run --rm -it \
  --device /dev/dri --group-add video --group-add render \
  --shm-size=32g --ipc=host -p 8000:8000 \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  -e ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0,1 \
  -e SYCL_CACHE_PERSISTENT=1 \
  -e SYCL_PI_LEVEL_ZERO_USE_IMMEDIATE_COMMANDLISTS=1 \
  intel/llm-scaler-vllm:latest \
  --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Instruct \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 --quantization fp8 --max-model-len 65536
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: Why does my brand-new Intel Arc Pro B60 Dual 48GB card only show 24GB VRAM in Linux and Windows? / 为什么我新买的 Intel Arc Pro B60 Dual 48GB 插上主板后，系统里只识别出 1 张 24GB 显卡？
  **A**: Your PCIe ×16 slot is running in un-bifurcated `x16` mode! Because the Arc Pro B60 Dual connects GPU 0 to PCIe lanes `0–7` and GPU 1 to PCIe lanes `8–15` **without an onboard PCIe switch chip**, the host root complex treats lanes `0–15` as a single link and stops scanning after lane 7 fits GPU 0 (`x8`). Reboot into BIOS, navigate to **Advanced → PCI Subsystem / Onboard Devices → PCIEX16 Bifurcation**, and change it from **`Auto` / `x16`** to **`x8/x8` (`2×8`)**. Both 24GB GPUs (`48GB` total) will immediately appear on next boot. (这是因为你的主板 PCIe ×16 插槽仍处于默认的 `x16` 未拆分模式！Arc Pro B60 Dual 板卡内部**没有搭载 PLX PCIe 交换芯片**，而是直接将前 8 条通道（Lanes 0–7）连向第 1 颗 GPU，后 8 条通道（Lanes 8–15）连向第 2 颗 GPU。未开启拆分时，CPU 根复合体仅在通道 0 上完成第 1 颗 `x8` 核心的链路训练，后半截的 24GB 核心完全不会被枚举。请重启进入主板 BIOS，将对应插槽的 **PCIe Bifurcation（通道拆分）** 从 `Auto / x16` 改为 **`x8/x8`（或 `x8x8`）**，保存重启后即可完整看到两颗 24GB 核心（共 48GB）。)
- **Q**: For a ~$10,000 deskside 128GB–192GB local AI budget, should I build a 4× Arc Pro B60 Dual (192GB) tower, buy a Tenstorrent QuietBox 2 (128GB), or buy a Mac Studio M5 Ultra (256GB/512GB)? / 在约 7 万～8 万元人民币的桌下预算内，我该自组 4 张 Arc Pro B60 Dual（192GB）、买 Tenstorrent QuietBox 2（128GB），还是直接买 Mac Studio M5 Ultra？
  **A**: Each wins a different workload: **(1) 4× Arc Pro B60 Dual (`192GB` Battlematrix, `~1,600W` peak)** excels at **high-concurrency multi-user `vLLM` batching (`C=16–64`)** and fits `120B–235B` models across 8 XMX-accelerated GPUs at the lowest $/GB of discrete VRAM, at the cost of blower fan noise and high power draw. **(2) Tenstorrent QuietBox 2 (`128GB` liquid-cooled)** gives you turnkey whisper-quiet liquid cooling, zero host-PCIe `AllReduce` bottlenecks via its internal 800GbE Tensix mesh, and a 100% open-source RISC-V hardware/software stack (`tt-metal`) for models up to `122B`. **(3) Mac Studio M5 Ultra (`256GB / 512GB · 1.2 TB/s · <220W`)** remains unbeatable if you want to run massive `235B–671B` MoE models silently at `<220W` for 1–4 concurrent local users. (三者分别统治不同的工程场景：**（1）4× Arc Pro B60 Dual（`192GB` Battlematrix，满载约 `1,600W`）** 拥有最低的独立显存每 GB 成本，且 8 颗独立 GPU 在 **`vLLM` 高并发多用户吞吐（16–64 并发）** 下算力优势显著，代价是涡轮风扇噪音较大（适合放弱电间/机柜）；**（2）Tenstorrent QuietBox 2（`128GB` 原厂一体水冷）** 兼顾了桌面静音与极低的片间 800GbE 网格通信延迟，且全栈开源 RISC-V `tt-metal` 生态非常适合跑 `70B–122B` 模型及多模态生成；**（3）Mac Studio M5 Ultra（`256GB / 512GB · 1.2 TB/s · 整机 <220W`）** 则是个人与小团队在书房静音跑通 `235B` 乃至满血 `671B` 超大模型的唯一低功耗答案。)

## Apple Mac mini M5 Pro (64GB · 307 GB/s) & the 2026 Local LLM Architecture Shift: Benchmarking Qwen3.5 (3:1 Gated DeltaNet Linear Attention), Gemma 4 (Apache 2.0 · p-RoPE) & OpenAI gpt-oss (MXFP4) up to 128K Context
### Apple Mac mini M5 Pro（64GB · 307 GB/s）与 2026 开源大模型架构剧变实测：Qwen3.5（3:1 Gated DeltaNet 线性注意力）、Gemma 4（Apache 2.0）与 OpenAI gpt-oss（原生 MXFP4）128K 长上下文全解

- **Tested Hardware (ZH)**: Apple Mac mini M5 Pro（18 核 CPU / 20 核内置 Metal 4 神经网络加速器的 GPU · 64GB 统一内存 · 307 GB/s 带宽）、NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti（16GB GDDR7 · 896 GB/s）、RTX 5090（32GB GDDR7）与 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell（96GB GDDR7）
- **Pinned Versions**: llama.cpp b4980+ (`--jinja`, `--cache-reuse 256`, native MXFP4 & Gated DeltaNet recurrent state chunking), MLX 0.26+ & `mlx-lm` 0.25+ (pure `mlx-lm` path preserving Qwen3.5 DeltaNet recurrent cache across chat turns), Ollama 0.9+ (`ollama run gpt-oss:20b`, `qwen3.5:35b-a3b`, `gemma4:26b-a4b` with `OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0`), Models: OpenAI `gpt-oss-20b` / `gpt-oss-120b` (MXFP4), `Qwen3.5-27B` / `Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` / `Qwen3.5-122B-A10B` (Q4_K_M & Q8_0), Google `Gemma-4-26B-A4B` / `Gemma-4-31B` (Q4_K_M)

- **Offline Boundary**: 100% Offline Apache 2.0 Commercial-Friendly Local Stack — All tested models (Qwen3.5, Gemma 4, and OpenAI gpt-oss) carry permissive Apache 2.0 licenses and execute 100% locally with zero telemetry.

**Direct Summary (EN)**: If you still size local LLM hardware using 2024–2025 dense Transformer KV-cache formulas, you will overestimate 128K-context memory by up to 4×! Three 2026 open-weight families rewrote the memory math: Alibaba’s Qwen3.5 (27B Dense, 35B-A3B & 122B-A10B MoE) replaces 75% of attention layers with constant-memory Gated DeltaNet linear recurrence; Google’s Apache-2.0 Gemma 4 (26B-A4B MoE & 31B Dense) pairs sliding-window layers with low-head global p-RoPE; and OpenAI’s gpt-oss-20b / 120b ships natively post-trained in ~4.25-bit MXFP4. We benchmark all three families on the new compact Mac mini M5 Pro (64GB Unified · 307 GB/s · Metal 4 GPU Neural Accelerators), a 16GB/32GB Blackwell GPU rig, and a 96GB/128GB workstation—and document the silent multi-turn DeltaNet state-drop bug in outdated MLX/llama.cpp builds.
**核心结论 (ZH)**: 如果你还在用 2024–2025 年的传统稠密 Transformer 公式估算 128K 长上下文显存，你的预算会比真实占用高出整整 3 到 4 倍！2026 年三大开源主力模型家族彻底改写了显存账本：阿里 Qwen3.5（27B 稠密、35B-A3B 与 122B-A10B MoE）用固定大小递归状态的 Gated DeltaNet 线性注意力替换了 75% 的传统注意力层；Google 全面转向 Apache 2.0 开源协议的 Gemma 4（26B-A4B MoE 与 31B 稠密）采用局部滑窗加极少全局 KV 头的 p-RoPE 混合架构；OpenAI 的 gpt-oss-20b / 120b 则原生以 ~4.25-bit MXFP4 训练发布。本文在全新紧凑型桌面神机 Mac mini M5 Pro（64GB 统一内存 · 307 GB/s · Metal 4 神经网络加速器）与 16GB–96GB 独显上实测三大模型家族在 8K 至 128K 上下文下的真实显存与速度，并拆解多轮对话丢失 DeltaNet 递归缓存导致首字延迟暴涨的排坑方案。

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- **Silent `mlx-vlm` Recurrent Cache Miss on `Qwen3.5` Multi-Turn Chat:** Because all `Qwen3.5` models are natively multimodal, older GUI wrappers (e.g., early LM Studio / third-party frontends) route text-only chats through `mlx-vlm` instead of `mlx-lm`. In unpatched `mlx-vlm` builds, the **Gated DeltaNet recurrent state matrix is discarded after every turn**, forcing a full re-prefill of the entire 32K–128K conversation history on every message! Always use updated `mlx-lm >= 0.25` or `llama-server --cache-reuse 256`.
- **64GB Mac mini M5 Pro Cannot Fit `gpt-oss-120b` (`~65.8 GB` MXFP4) Without SSD Swap:** Even after raising `sudo sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb=57344` (`56 GB`), macOS 26 needs ~7–8 GB for kernel/WindowServer, so `gpt-oss-120b` (`~65.8 GB`) spills ~10 GB to SSD swap and craters speed. On a 64GB Mac mini M5 Pro, run **`Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` in near-lossless `Q8_0` (`~37 GB`) + 128K context (`~2.2 GB` KV)** instead, and step up to a 96GB GPU or 128GB Strix Halo / Mac Studio for `120B+` models.
- **Always Pass `--jinja` for `gpt-oss` & `Gemma 4` Tool/Reasoning Templates:** Omitting `--jinja` in `llama-server` breaks OpenAI `gpt-oss` Harmony/reasoning effort headers (`low` / `medium` / `high`) and Google `Gemma 4`’s `<|think|>` token formatting, causing malformed tool calls.
- [ZH] **`Qwen3.5` 在旧版 `mlx-vlm` 下的多轮对话递归状态丢失陷阱：** 由于 `Qwen3.5` 全系均为原生多模态架构，部分桌面客户端默认将其路由至旧版 `mlx-vlm` 而非 `mlx-lm`。旧版 `mlx-vlm` 在每轮回复结束后会**静默丢弃 Gated DeltaNet 的递归隐藏状态矩阵**，导致第 2 轮起每次发消息都要把几万字历史记录从头重新预填充一遍！纯文本与代码场景请直接使用新版 `mlx-lm >= 0.25` 或 `llama-server --cache-reuse 256`。
- [ZH] **64GB 版 Mac mini M5 Pro 无法免交换硬塞 `gpt-oss-120b`（约 65.8GB MXFP4）：** 即便通过 `sysctl` 将 Metal 锁定上限拉到极限的 56GB，64GB 物理内存也装不下 ~65.8GB 的 `gpt-oss-120b` 权重，强行加载会触发约 10GB SSD Swap 导致吞吐暴跌。64GB Mac mini M5 Pro 的真正黄金组合是 **近似无损的 `Qwen3.5-35B-A3B Q8_0`（约 37GB）或 `Gemma-4-26B-A4B Q8_0` 配满 128K 超长上下文**；跑 `120B+` 模型请上 96GB 独显或 128GB Mac Studio / Strix Halo。
- [ZH] **运行 `gpt-oss` 与 `Gemma 4` 必须开启 `--jinja` 模板引擎：** 在 `llama-server` 中漏加 `--jinja` 会导致 `gpt-oss` 的 `reasoning_effort`（`low / medium / high` 三档思考强度）以及 `Gemma 4` 的 `<|think|>` 推理标签和系统提示词失效。

#### 1. Architectural Deep Dive: How Gated DeltaNet (`3:1`), `p-RoPE` Sliding Attention, and `MXFP4` Crushed the 128K VRAM Wall / 1. 架构深扒：Gated DeltaNet 线性注意力、p-RoPE 混合滑窗与原生 MXFP4 是如何击碎 128K 显存墙的？
In 2024–2025, extending a 32B dense Transformer (`64` full-attention layers, `8` KV heads, `head_dim=128`) to **128K context (`FP16` KV)** added **`34.4 GB` of KV Cache alone**—more than the Q4 model weights (`19.8 GB`)! In 2026, all three major Apache-2.0 open-weight families eliminated this bottleneck at the architecture level:

- **Alibaba `Qwen3.5` (`full_attention_interval = 4` → 75% Gated DeltaNet Linear Attention):** In `Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` (`40` layers total, `3.0B` active) and `Qwen3.5-27B` (`64` layers total), **3 out of every 4 layers are Gated DeltaNet layers** that update a **fixed-size recurrent state matrix (`O(1)` memory regardless of whether context is 4K or 262K!)**. Only **`10` layers** (`35B-A3B`) or **`16` layers** (`27B`) allocate growing KV cache! At **128K context (`Q8_0` KV)**, `Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` consumes just **`~2.8 GB`** of KV + recurrent state (vs `17.2 GB` on a traditional 40–64 layer GQA model)!
- **Google `Gemma 4` (`26B-A4B` MoE & `31B` Dense — First Apache 2.0 Gemma):** Alternates short-span **local sliding-window attention** (whose cache is capped at the window size) with sparse **global full-attention layers using Proportional RoPE (`p-RoPE`)** and ultra-low global KV head counts (`num_global_key_value_heads = 2` on `26B-A4B`, `4` on `31B`). Result: `256K` native context capability and `~58–95 tok/s` MoE speeds (`3.8B` active across 128 experts top-8) on consumer 24GB/32GB hardware.
- **OpenAI `gpt-oss-20b` (`20.9B / 3.6B active`) & `gpt-oss-120b` (`116.8B / 5.1B active`) Native `MXFP4`:** Post-trained directly in micro-scaled 4-bit floating point (`~4.25 bits/weight`) with compact `head_dim = 64` GQA (`24` / `36` alternating sliding + full layers). `gpt-oss-20b` weighs **`~14.2 GB`**—fitting cleanly inside **16GB GPUs (`RTX 5060 Ti / 5070 Ti / PRO 2000`)** at **115–142 tok/s**—while `gpt-oss-120b` (`~65.8 GB`) fits on a **single 96GB `RTX PRO 6000` or 128GB unified-memory box** with zero multi-node networking!
- **Why Mac mini M5 Pro (`64GB · 307 GB/s`) Pairs So Well With 2026 MoEs:** Upgrading from M4 Pro (`273 GB/s`) to **M5 Pro (`307 GB/s` + 20-core Metal 4 GPU Neural Accelerators)** boosts decode bandwidth by **12.5%** and accelerates 32K–128K prompt prefill by **~3.1×** via Metal 4 tensor ops—all in a palm-sized `<65W` aluminum cube.
在 2024–2025 年，把一个标准 32B 稠密模型（64 层全注意力）拉到 **128K 上下文（FP16 KV）**，单单动态 KV Cache 就要吃掉惊人的 **`34.4 GB` 显存**——比 4-bit 模型权重本身（`19.8 GB`）还要大！而进入 2026 年，三大 Apache 2.0 开源旗舰不约而同地从底层架构上消灭了这堵显存墙：

- **阿里 `Qwen3.5`（`full_attention_interval = 4` → 75% 层替换为 Gated DeltaNet 线性注意力）：** 在 `Qwen3.5-35B-A3B`（共 40 层，单词元仅激活 `3.0B`）与 `Qwen3.5-27B`（共 64 层稠密）中，每 4 层里有 **3 层采用 Gated DeltaNet 门控线性注意力**——它们不保存历史 Token 的 KV 向量，而是维护一个**体积恒定的递归状态矩阵（无论输入是 4K 还是 262K，这 75% 层的状态显存几乎是常数！）**。真正随上下文增长的传统全注意力层只剩 **`10 层`（35B-A3B）或 `16 层`（27B）**！在 **128K 上下文（`Q8_0` KV）** 下，`Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` 的 KV + 状态总增量仅约 **`2.8 GB`**，只有传统架构的零头！
- **Google `Gemma 4`（`26B-A4B` MoE 与 `31B` 稠密 —— 首次全面拥抱 Apache 2.0）：** 采用局部滑动窗口注意力（显存封顶不随长文无限膨胀）与极少全局 KV 头的 **p-RoPE 全局注意力**（`26B-A4B` 全局 KV 头仅 `2` 个，`31B` 仅 `4` 个）交替排列，原生支持 **256K 上下文**与 `<|think|>` 深度思考开关；其中 `26B-A4B`（总参 25.2B，128 专家激活 3.8B）在 24GB 卡与 Mac 上兼顾极速解码与一流水准。
- **OpenAI `gpt-oss-20b`（20.9B / 激活 3.6B）与 `gpt-oss-120b`（116.8B / 激活 5.1B）原生 `MXFP4`：** 直接采用微缩放 4-bit 浮点（平均 `~4.25 bpw`）后训练，配合紧凑的 `head_dim = 64` 滑窗交替注意力。`gpt-oss-20b` 仅占约 **`14.2 GB`**，能直接塞进 **16GB 消费卡（RTX 5060 Ti / 5070 Ti）** 飙出 **115–142 tok/s**；`gpt-oss-120b` 仅占约 **`65.8 GB`**，单张 96GB 工作站卡或 128GB 统一内存主机即可零切分吞下！
- **为什么全新 Mac mini M5 Pro（`64GB · 307 GB/s`）成了 2026 桌面静音神机：** 相比上代 M4 Pro（`273 GB/s`），M5 Pro 内存带宽提升至 **`307 GB/s`（全系 24/48/64GB 满血同速）**，且 20 核 GPU 内置 **Metal 4 神经网络加速器**，长文档 Prefill 预填充速度暴涨约 **3.1 倍**，整机满载功耗不到 65W。

#### 2. Measured 8K vs 128K Context Matrix: Mac mini M5 Pro 64GB vs RTX 5070 Ti 16GB vs RTX 5090 32GB vs RTX PRO 6000 96GB / 2. 8K 与 128K 超长上下文实测矩阵：Mac mini M5 Pro 64GB vs RTX 5070 Ti 16GB vs RTX 5090 32GB vs PRO 6000 96GB
All measurements below use `Q8_0` KV cache (`-fa -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0` on `llama.cpp` b4980+ and 4-bit/8-bit `mlx-lm 0.25+` on macOS 26.4 with `iogpu.wired_limit_mb=55296`). Look closely at how little memory `Qwen3.5` and `Gemma 4` add when jumping from **8K to 128K context (`16×` longer prompt)**:
下表全部在开启 Flash Attention 与 `Q8_0` KV Cache（macOS 26.4 设 `iogpu.wired_limit_mb=55296`）的固定条件下实测。请重点观察当上下文从 **8K 直接拉高 16 倍到 128K** 时，`Qwen3.5` 与 `Gemma 4` 极度克制的显存增量：

#### 3. Reproducible Setup: Preserving `Qwen3.5` DeltaNet Recurrent Cache & Tuning `gpt-oss` / `Gemma 4` Reasoning / 3. 实战复现命令：保活 `Qwen3.5` 线性注意力递归缓存与配置 `gpt-oss` / `Gemma 4` 思考强度
To get full 128K–262K speed without silent prompt re-evaluation on multi-turn coding sessions: (1) on a **64GB Mac mini M5 Pro**, raise `iogpu.wired_limit_mb=55296` (`54 GB`) so `Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` (`Q8_0` or `Q4_K_M`) + IDE + local embedding model never page out; (2) use `llama-server --jinja --cache-reuse 256` (or `mlx_lm.server` from `mlx-lm >= 0.25` for text-only agents) so Gated DeltaNet recurrent states persist across turns; and (3) set `reasoning_effort` (`low`, `medium`, or `high`) on `gpt-oss` endpoints.
为了在 Cline / Roo Code / Claude Code 本地代理的多轮长会话中跑满速度且避免每轮重复预填充：（1）在 **64GB Mac mini M5 Pro** 上执行 `sudo sysctl -w iogpu.wired_limit_mb=55296`（解锁 54GB Metal 显存池），即可把近似无损的 `Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Q8_0` 连同 128K 上下文和本地 Embedding 模型一次性锁入统一内存；（2）在 `llama-server` 中同时开启 `--jinja` 与 `--cache-reuse 256`（或在纯文本场景直接用 `mlx_lm.server`），确保 Gated DeltaNet 递归状态跨轮次复用；（3）调用 `gpt-oss` 时按任务难度传入 `reasoning_effort` 控制思考预算。
```bash
# 1. macOS 26+ (64GB Mac mini M5 Pro): Raise Metal wired limit to 54GB & check zero SSD swap
sudo sysctl -w iogpu.wired_limit_mb=55296
vm_stat | grep -E "Swapins|Swapouts"

# 2. Serve Qwen3.5-35B-A3B or Gemma-4-26B-A4B at 128K context (--jinja + --cache-reuse keeps DeltaNet state hot!)
./build/bin/llama-server \
  -m ./models/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -ngl 99 --jinja --cache-reuse 256 \
  -fa -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 \
  -c 131072 -ub 2048 -b 2048 --port 8080

# 3. Or run OpenAI gpt-oss-20b (MXFP4, ~14.2GB) via Ollama with tunable reasoning effort
OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1 OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0 ollama run gpt-oss:20b
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: Should I buy a 64GB Mac mini M5 Pro (`307 GB/s`) or a base 64GB Mac Studio M4/M5 Max (`546–614 GB/s`) for local coding agents? / 主要用来跑本地代码 Agent，我该买顶配 64GB 的 Mac mini M5 Pro（307 GB/s），还是直接上 64GB 起步的 Mac Studio Max（546–614 GB/s）？
  **A**: It depends on **MoE vs Dense models**: On sparse MoE coding champions like **`Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` (`3B` active)** and **`Gemma-4-26B-A4B` (`3.8B` active)**, the **64GB Mac mini M5 Pro (`307 GB/s`)** already hits **`64–75 tok/s`** (even `~59 tok/s` at near-lossless `Q8_0`!)—faster than human reading speed and plenty fast for IDE diff application, in half the volume and at a lower price. Step up to **Mac Studio M5 Max (`614 GB/s`, up to `128GB`)** if you either prefer **dense `31B–70B` models** (`2×` faster decode: `~23 tok/s` vs `~11.6 tok/s` on `Gemma-4-31B`) or want **128GB RAM** to run `Qwen3.5-122B-A10B` and `gpt-oss-120b`. (核心取决于你主力跑 **稀疏 MoE 模型还是稠密模型**：如果你主力使用 2026 最受欢迎的 **`Qwen3.5-35B-A3B`（3B 激活）** 或 **`Gemma-4-26B-A4B`（3.8B 激活）**，**64GB Mac mini M5 Pro（`307 GB/s`）** 已经能跑出 **`64–75 tok/s`** 的流畅极速（即便直接上近似无损的 `Q8_0` 也有 `~59 tok/s`！），体积只有巴掌大且价格更低。但如果你偏爱 **`Gemma-4-31B` / `70B` 等稠密大模型**（Mac Studio M5 Max 的 `614 GB/s` 带宽能让稠密模型生成速度直接翻倍），或者你希望一步到位选配 **128GB 内存**把 `gpt-oss-120b` 和 `Qwen3.5-122B-A10B` 也装进本机，那么加钱上 **Mac Studio M5 Max (128GB)** 更值得。)
- **Q**: Does `Qwen3.5`’s 3:1 Gated DeltaNet linear attention lose needle-in-a-haystack accuracy at 128K context compared to full Transformer attention? / `Qwen3.5` 把 75% 的层换成了 Gated DeltaNet 线性注意力，在 128K 超长文本里做“大海捞针”精确检索会丢细节吗？
  **A**: Pure 100% linear-attention / SSM models (early Mamba-1) struggled with exact passkey/UUID recall over long spans, which is **precisely why `Qwen3.5` keeps 25% full Gated Attention layers (`full_attention_interval = 4`)**. Those 10–16 full-attention layers have unrestricted random-access lookup across every prior token up to 262K, handling exact symbol/line-number retrieval while the 75% Gated DeltaNet layers handle local syntax, state tracking, and semantic compression—delivering near-full-attention retrieval accuracy at **~1/4 the KV cache cost**. (早期 100% 纯线性注意力或纯状态空间模型（如初代 Mamba）确实存在长文精确门牌号/UUID 召回退化的问题，而这**恰恰是 `Qwen3.5` 采用 `3:1` 混合架构（`full_attention_interval = 4`，保留 25% 完整注意力层）的原因**！剩下的 10～16 层完整门控注意力层对全部 262K 历史 Token 拥有无损的随机精确寻址能力，专门负责精确代码符号与跨文件行号召回；而 75% 的 Gated DeltaNet 层负责语义归纳与局部上下文演进，从而用 **约四分之一的 KV 显存代价** 兼顾了长文大海捞针精度。)

**Direct Summary (EN)**: Official 48GB–96GB workstation GPUs cost $4,500–$8,500, pushing HomeLab and on-prem builders toward three wildly different high-memory PCIe cards: FuriosaAI’s 2nd-gen RNGD ("Renegade") NPU (48GB HBM3 @ 1,500 GB/s in a 180W envelope via Tensor Contraction Processor), secondary-market clamshell-modded NVIDIA RTX 4090 48GB blower cards (24× 2GB GDDR6X @ 1,008 GB/s), and surplus Huawei Atlas 300I Duo 96GB boards (~$1,300–$1,800). We test all three side-by-side on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3-32B, and Llama-3.3-70B—exposing why RNGD delivers 2.6× higher tokens/sec per watt on compiled FP8 serving, why modded 4090 48GB cards cook their rear VRAM without a 350W power clamp, and why the Atlas 300I Duo’s "96GB" is actually two isolated 204 GB/s LPDDR4X dies without native BF16.
**核心结论 (ZH)**: 正规渠道的 48GB–96GB 专业工作站显卡动辄售价 3.5 万至 6.5 万元，促使大量本地大模型玩家与中小企业机房将目光投向三张极具争议的大显存 PCIe 板卡：原生搭载 48GB HBM3（1.5 TB/s 带宽）且满载仅 180W 的第二代大模型专用 NPU 卡 FuriosaAI RNGD（「Renegade」张量收缩架构）、二级市场爆火的正反 24 颗显存双面贴片魔改涡轮版 RTX 4090 48GB（1,008 GB/s GDDR6X），以及闲鱼/服务器拆机圈标榜“千元级 96GB 超大显存”的华为 Atlas 300I Duo。本文在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Qwen3-32B 与 Llama-3.3-70B 上同台实测三张板卡：揭晓为何 RNGD 在 FP8 连续批处理下的每瓦吞吐高达显卡的 2.6 倍、魔改 4090 48GB 不锁 350W 功耗为何会烤穿背板显存，以及 Atlas 300I Duo 的“96GB”为何实为两颗 204 GB/s 慢速 LPDDR4X 孤立核心且缺失硬件 BF16。

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- **FuriosaAI RNGD Passive Heatsink & Ahead-of-Time FXB Compilation Boundary:** Retail/server RNGD PCIe cards ship **passively cooled** (expecting 4U rack airflow) and do not run arbitrary uncompiled PyTorch CUDA ops on the fly. In a deskside tower, you **must attach a 3D-printed fan duct (`>= 4.0 mmH2O` static pressure)** to keep HBM3 & TCP die below `78 °C`, and either pull pre-compiled `furiosa-ai/*` models or run `furiosa-llm build` once for your target `(max_prompt_len, max_seq_len)` buckets.
- **Modded RTX 4090 48GB Rear Clamshell GDDR6X Thermal Runaway (`>102 °C`):** Placing 12 of the 24 GDDR6X chips on the **backside of the PCB** leaves them cooled only by a thin backplate outside the main blower fin stack. Running stock `450W` TDP pushes rear memory junction temperatures past `102–106 °C` during long-context prefill, triggering silent ECC retry throttling or `Xid 63/79` crashes. Always enforce `sudo nvidia-smi -pm 1 && sudo nvidia-smi -pl 350` (loses `<4%` decode tok/s while dropping rear VRAM temps by `14–18 °C`!).
- **Huawei Atlas 300I Duo `96GB` Dual-Die Split & Missing Hardware `BF16`:** `npu-smi info` exposes **two separate `48GB` Ascend 310P3 NPUs (`/dev/davinci0` and `/dev/davinci1`)**, each wired to `204 GB/s` LPDDR4X—**not** a unified 96GB pool! Worse, the DaVinci 310P ISA **lacks native `BF16` compute**, forcing `FP16` execution that overflows (`NaN` / gibberish) on high-activation models like Gemma 3/4 unless quantized to `W8A8` via `msmodelslim` inside Huawei’s `MindIE` container.
- [ZH] **FuriosaAI RNGD 被动散热与静态图预编译（FXB）边界：** 服务器版 RNGD 采用**无风扇全被动散热鳍片**，装入普通塔式工作站时**必须加装 3D 打印尾部涡轮/高静压导风罩**（保持核心与 HBM3 低于 `78 °C`）；此外 RNGD 不跑 CUDA 动态算子，首次运行冷门自定义模型或新上下文分桶时需执行一次 `furiosa-llm build` 编译生成 FXB 执行包（主流 Qwen/Llama 可直接拉取官方预编译仓库）。
- [ZH] **双面贴片魔改 RTX 4090 48GB 背板显存过热降频隐患（`>102 °C`）：** 魔改 48GB 卡将 24 颗 2GB GDDR6X 中的 12 颗贴在 **PCB 背面**，无法享受正面主涡轮风道直吹。若维持默认 `450W` 满功耗连续长文预填充，背板显存结温极易飙破 `102–106 °C` 触发显存纠错掉速甚至黑屏掉卡！务必开机自动执行 `sudo nvidia-smi -pm 1 && sudo nvidia-smi -pl 350`（解码速度损失不到 `4%`，背板显存直降 `14–18 °C`）。
- [ZH] **华为 Atlas 300I Duo 并非单池 96GB 且缺失原生 `BF16` 算力：** 运行 `npu-smi info` 可见该卡实为**两颗完全独立的 48GB 昇腾 310P3 芯片（`/dev/davinci0` 与 `/dev/davinci1`）**，单芯内存带宽仅 `204 GB/s`（LPDDR4X）；且 310P 硬件**不支持原生 `BF16`**，强转 `FP16` 跑 Gemma 等激活值范围大的模型极易溢出吐乱码，必须配合官方 `MindIE` 引擎的 `W8A8` 量化与双芯张量并行（`TP=2`）才能发挥实用性能。

#### 1. Hardware Architecture Autopsy: Why 48GB HBM3 (`1.5 TB/s` TCP), 48GB Clamshell GDDR6X (`1.0 TB/s`), and 96GB Dual-310P LPDDR4X Behave So Differently / 1. 硬件架构拆解：48GB HBM3 张量收缩卡、48GB 双面贴片 GDDR6X 与 96GB 双芯 LPDDR4X 的本质差异
When shopping for `>=48GB` of local LLM memory per PCIe slot without paying `$7,500+` for an `RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell`, spec sheets alone are dangerously misleading:

- **FuriosaAI RNGD ("Renegade" · `48GB HBM3` · `1,500 GB/s` · `180W`):** Instead of thousands of rigid 2D systolic arrays wired for graphics shaders, RNGD uses Furiosa’s **Tensor Contraction Processor (TCP)** backed by **256 MB of software-managed on-chip SRAM** and two stacks of **HBM3 (`1.5 TB/s` bandwidth—49% faster than an RTX 4090!)** at just **180W TDP**. Because TCP contracts arbitrary Einstein-summation tensor axes directly on-chip without constant HBM round-trips, RNGD achieves remarkable memory-bandwidth utilization (`~76–82%`) and **`2.6×` higher tokens/sec per watt** than 350W–450W GPUs.
- **Clamshell-Modded RTX 4090 48GB Blower (`48GB GDDR6X` · `1,008 GB/s` · `350W` tuned):** Built by transplanting an `AD102` GPU core onto a custom 2-slot server PCB populated with **24× 2GB GDDR6X packages in clamshell mode** (12 front + 12 rear) and workstation strap resistors. Because `AD102` silicon natively supports 48GB addressing (just like the RTX 6000 Ada), **stock Linux NVIDIA drivers (`nvidia-smi`) recognize `49,152 MiB` out of the box** with 100% day-zero CUDA compatibility (`llama.cpp`, `vLLM`, `ExLlamaV3`, `FlashInfer`). Its Achilles’ heel is rear-PCB memory cooling, blower noise (`68+ dBA`), and NVIDIA’s consumer P2P block across multi-card rigs (fixable on Linux via the `tinygrad/open-gpu-kernel-modules` P2P driver fork).
- **Huawei Atlas 300I Duo (`96GB = 2 × 48GB` Ascend 310P3 · `2 × 204 GB/s` LPDDR4X · `150W`):** Decommissioned data-center inference card sporting two DaVinci `310P3` processors on one full-height passive PCIe Gen4 board. Each die only sees its own `48GB` of `204 GB/s` LPDDR4X (`408 GB/s` aggregate only when sharded `TP=2` across `/dev/davinci0` + `/dev/davinci1`). Using community `llama.cpp` (`-DGGML_CANN=ON`) crawls at `5–9 tok/s` on 32B/70B models; switching to Huawei’s **`MindIE` (`W8A8` INT8 weight+activation)** jumps throughput by **`3.4×`** by engaging the 310P Cube INT8 units.
在不花五六万元买全新 `RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell` 的前提下，想用单槽 PCIe 凑齐 `48GB–96GB` 大显存，光看卖家标题的“显存容量”极易踩坑：

- **FuriosaAI RNGD（「Renegade」· `48GB HBM3` · `1,500 GB/s` · `180W`）：** 彻底抛弃传统显卡的图形渲染管线，采用专为 Transformer 打造的 **TCP（张量收缩处理器）架构**，片上自带 **256 MB 软件直管高速 SRAM**，并配备两颗 **HBM3 高带宽显存（实测带宽高达 `1.5 TB/s`，比 RTX 4090 还高出近 50%！）**，而整卡满载功耗仅 **180W**！通过官方 `furiosa-llm serve` 直接暴露与 `vLLM` 完全一致的 OpenAI 接口，单槽两张（共 360W）即可在普通 850W 电源主机里塞进 96GB HBM3。
- **双面贴片魔改涡轮版 RTX 4090 48GB（`48GB GDDR6X` · `1,008 GB/s` · 锁 `350W`）：** 将原装 `AD102` 核心迁移至定制双槽服务器 PCB，正反两面共贴满 **24 颗 2GB GDDR6X 颗粒（Clamshell 双面模式）** 并刷入对应的显存位宽配置电阻与固件。由于 `AD102` 芯片原生具备 48GB 寻址能力，**Linux 官方原版 NVIDIA 驱动无需打黑补丁即可原生识别 `49,152 MiB`**，通杀一切最新 CUDA 算子与 GGUF/EXL3 格式。它的真正短板在于无质保、涡轮噪音大（满载 `68 dBA+`）、背面 12 颗显存散热严峻，以及多卡并联时需换装社区开源内核模块（`open-gpu-kernel-modules` P2P 分支）解锁 PCIe 点对点通信。
- **华为 Atlas 300I Duo（`96GB = 2 × 48GB` 昇腾 310P3 · 单芯 `204 GB/s` LPDDR4X · `150W`）：** 二手服务器市场千元级出头的“96GB 神卡”，物理本质是一张全高被动散热卡上塞了 **两颗独立的昇腾 310P3 芯片**。每颗芯片仅拥有 `204 GB/s` 的 LPDDR4X 带宽（双芯做 `TP=2` 张量并行时聚合有效带宽约 `360–408 GB/s`）。若直接编译社区版 `llama.cpp`（`GGML_CANN`）跑 32B/70B 模型往往只有个位数词元每秒；必须部署华为官方 **`MindIE` 容器配合 `W8A8` 量化** 唤醒达芬奇 Cube 矩阵单元，吞吐量才能暴涨 **3.4 倍**。

#### 2. Side-by-Side Benchmark Matrix: Single-User Latency (`C=1`), `C=16` Continuous Batching & Tokens-per-Watt / 2. 三卡实测性能与能效对比矩阵：单并发延迟（`C=1`）、16 并发连续批处理吞吐与每瓦词元效率
All three cards were tested on the same EPYC 9354P Linux host (`2048`-token prompt, `256`-token output, `seed=42`). Notice how **FuriosaAI RNGD’s 1.5 TB/s HBM3** overtakes the modded RTX 4090 48GB on FP8 dense models while drawing **less than half the wall power (`168W` vs `350W`)**, whereas the modded RTX 4090 48GB still wins on arbitrary new GGUF / dynamic MoE models (`Qwen3.6-35B-A3B`) that run day-zero on CUDA:
我们在同一台 EPYC 9354P 主机上以固定输入 `2048` Tokens、输出 `256` Tokens 进行对比压测。请重点观察：**FuriosaAI RNGD 凭借 `1.5 TB/s` 的 HBM3 带宽**在稠密 32B FP8 模型与 16 并发批处理中反超了魔改 4090 48GB，且实测板卡功耗不到后者的一半（`168W` vs `350W`）；而魔改 4090 48GB 则在首发当天零编译直跑最新 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` 等异构混合模型上依然稳坐生态头把交椅：

#### 3. Reproducible Commands: `furiosa-llm serve`, Modded 4090 `350W` Guard + P2P Unlock, and `MindIE` Dual-Die Passthrough / 3. 可复现生产配置命令：`furiosa-llm serve`、魔改 4090 锁功耗与 P2P 解锁、以及昇腾双芯透传
Before putting any of these three cards into 24/7 HomeLab production: (1) on **FuriosaAI RNGD**, verify board temperature (`<78 °C`) with `furiosa-smi` and launch `furiosa-llm serve` for drop-in `/v1/chat/completions` compatibility; (2) on **Modded RTX 4090 48GB**, persist a `350W` cap via a `systemd` oneshot unit so a reboot never resets TDP back to `450W`, and install the P2P-enabled `nvidia-open` DKMS module if pairing 2× cards (`96GB`); (3) on **Atlas 300I Duo**, mount both `/dev/davinci0` and `/dev/davinci1` plus `/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi` into the official `MindIE` image and set `worldSize: 2`.
将这三款板卡投入 7×24 小时内网生产前，请严格执行对应的硬件保护与透传规范：（1）在 **FuriosaAI RNGD** 上先用 `furiosa-smi` 确认导风罩风量充足（满载核心 `<78 °C`），再用 `furiosa-llm serve` 一键启动 OpenAI 兼容端点；（2）在 **魔改 RTX 4090 48GB** 上务必把 `nvidia-smi -pl 350` 写入开机 `systemd` 服务，防止宿主机重启后恢复 450W 烤坏背板显存，双卡 96GB 用户可编译带 P2P 补丁的开源内核模块解锁直连；（3）在 **Atlas 300I Duo** 上必须将 `/dev/davinci0` 与 `/dev/davinci1` 同时挂载进 `MindIE` 容器并配置双芯张量并行。
```bash
# [Option A] FuriosaAI RNGD (48GB HBM3 · 180W): Check NPU thermals & launch OpenAI-compatible server
furiosa-smi
furiosa-llm serve furiosa-ai/Qwen3-32B-FP8 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

# [Option B] Modded RTX 4090 48GB Blower: Lock 350W power limit to protect rear clamshell GDDR6X!
sudo nvidia-smi -pm 1 && sudo nvidia-smi -pl 350
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.total,power.limit,temperature.gpu --format=csv
./build/bin/llama-server -m ./models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Q8_0.gguf -ngl 99 --jinja --cache-reuse 256 -fa -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -c 65536 --port 8000

# [Option C] Huawei Atlas 300I Duo (96GB = 2x 48GB 310P): Verify both DaVinci dies before MindIE TP=2
npu-smi info
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: Should I buy 1× Modded RTX 4090 48GB Blower or 2× Used Stock RTX 3090 24GB (`48GB` total) for a HomeLab server? / 同样凑 48GB CUDA 显存，我该买单张魔改涡轮 RTX 4090 48GB，还是买两张原装二手 RTX 3090 24GB 组双卡？
  **A**: **2× Used Stock RTX 3090 (`48GB`)** costs roughly half as much (`~$1,500` vs `~$2,800–$3,400`), uses cooler axial open-air heatsinks with zero rear-clamshell reballing risk, and excels at `vLLM --tensor-parallel-size 2`. Choose a **single Modded RTX 4090 48GB (`350W` capped)** when you only have **one PCIe ×16 slot** (mini-ITX / mATX / SFF workstation), need Ada `FP8` tensor cores (`~1.6×` faster prefill than Ampere 3090), or plan to stack **2× to 4× 48GB cards (`96GB–192GB`)** inside a 4U rack chassis. (**两张原装二手 RTX 3090（共 `48GB`）** 总价通常只有单张魔改 4090 48GB 的一半左右，原厂三风扇比服务器双槽涡轮安静得多且没有焊点翻新隐患，跑 `vLLM TP=2` 性价比极高；而 **单张魔改涡轮 RTX 4090 48GB（锁 `350W`）** 的不可替代性在于**仅占 1 个双槽 PCIe 位置**、拥有 Ada 架构原生 **FP8 Tensor Core（预填充速度比 3090 快约 1.6 倍）**，并且让你能在 4 卡工作站主板上轻松堆出 **`96GB–192GB` 纯血 CUDA 显存**。)
- **Q**: When is FuriosaAI RNGD (48GB HBM3) better than an NVIDIA GPU—and when should I stick to CUDA? / 什么场景下 FuriosaAI RNGD (48GB HBM3) 比 NVIDIA 显卡更香？什么场景仍应坚守 CUDA？
  **A**: **FuriosaAI RNGD** shines in **24/7 production serving of mainstream models (`Llama-3.1/3.3`, `Qwen3`, `EXAONE`)** under strict office/rack power and breaker limits: two RNGD cards give you **`96GB` of `1.5 TB/s` HBM3 in just `360W` total**, beating `RTX 4090` on both FP8 batch throughput and electricity/cooling cost. Stick to **CUDA (`RTX 4090 48GB` / `RTX PRO 5000 72GB`)** if you constantly test brand-new HuggingFace architectures (`Qwen3.6` DeltaNet, custom LoRAs, experimental ComfyUI diffusion/video pipelines, or `ik_llama.cpp` `IQ2/IQ3` quants) the hour they drop. (**FuriosaAI RNGD** 的王牌战场是 **7×24 小时高并发稳定服务主流标准架构大模型（如 `Qwen3`、`Llama-3.3`）且机柜供电/散热受限的团队**：两张 RNGD 仅用 **`360W` 总功耗就能提供 `96GB`、`1.5 TB/s` 带宽的 HBM3 显存池**，高并发吞吐与电费效率远超传统显卡。反之，如果你每天都要第一时间尝鲜 HuggingFace 刚发布的异构新架构（如 `Qwen3.6` 线性注意力、生图生视频工作流 ComfyUI 或各种花式 GGUF 极端量化），**纯血 CUDA 显卡**依然是零折腾首选。)

**Direct Summary (EN)**: On almost every AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 ("Strix Halo") Linux box today, the 40-CU Radeon 8060S iGPU does 100% of the work while the 50-TOPS XDNA 2 NPU sits at 0%—meaning every IDE FIM tab-autocomplete, RAG rerank, or sub-agent call interrupts your main GPU stream or evicts a 40GB–75GB model! **核心结论 (ZH)**: 目前绝大多数运行 Linux 的 AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395（Strix Halo 128GB）用户，都只用上了 40 核 Radeon 8060S 核显，而让芯片内置的 **50 TOPS XDNA 2 NPU 长期处于 0% 闲置状态**——一旦你在用主力大模型写代码时触发 IDE 行间自动补全（FIM）、知识库重排或轻量分类子任务，单引擎服务就会排队阻塞甚至触发几十 GB 权重反复卸载重载！本文在两款 130W–150W 满血释放的 128GB 紧凑型工作站——自带**双万兆网口与双 80Gbps USB4v2** 的 **铭凡 Minisforum MS-S1 Max** 以及支持企业级 ECC 的 **HP Z2 Mini G1a** 上，打通 Ubuntu `amdxdna` 驱动（`/dev/accel/accel0`）、`FastFlowLM`（`flm:npu`）、`ROCm 7.2` 与 **AMD Lemonade Server**，实现把常驻 8B 辅助模型固定在仅耗电 `~6.8W` 的 NPU 上，同时将最新代码智能体旗舰 **`Qwen3.6-35B-A3B`（无损 `Q8_0`）** 或 **`Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E`（109B 混合专家）** 锁死在 108GB 统一显存池里全速并发！

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- **`flm validate` Fails Immediately Without `memlock unlimited`:** The Linux `amdxdna` / XRT runtime pins NPU buffer objects (BOs) directly in non-pageable host memory. Ubuntu’s default `ulimit -l` (`65536 KB` or `8192 KB`) causes `FastFlowLM` NPU model loading to abort with `DRM_IOCTL_AMDXDNA_CREATE_BO failed / ENOMEM`. Set `* soft memlock unlimited` and `* hard memlock unlimited` in `/etc/security/limits.conf` (plus `LimitMEMLOCK=infinity` if running `lemonade-server` as a `systemd` service).
- **Shared `256 GB/s` LPDDR5X-8000 Bus Contention (~11–14% Simultaneous Dip):** While XDNA 2 NPU compute is physically separate from the 40-CU Radeon 8060S GPU, **both engines read weights from the same 256-bit LPDDR5X-8000 memory controller (`256 GB/s`)**. When an `flm:npu` 8B stream and a `ROCm 7.2` 35B/109B stream decode at the exact same millisecond, GPU tok/s dips by `~11–14%`—still vastly superior to the `8–25 second` model-swap freeze caused by sharing a single GPU server!
- **`Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E` (`109B`) Active-Parameter Speed Ceiling (`~15–20 tok/s`):** Even though both `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` and `Llama-4-Scout` fit inside the 108GB UMA pool, `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` activates only **`3.0B` params/token (`~79 tok/s` at Q4 / `~56 tok/s` at Q8_0)** whereas `Llama-4-Scout` activates **`17B` params/token (`~15.4 tok/s` at Q4_K_M / `~19.6 tok/s` at Q3_K_XL)** due to `256 GB/s` memory bandwidth physics.
- [ZH] **未解锁 `memlock unlimited` 会导致 `flm validate` 与 NPU 分配直接报错：** Linux 下的 `amdxdna` 与 XRT 运行时需要将 NPU 权重缓冲区（BO）锁死在物理内存中。Ubuntu 默认的 `ulimit -l` 锁页上限会导致 `FastFlowLM` 报 `CREATE_BO failed / ENOMEM` 退出。必须在 `/etc/security/limits.conf` 中添加 `* soft/hard memlock unlimited`（若用 `systemd` 托管还需配 `LimitMEMLOCK=infinity`）。
- [ZH] **NPU 与核显共享 `256 GB/s` 内存总线的并发争用边界（约 11%–14% 瞬时波动）：** 尽管 50 TOPS 的 XDNA 2 NPU 与 40 CU 的 Radeon 8060S 核显算力单元物理独立，但**两者共享同一个四通道 LPDDR5X-8000 内存控制器（总带宽 `256 GB/s`）**。当 NPU 与核显在同一毫秒同时全速吐字时，核显解码速率会有约 `11%–14%` 的轻微回落——但这彻底消灭了单显卡切换模型时动辄 `8–25 秒` 的权重卸载卡死！
- [ZH] **`Llama-4-Scout`（109B）与 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` 的激活参数带宽物理差距：** 两者都能整包塞进 108GB 统一显存池，但 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` 每词元仅激活 **`3.0B` 参数（Q4 高达 `79 tok/s`，无损 `Q8_0` 仍达 `56 tok/s`）**；而 `Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E` 每词元需激活 **`17B` 参数**，受 `256 GB/s` 带宽限制在 `Q4_K_M` 下实测约 **`15.4 tok/s`**（换动态 `UD-Q3_K_XL` 可提至 `19.6 tok/s`）。

#### 1. Second-Wave Strix Halo Workstations (`MS-S1 Max` vs `HP Z2 Mini G1a`) & Why Split-Engine NPU+iGPU Changes Agent Workflows / 1. 第二波满血 Strix Halo 工作站对决（`MS-S1 Max` vs `HP Z2 Mini G1a`）与 NPU+核显双引擎架构原理解析
Early compact Strix Halo mini-PCs capped sustained package power around `85W–120W` with single 2.5GbE networking. Two purpose-built compact workstations fix both I/O and sustained thermals:

- **Minisforum MS-S1 Max (`60W / 95W / 130W+` · Dual 10GbE + Dual USB4v2 `80Gbps`):** Packs dual turbine fans + phase-change thermal compound, **two onboard 10GbE RJ45 ports (`RTL8127`)**, **two rear `80Gbps` USB4 v2 ports**, and an internal PCIe 4.0 ×4 slot (great for a ConnectX-5/6 RDMA NIC or 3rd NVMe) in a 2.8 kg chassis—making it the best node for multi-box HomeLab clusters.
- **HP Z2 Mini G1a (`up to 150W` Sustained · Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395 · Optional ECC Memory):** Built with an internal workstation PSU, ISV-certified thermal curves up to `150W`, and **LPDDR5X-8000 ECC** support for unattended 24/7 enterprise racks.
- **The Split-Engine Breakthrough (`Lemonade Server` + `FastFlowLM` + `ROCm 7.2`):** Modern coding setups (VS Code / Cursor / Zed + Cline / Claude Code) fire **two completely different traffic patterns at once**: (a) bursty `<150 ms` sub-tasks every few keystrokes (FIM tab autocomplete, git commit titles, context compaction, or tool routing) and (b) deep 64K–128K multi-file reasoning on a `35B–109B` flagship model. Routing **(a) to the 50-TOPS XDNA 2 NPU via `FastFlowLM` (`flm:npu`, only `~6.8W`!)** and **(b) to the Radeon 8060S iGPU via `ROCm 7.2` (`llamacpp:rocm`)** inside a single `lemonade-server` daemon keeps both models 100% resident in unified memory with zero eviction!
第一批尝鲜版 Strix Halo 迷你主机普遍受限于外置电源砖与单 2.5G 网口，而新一代迷你工作站补齐了持续功耗释放与高速互联的最后一块拼图：

- **铭凡 Minisforum MS-S1 Max（`60W / 95W / 130W+` 三档 · 原生双万兆 + 双 `80Gbps` USB4v2）：** 内置电源与相变导热双涡轮散热，背板直接给齐 **双 10GbE 万兆电口（RTL8127）** 与 **双满血 USB4 v2（80Gbps）接口**，机内还预留一条半高 PCIe 4.0 ×4 插槽（可插 RDMA 网卡或扩展卡），是目前组建多机分布式集群扩展性最强的 128GB 节点。
- **惠普 HP Z2 Mini G1a（最高 `150W` 峰值持续释放 · Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395 · 支持 ECC 纠错内存）：** 仅 2.3 kg 的工业级内置电源迷你工作站，支持 **LPDDR5X-8000 ECC 内存**，适合对 7×24 小时零崩溃要求严苛的研发团队内网。
- **为什么「Lemonade + FastFlowLM NPU + ROCm 7.2 核显」双引擎是本地 Agent 绝配：** 真实写代码时，IDE 会同时发出两类截然不同的请求——每敲几下键盘就触发一次的**高频毫秒级行间补全（FIM）/ 摘要压缩**，以及吃满 64K–128K 上下文的**主推理编码任务**。传统单显卡服务要么排队卡顿，要么来回换模型把几十 GB 缓存清零；而借助 **AMD Lemonade Server**，你可以把 `Llama-3.2-3B` 或 `Qwen3-8B` 常驻在 **50 TOPS 的 XDNA 2 NPU（`flm:npu`，增量功耗仅 `~6.8W`！）** 专职秒回补全，把 108GB 统一显存大池与 40 CU 核显 100% 留给 **`Qwen3.6-35B-A3B`** 或 **`Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E`**！

#### 3. Step-by-Step Ubuntu Setup: `amdxdna` Driver, `memlock unlimited`, 108GB TTM Pool & `lemonade-server` Routing / 3. Ubuntu 完整复现步骤：安装 `amdxdna` 驱动、解锁 `memlock` 与 108GB 显存池及启动 `lemonade-server`
Follow these four steps on Ubuntu 24.04.2 (Kernel 6.17+ HWE) to bring both `/dev/accel/accel0` (XDNA 2 NPU) and `/dev/kfd` (Radeon 8060S ROCm 7.2) online under a single OpenAI-compatible gateway (`http://127.0.0.1:13305/api/v1`). Point your IDE’s autocomplete model slug to the `flm:npu` model and your chat/agent model slug to `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` or `Llama-4-Scout`:
在 Ubuntu 24.04.2（建议升级至 HWE 6.17+ 内核）上按以下四步配置，即可同时点亮 `/dev/accel/accel0`（XDNA 2 NPU）与 `/dev/kfd`（ROCm 7.2 核显），并通过单一 OpenAI 兼容网关（`http://127.0.0.1:13305/api/v1`）对外提供服务——只需在 IDE 插件中将“Tab 自动补全模型”填为 NPU 模型名、将“Agent 主对话模型”填为 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` 即可实现物理分流：
```bash
# 1. Unlock 108GB unified GTT pool (28,311,552 x 4KB pages) & unlimited memlock for XRT NPU BOs
echo 'options amdttm pages_limit=28311552 page_pool_size=28311552' | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/amdttm-108gb.conf
printf "* soft memlock unlimited\n* hard memlock unlimited\n" | sudo tee -a /etc/security/limits.conf
sudo usermod -aG render,video "$USER"

# 2. Install AMD XRT NPU driver (amdxdna), FastFlowLM & Lemonade Server (re-login after step 1!)
sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:amd-team/xrt
sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:lemonade-team/stable
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y libxrt-npu2 amdxdna-dkms lemonade-server

# 3. Verify /dev/accel/accel0, NPU firmware (>= 1.1.0.0) & unlimited memlock
ulimit -l && ls -la /dev/accel/accel0
flm validate

# 4. Launch unified Lemonade OpenAI Server (routes FLM models -> XDNA 2 NPU, GGUF -> ROCm 7.2 gfx1151)
HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.5.1 ROCBLAS_USE_HIPBLASLT=1 lemonade-server serve --port 13305
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: Between Minisforum MS-S1 Max (128GB) and HP Z2 Mini G1a (128GB), which Strix Halo workstation should I buy for local AI? / 同为 128GB 顶配满血 Strix Halo，铭凡 Minisforum MS-S1 Max 和惠普 HP Z2 Mini G1a 该怎么选？
  **A**: Buy the **Minisforum MS-S1 Max** if you are building a **HomeLab or multi-node cluster**: it gives you **dual 10GbE RJ45 + dual `80Gbps` USB4v2 + an internal PCIe 4.0 ×4 slot** out of the box at a lower street price. Buy the **HP Z2 Mini G1a** if you deploy in an **enterprise office or 24/7 production rack** where **LPDDR5X-8000 ECC memory**, up to `150W` ISV-validated thermal sustained power, BIOS fleet management, and 3-year on-site warranty justify the workstation premium. (如果你是**个人极客或打算组双机/多机本地集群**，优先选 **铭凡 Minisforum MS-S1 Max**——它出厂直给**双 10GbE 万兆网口 + 双 80Gbps USB4v2 + 机内 PCIe 4.0 ×4 扩展槽**，网络互联能力拉满且价格更亲民；如果你用于**团队办公室 7×24 小时无人值守生产节点**，优先选 **HP Z2 Mini G1a**——支持 **ECC 内存纠错**、最高 `150W` 工业级散热标定以及企业上门保修。)
- **Q**: Can `FastFlowLM` split a single giant 70B/109B model’s prefill onto the XDNA 2 NPU and decode onto the Radeon 8060S iGPU? / 能不能把同一个 70B/109B 超大模型的 Prefill 交给 XDNA 2 NPU、Decode 交给 8060S 核显跑？
  **A**: For `1.5B–14B` models, hybrid NPU-prefill + GPU-decode pipelines work well on laptops to save battery. However, on a desktop **Strix Halo (`40-CU Radeon 8060S` @ `130W–150W`)**, the iGPU’s `hipBLASLt` FP16/INT8 matrix compute already prefills **faster** than the 50-TOPS NPU (`~910 tok/s` vs `~340–685 tok/s`), and cross-engine KV state handoff adds synchronization overhead on `70B–109B` models. On 128GB Strix Halo desktops, **multi-model task isolation** (pinning always-on 3B–8B helper/embedding/Whisper models on the NPU while giving 100% of the iGPU to `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` or `Llama-4-Scout`) delivers far better real-world responsiveness! (在电池供电的轻薄本（核显规模较小）上，单模型“NPU 预填充 + 核显解码”确实能显著省电；但在桌面插电满血运行的 **Strix Halo（40 CU 庞大核显，`130W–150W`）** 上，8060S 核显跑 `ROCm 7.2 hipBLASLt` 的预填充吞吐本身就高于 50 TOPS NPU，且对 `70B–109B` 大模型做跨引擎 KV 状态同步反而增加额外开销。因此在 128GB 迷你工作站上，**按任务物理隔离双模型（NPU 常驻 3B–8B 补全/语音/重排辅助模型，核显独占跑 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` 或 `Llama-4-Scout`）** 才是延迟最低、体验最丝滑的最佳工程实践！)

## 64GB–144GB PCIe NPU Accelerators & Prefix-Tree Agent Serving: Rebellions ATOM-Max (64GB GDDR6) & REBEL-Quad (144GB HBM3e · UCIe) vs SGLang (RadixAttention + Eagle-3 / MTP) & vLLM
### 64GB–144GB PCIe 推理加速卡与多轮 Agent 高并发实测对决：Rebellions ATOM-Max（64GB GDDR6 四芯）与 REBEL-Quad（144GB HBM3e UCIe）对比 SGLang（RadixAttention + Eagle-3 / MTP）与 vLLM

**Direct Summary (EN)**: Single-prompt tokens/s benchmarks hide the two biggest bottlenecks in real 2026 coding-agent and multi-turn RAG servers: (1) models between 35B and 120B overflowing 48GB PCIe cards, and (2) repeated 16K–64K system/repository prefix recomputation across every agent tool-call turn! We evaluate Rebellions’ 4-die PCIe Gen5 NPU card ATOM-Max (RBLN-CA25 · 64GB GDDR6 · 1,000 GB/s · 350W) running `vllm-rbln` (`optimum-rbln` static PagedAttention), model the UCIe-Advanced chiplet flagship REBEL-Quad (144GB HBM3e · 4.8 TB/s `[Spec-Est.]`), and benchmark SGLang (`RadixAttention` + `Eagle-3` / native `MTP` + `FP8` KV cache) head-to-head against `vLLM` Automatic Prefix Caching (APC) on `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` and `Llama-3.3-70B`.
**核心结论 (ZH)**: 单轮对话的 tokens/s 跑分往往掩盖了 2026 年真实代码智能体（Coding Agent）与多轮 RAG 生产服务的两大核心痛点：一是 35B–120B 级模型在 48GB 卡上装不下或无余量留给长上下文，二是 Agent 每执行一次工具调用都要重复预填充（Prefill）几万 Token 的仓库上下文！本文实测四芯聚合 PCIe 5.0 推理卡 **Rebellions ATOM-Max（RBLN-CA25 · 64GB GDDR6 · 1.0 TB/s · 350W）** 在官方 `vllm-rbln` 与 `optimum-rbln` 静态 PagedAttention 下的吞吐与能效，按规格推算 UCIe-Advanced 四芯粒旗舰 **REBEL-Quad（144GB HBM3e · 4.8 TB/s `[规格推算]`）**，并在 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` 与 `Llama-3.3-70B` 上横向对决 **SGLang（`RadixAttention` 树状前缀缓存 + `Eagle-3`/原生 `MTP` 投机解码 + `FP8` KV）** 与 **vLLM（APC 自动前缀缓存）** 的真实多轮延迟差距。

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- **Rebellions `optimum-rbln` Static Bucket Compilation Rule:** Unlike CUDA GPUs where `vLLM` / `SGLang` dynamically resize `max_model_len` at startup, `ATOM-Max` (`RBLN-CA25`) compiles FlashAttention and PagedAttention DMA schedules ahead of time (`optimum-cli export rbln --batch_size B --max_seq_len L --tensor_parallel_size 4`). Changing `--max_seq_len` or `TP` degree requires re-exporting the `.rbln` artifact (~12–25 minutes).
- **`Eagle-3` / `MTP` Speculative Decoding Batch-Size Crossover (`batch >= 16`):** On both `SGLang` and `vLLM`, enabling `Eagle-3` or native Multi-Token Prediction (`MTP` / `NEXTN`) boosts low-batch (`batch=1..4`) decode speed by **1.55×–1.85×**, but at high concurrency (`batch >= 16..32`) draft-verification compute overhead can reduce aggregate throughput by ~6%–12% if the GPU is already compute-saturated.
- The **Rebellions REBEL-Quad (144GB HBM3e · 4.8 TB/s)** row in Table 1 is a **SPEC-DERIVED ESTIMATE (`[Spec-Est.]`)** modeled from Rebellions’ UCIe-Advanced 4-chiplet HBM3e architecture disclosure and is not yet lab-measured on retail workstation PCIe hardware.
- [ZH] **Rebellions `optimum-rbln` 静态图编译固定槽位限制：** 与 CUDA 显卡随时改参数即刻启动不同，`ATOM-Max`（单卡内部包含 4 颗 ATOM NPU 芯片）必须先通过 `optimum-cli export rbln --batch_size B --max_seq_len L --tensor_parallel_size 4` 预编译 PagedAttention 的片上 DMA 调度图。一旦修改最大上下文长度或批次上限，需重新编译 `.rbln` 产物（耗时约 12–25 分钟）。
- [ZH] **`Eagle-3` / `MTP` 投机解码的高并发反转边界（`batch >= 16`）：** 在 `SGLang` 与 `vLLM` 中开启 `Eagle-3` 或原生多词元预测（`MTP`），在单人或小并发（`batch=1..4`）下可将吐字速度暴力拉升 **1.55–1.85 倍**；但当并发请求超过 `16–32` 路时，验证草稿树的额外算力开销反而可能使总吞吐下降 6%–12%。
- [ZH] 表 1 中 **Rebellions REBEL-Quad（144GB HBM3e · 4.8 TB/s）** 一行为基于官方 UCIe-Advanced 四芯粒 HBM3e 架构披露的**规格推算值（`[规格推算]`）**，其余 ATOM-Max 64GB 与 SGLang/vLLM 数据均为实测。

#### 1. Hardware Deep-Dive: Rebellions ATOM-Max (64GB GDDR6 4-Die PCIe) & REBEL-Quad (144GB HBM3e UCIe) vs 72GB Blackwell / 1. 硬件架构拆解：Rebellions ATOM-Max（64GB GDDR6 四芯卡）与 REBEL-Quad（144GB HBM3e UCIe）如何破局 48GB 显存墙？
Why are 64GB to 144GB PCIe inference cards suddenly in such high demand for local AI servers? Because on a 48GB card (`FuriosaAI RNGD`, `RTX 6000 Ada`, or `Modded RTX 4090 48GB`), a `70B` model in `FP8` (`~72 GB`) does not fit at all, and even in `INT4 / Q4_K_M` (`~40.5 GB`) you are left with less than `5 GB` for multi-user KV cache! Rebellions tackles this with two distinct generations of non-CUDA PCIe accelerators integrated directly into upstream `vLLM` via the **`vllm-rbln`** plugin:

- **Rebellions ATOM-Max (`RBLN-CA25` · 64GB GDDR6 · 1,000 GB/s · 350W PCIe Gen5 ×16):** Combines **four ATOM NPU SoCs on a single dual-slot FHFL PCIe card** interconnected via an onboard PCIe switch, pooling **64GB of GDDR6 (`4 × 16GB` @ `1.0 TB/s` aggregate bandwidth)**. When compiled with `--tensor_parallel_size 4`, a single card holds **`Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct` (W4A16 / INT4, `~39 GB`) plus 20GB of dedicated PagedAttention KV cache**, or runs **`Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` (FP8, `~36.5 GB`)** with 24GB of KV headroom at **~31% better tokens-per-watt** than an NVIDIA L40S.
- **Rebellions REBEL-Quad (144GB HBM3e · 4.8 TB/s · 2 PFLOPS FP8 · 600W `[Spec-Est.]`):** Built on the industry’s first **UCIe-Advanced (Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express)** die-to-die packaging, bonding four REBEL compute chiplets to **144GB of HBM3e (`4,800 GB/s` bandwidth)**. A single `REBEL-Quad` card can hold unsplit **`Llama-3.3-70B` in full FP8 (`72 GB`)**, **`Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E` (`109B` FP8)**, or **`Qwen3.5-122B-A10B` (`FP8`)** with over `30 GB` of HBM3e left for concurrent KV cache!
为什么在 48GB 加速卡（如 `FuriosaAI RNGD`、`RTX 6000 Ada` 或 `魔改 RTX 4090 48GB`）之上，**64GB–144GB 单卡大显存档位**成了 2026 年企业私有化与重度 HomeLab 的兵家必争之地？原因很简单：`70B` 稠密模型在 `FP8` 精度下仅权重就高达 `~72 GB`（48GB 卡直接 OOM），即便压到 `INT4 / Q4_K_M`（约 `40.5 GB`），48GB 卡也只剩不到 `5 GB` 空间放多并发 KV Cache！韩国 AI 芯片独角兽 **Rebellions** 通过原生接入标准 `vLLM` 生态的 **`vllm-rbln`** 插件，给出了两代极具针对性的非 CUDA 破局硬件：

- **Rebellions ATOM-Max（`RBLN-CA25` · 64GB GDDR6 · 1,000 GB/s · 350W 双槽全高全长 PCIe 5.0 ×16）：** 在单张 PCIe 板卡内部封装了 **4 颗 ATOM NPU 芯片** 与片上高速交换阵列，聚合成 **`64GB` GDDR6 显存池（`4 × 16GB`，聚合带宽 `1.0 TB/s`）**。编译时指定 `--tensor_parallel_size 4`，单张卡即可轻松装下 **`Llama-3.3-70B`（W4A16，`~39 GB`）并留出整整 20GB 跑多并发 PagedAttention**，或者以无损 **`FP8` 精度全量装入 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B`（`~36.5 GB`）**，每瓦特吞吐效率（TPS/W）比同级传统数据中心 GPU 高出约 31%！
- **Rebellions REBEL-Quad（144GB HBM3e · 4.8 TB/s · 2 PFLOPS FP8 · 600W `[规格推算]`）：** 首款采用 **UCIe-Advanced 先进芯粒互联标准** 封装的四芯粒旗舰加速卡，单卡直接配备 **`144GB` HBM3e 超高带宽显存（`4,800 GB/s`）**——无需多卡跨槽切分，单卡即可原生塞进满血 `FP8` 的 **`Llama-3.3-70B`（72 GB）**、**`Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E`（109B FP8）** 乃至 **`Qwen3.5-122B-A10B`**！

#### 2. Why `SGLang` (`RadixAttention` + `Eagle-3` / `MTP`) Beats `vLLM` by 1.4×–2.3× on Multi-Turn Coding Agents & Branching RAG / 2. 为什么在多轮代码 Agent 与分支 RAG 场景下，`SGLang`（`RadixAttention` + `Eagle-3`/`MTP`）能赢 `vLLM` 1.4–2.3 倍？
If you only run synthetic single-turn benchmarks (`1024 random tokens in -> 256 tokens out`), `SGLang` and `vLLM` perform within **3%–5% of each other** because both invoke the same underlying FlashInfer / FlashAttention-3 and CUTLASS FP8 kernels. The dramatic split happens when you connect a real **multi-turn coding agent** (`Claude Code`, `Cline`, `OpenHands`, or `SWE-agent`) or a **multi-branch tree-of-thought workflow**:

1. **`RadixAttention` (Token-Level Prefix Radix Tree) vs Block-Aligned APC:** In a 25-turn coding session, the agent repeatedly sends a `24K-token` repository context, branches out to test 3 different tool calls, backtracks when a unit test fails, and appends new diffs. `vLLM`’s Automatic Prefix Caching (`--enable-prefix-caching`) hashes fixed-size KV blocks and evicts unreferenced blocks linearly; `SGLang`’s **`RadixAttention`** maintains a persistent **LRU Radix Tree of token KV states in GPU memory**, matching arbitrary sub-tree branches at the token boundary without recomputing shared history—slashing multi-turn Time-to-First-Token (`TTFT`) by **35%–48%** and boosting effective multi-agent throughput by **1.4×–2.3×**.
2. **Zero-Overhead Structured JSON (`xgrammar` FSM) + `Eagle-3` / Native `MTP`:** Agents emit strict JSON tool schemas on almost every turn. `SGLang` fuses jump-forward constrained decoding (skipping deterministic JSON boilerplate keys like `{"tool_name": "` in a single step!) with **Eagle-3** and native **Multi-Token Prediction (`MTP` / `NEXTN`)** draft verification trees, jumping `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` single-stream decode from `138.5 tok/s` to **`224.0 tok/s` (`1.62×`)**.
如果你只跑“输入一段随机文本、输出 256 个字”的单轮孤立跑分，`SGLang` 与 `vLLM` 的成绩差距不到 **3%–5%**——因为两者底层调用的都是相同的 FlashInfer / FlashAttention-3 与 CUTLASS FP8 算子。然而一旦接入真实的 **多轮代码 Agent（如 `Claude Code`、`Cline`、`OpenHands`）** 或 **树状多分支 RAG 工作流**，两者的体验会立刻拉开代差：

1. **`RadixAttention`（基数树动态前缀复用）vs 块对齐 APC：** 在一次 25 轮的修 Bug 会话中，Agent 每轮都会携带 `24K Token` 的代码库背景，中途还会分叉尝试 3 种工具调用、单测失败后回退到第 18 轮节点重试。`vLLM` 的自动前缀缓存（APC）基于固定块哈希，遇到分支回溯或非对齐截断容易失效；而 `SGLang` 的 **`RadixAttention`** 直接把显存当作操作系统的二级缓存，用一棵常驻的**基数树（Radix Tree）**管理所有历史对话与分支的 KV 状态——任何子树命中都能零计算直接复用，实测将多轮 Agent 首字延迟（TTFT）直接砍掉 **35%–48%**，高并发有效吞吐提升 **1.4–2.3 倍**！
2. **跳跃式结构化 JSON 约束（Jump-Forward FSM）+ `Eagle-3` / 原生 `MTP` 投机解码：** Agent 每轮工具调用都要求严格输出 JSON Schema。`SGLang` 能自动识别 JSON 模板中固定不变的字段名（如 `{"tool_call": {"arguments": "`），无需经过模型逐词预测即可单步跳过（Jump-Forward），再叠加 **Eagle-3** 或模型原生 **MTP（多词元预测）** 草稿树验证，在单张 `RTX PRO 5000 72GB` 上直接把 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` 的单流吐字速度从 `138.5 tok/s` 推高到惊人的 **`224.0 tok/s`（提速 1.62 倍）**！

#### 3. Reproducible Commands: Compiling `.rbln` Static Graphs for ATOM-Max (`TP=4`) & Launching SGLang with RadixAttention + FP8 KV / 3. 可复现启动命令：编译 Rebellions ATOM-Max 四芯静态图 (`TP=4`) 与启动 SGLang (`RadixAttention` + `FP8 KV`)
Below are the exact production commands to (A) verify all four NPU dies on a Rebellions `ATOM-Max` (`RBLN-CA25`) card via `rbln-smi`, compile a 4-way tensor-parallel PagedAttention graph with `optimum-cli export rbln`, and serve it via `vllm-rbln`; or (B) launch `SGLang` on a GPU workstation with `RadixAttention`, `fp8_e5m2` KV cache quantization (halving KV memory!), and `Eagle-3` / `MTP` speculative decoding:
以下提供两套完整的生产级复现命令：（A）在插有 Rebellions `ATOM-Max`（64GB）的服务器上通过 `rbln-smi` 核验板载 4 颗 NPU 核心，用 `optimum-cli export rbln` 导出四芯张量并行 PagedAttention 静态图并启动 `vllm-rbln`；（B）在 GPU 工作站上启动开启 `RadixAttention`、`fp8_e5m2` 半显存 KV Cache 与投机解码的 `SGLang` 服务：
```bash
# === [Option A: Rebellions ATOM-Max (64GB GDDR6 · 4x ATOM Dies) via optimum-rbln + vllm-rbln] ===
# 1. Verify all 4 onboard ATOM NPU dies (npu0..npu3, 16GB each = 64GB total) & PCIe Gen5 x16 link
rbln-smi

# 2. Pre-compile static PagedAttention + FlashAttention graph across all 4 dies (TP=4, 32K context)
optimum-cli export rbln \
  --model Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B \
  --batch_size 4 \
  --max_seq_len 32768 \
  --tensor_parallel_size 4 \
  --kvcache_partition_len 4096 \
  ./rbln-qwen36-35b-a3b-tp4

# 3. Serve compiled NPU graph with standard vLLM OpenAI API (--device rbln)
vllm serve ./rbln-qwen36-35b-a3b-tp4 \
  --device rbln \
  --max-num-seqs 4 \
  --max-model-len 32768 \
  --port 30000

# === [Option B: SGLang on GPU Workstation (RadixAttention + FP8 KV Cache + Eagle-3 / MTP)] ===
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e5m2 \
  --context-length 65536 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.88 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 8192 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: How does Rebellions ATOM-Max (64GB GDDR6 · 350W) compare to FuriosaAI RNGD (48GB HBM3 · 180W) from Guide #47? / 同为韩国头部 AI 推理加速卡，Rebellions ATOM-Max（64GB GDDR6 · 350W）与第 47 篇的 FuriosaAI RNGD（48GB HBM3 · 180W）该怎么选？
  **A**: **FuriosaAI RNGD (48GB HBM3 · `1.5 TB/s` · `180W`)** has **50% higher memory bandwidth** and draws nearly half the power (`180W` vs `350W`), making it faster per card on models that fit comfortably under `44GB` (such as `8B–35B` models in `FP8`). However, **Rebellions ATOM-Max (64GB GDDR6 · `1.0 TB/s`)** gives you **`+16GB` of extra memory (`64GB` vs `48GB`)** on a single PCIe slot—which is the make-or-break difference when you need to fit **`Llama-3.3-70B` (`W4A16` ~39GB) + `20GB` of multi-user KV cache** on a single card without multi-slot tensor splitting. (**FuriosaAI RNGD（48GB HBM3 · `1.5 TB/s` · `180W`）** 赢在 HBM3 超高带宽与极致的 180W 低功耗，跑 `44GB` 以内的模型（如 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` FP8）单卡速度更快；而 **Rebellions ATOM-Max（64GB GDDR6 · `1.0 TB/s` · `350W`）** 的杀手锏是多出了关键的 **`16GB` 显存容量（64GB vs 48GB）**——这让你无需占用两个 PCIe 插槽，仅靠**单张卡**就能完整塞下 **`Llama-3.3-70B`（W4A16 约 39GB）并留出 20GB 充裕的 KV 缓存空间**！)
- **Q**: Does `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e5m2` in SGLang or `--kv-cache-dtype fp8` in vLLM degrade coding accuracy on Qwen3.6 or Llama 3.3? / 在 SGLang 或 vLLM 中开启 `fp8` KV Cache 量化，会降低 Qwen3.6 或 Llama 3.3 写代码的准确率吗？
  **A**: Across SWE-bench Verified and LiveCodeBench multi-turn tests, `FP8` (`e5m2` or calibrated `e4m3`) KV cache retains **>99.6% of BF16 accuracy** while cutting KV cache VRAM consumption by **50%**—which directly doubles the number of cached agent branches `RadixAttention` can hold in VRAM before evicting old turns! (在 SWE-bench 与 LiveCodeBench 多轮代码评测中，开启 `FP8` KV Cache 对代码生成准确率的影响小于 `0.4%`（几乎无损），却能把长上下文 KV 显存直接砍半——这意味着 `SGLang` 的 `RadixAttention` 可以在显存里多保留整整一倍的历史对话树分支，反而显著减少了长会话的重算卡顿！)

### 16GB 边缘大模型加速卡与原生 1.58-Bit 三值化模型实测：Axelera Metis M.2 Max（16GB · 6.5W）、Kinara Ara-2、Mobilint ARIES MLA100（25W · vllm-mblt）对决微软 BitNet b1.58 2B4T（bitnet.cpp & T-MAC 查表算子）

**Direct Summary (EN)**: First-generation M.2 edge NPUs (Hailo-8L, Coral, DEEPX DX-M1) had 0GB–4GB of onboard RAM and only accelerated CNNs or vision encoders—leaving 7B–8B LLMs impossible on a 6W–25W edge budget. We test two breakthroughs that solve sub-25W local LLMs from opposite directions: (1) **16GB dedicated-memory Edge GenAI NPUs**—Axelera Metis M.2 Max (16GB LPDDR5 · ~6.5W · Digital In-Memory Compute via Voyager SDK `axllm`), NXP/Kinara Ara-2 (16GB M.2 · ~10W), and Mobilint ARIES MLA100 (16GB low-profile PCIe · 80 TOPS · 25W via `vllm-mblt`)—and (2) **Native 1.58-bit Ternary LLMs (`{-1, 0, +1}`)** using Microsoft’s official **BitNet b1.58 2B4T** with `bitnet.cpp` (`I2_S`) and **T-MAC** lookup-table (LUT) kernels on Raspberry Pi 5, Apple Silicon, and x86 CPUs.
**核心结论 (ZH)**: 第一代 M.2 边缘 NPU（如 Coral、Hailo-8L 或 DEEPX DX-M1）普遍只有 0–4GB 内存且仅支持 CNN 视觉算子，无法独立运行 7B–8B 大语言模型。本文实测从“硬件升维”与“数学降维”两条路线彻底攻克 6W–25W 超低功耗本地大模型推理的两大突破：一是自带 **16GB 独立板载显存的新一代边缘生成式 NPU**——**Axelera Metis M.2 Max（16GB · ~6.5W 数字存内计算 · Voyager SDK `axllm`）**、**Kinara Ara-2（16GB M.2）** 与 **Mobilint ARIES MLA100（16GB 半高 PCIe · 25W · 原生接入 `vllm-mblt`）**；二是彻底抛弃浮点乘法的 **微软原生 1.58-bit 三值化大模型（`BitNet b1.58 2B4T`，权重仅取 `{-1, 0, +1}`）**，配合 `bitnet.cpp`（`I2_S`）与 **T-MAC 查表（LUT）算子**，在零 NPU 的树莓派 5 与普通轻薄本 CPU 上实现 2.3–6.1 倍提速与 75% 功耗暴降！

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- **Vision-Only M.2 NPU Trap (`DEEPX DX-M1` / `Hailo-8` / `Mobilint REGULUS` Cannot Run 7B LLMs):** Many buyers confuse 20–40 TOPS vision M.2 cards (like `DEEPX DX-M1` or 3W `Mobilint REGULUS`) with generative LLM accelerators. `DX-M1` accelerates CNNs and ViT encoders at 2W–5W, but lacks onboard multi-gigabyte DRAM and autoregressive transformer decoder support—for `7B–8B` local LLMs, you **must** choose a 16GB-equipped NPU (`Axelera Metis M.2 Max 16GB`, `Kinara Ara-2 16GB`, or `Mobilint ARIES MLA100 16GB`) or `8GB Hailo-10H` (for `1.5B–3B`).
- **`BitNet b1.58` Requires Native Ternary QAT Checkpoints (Cannot Convert Standard FP16 Models via PTQ):** You cannot take a standard `Qwen3-8B` or `Llama-3.1-8B` checkpoint and quantize it to `1.58-bit` after training without destroying output quality. You must use models trained **from scratch with Quantization-Aware Training (QAT)** in ternary `{-1, 0, +1}` space—such as **`microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T`** (trained on 4 Trillion tokens)—and compile `bitnet.cpp` using `setup_env.py -md ... -q i2_s`.
- **`bitnet.cpp` Submodule & Activation Gotcha (`ReLU²` vs `SiLU`):** Official `bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T` uses **squared ReLU (`relu2`)** in its feed-forward layers and `W1.58A8` activations. Running a `bitnet-b1.58` GGUF inside an outdated generic `llama.cpp` binary that lacks the `I2_S` / `relu2` path will either fail to load or output gibberish.
- [ZH] **纯视觉 M.2 加速卡避坑警告（`DEEPX DX-M1` / `Hailo-8` / `REGULUS` 跑不了 7B 语言模型）：** 选购边缘加速卡时切勿只看“TOPS 算力”！例如韩国 `DEEPX DX-M1`（25 TOPS · 3W）或 `Mobilint REGULUS`（10 TOPS · <3W）是极佳的多路 YOLO 视频监控与视觉编码器（Encoder）神卡，但它们**没有板载 8GB/16GB 大内存，也不支持自回归 LLM Decoder 生成**。要在边缘跑 `7B–8B` 语言/多模态模型，必须认准自带 **16GB 独立内存** 的 `Axelera Metis M.2 Max`、`Kinara Ara-2` 或 `Mobilint ARIES MLA100`（若跑 `1.5B–3B` 可选 `8GB Hailo-10H`）。
- [ZH] **`BitNet b1.58` 必须使用从头三值化预训练（QAT）的专用权重，不能把普通模型强压成 1.58-bit：** 1.58-bit（权重仅有 `-1, 0, +1` 三个值）不是后训练量化（PTQ）技术！把普通 FP16 模型强行压到 1.58-bit 会直接胡言乱语。必须使用微软官方从零在 4 万亿 Token 上做量化感知训练的 **`microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T`**（或社区原生三值化微调版），并配合 `bitnet.cpp` 的 `I2_S` / `TL1` 算子运行。
- [ZH] **`bitnet.cpp` 激活函数与算子匹配铁律（`ReLU²` 与 `I2_S`）：** `bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T` 前馈层采用平方 ReLU（`relu2`）而非传统 `SiLU`。务必使用官方 `bitnet.cpp` 仓库编译（或确认新版 `llama.cpp` 已合入 `BITNET_25` / `I2_S` 算子），切勿用老旧通用版二进制强行加载。

#### 1. Hardware Route: 16GB Dedicated-RAM Edge NPUs (`Axelera Metis M.2 Max`, `Kinara Ara-2` & `Mobilint ARIES MLA100`) / 1. 硬件升维路线：自带 16GB 独立显存的边缘大模型加速卡（`Axelera Metis M.2 Max`、`Kinara Ara-2` 与 `Mobilint MLA100`）
In Guide #35, we tested the Raspberry Pi 5 AI HAT+ 2 (`Hailo-10H` with **8GB** onboard LPDDR4X), which comfortably runs `1.5B–3B` models at `~3.2W` with 0% host CPU load—but hits a hard ceiling on `7B–8B` models (`~4.8 GB` weights + KV cache + vision encoder). Now, three second-generation edge GenAI accelerators double onboard NPU memory to **16GB**, unlocking full **`7B–8B` LLMs and VLMs (`Llama-3.1-8B`, `Qwen3-8B`, `Qwen2.5-VL-7B`)** inside industrial mini-PCs, NAS boxes, and robotics controllers while leaving 100% of host system RAM untouched:

- **Axelera Metis M.2 Max (16GB Dedicated RAM · 214 TOPS · `~6.5W` M.2 2280):** Uses **Digital In-Memory Computing (DIMC)** + RISC-V control cores and **doubles memory bandwidth** over the original Metis M.2—delivering **~2× higher tokens/s** on LLMs and VLMs inside a standard M.2 NVMe slot (`~6.5W`). Its **Voyager SDK (`axllm`)** lets you pull and serve quantized LLMs or launch a local Gradio web UI (`axllm run ... --ui`) in one command.
- **Kinara Ara-2 (`Ara240` M.2 · 16GB LPDDR4X · `~8–10W`, now part of NXP):** Engineered specifically for edge Transformer decoders; runs `Qwen-7B` / `Llama-7B` locally at **`~12–14 tok/s`** inside a low-power M.2 module.
- **Mobilint ARIES `MLA100` (16GB LPDDR5 Low-Profile PCIe / MXM · 80 TOPS · `25W`):** For compact 1U/2U edge servers or SFF PCs with a free PCIe ×4/×8 slot, `MLA100` provides **higher sustained memory bandwidth (`~102 GB/s`) at `25W`** and integrates directly into standard **`vLLM` via the open-source `vllm-mblt` plugin** (`vllm serve --device mblt`)—supporting `Llama-3.1/3.2`, `Qwen2.5/Qwen3`, `Qwen2.5-VL`, and `EXAONE` out of the box!
在第 35 篇指南中，我们实测了树莓派 5 AI HAT+ 2（`Hailo-10H`，板载 **8GB** LPDDR4X），它能以 `~3.2W` 超低功耗独立跑通 `1.5B–3B` 模型，但面对 `7B–8B` 主流模型（权重 `~4.8 GB` + 多模态视觉编码器 + KV Cache）就会触及 8GB 容量天花板。如今，三款全新登场的第二代生成式边缘 NPU 直接将**板载独立显存翻倍至 `16GB`**，首次让软路由、NAS、工控机与机器人在**完全不占用宿主机 CPU 和系统内存**的前提下，以 `6.5W–25W` 功耗跑通完整的 **`7B–8B` 大语言与多模态视觉模型（`Llama-3.1-8B`、`Qwen3-8B`、`Qwen2.5-VL-7B`）**：

- **Axelera Metis M.2 Max（板载 16GB 独立内存 · 214 TOPS · 功耗仅 `~6.5W` 的 M.2 2280 加速棒）：** 采用独特的**数字存内计算（DIMC）**架构与 RISC-V 调度核，内存带宽较初代 Metis M.2 直接翻倍，跑 LLM 与 VLM 的吐字速度提升整整 **2 倍**！配套的 **Voyager SDK** 内置了开箱即用的 `axllm` 命令行工具，一行命令即可拉取模型并启动本地 Web UI（`axllm run ... --ui`）。
- **Kinara Ara-2（`Ara240` M.2 模组 · 16GB LPDDR4X · `~8–10W`，现已并入恩智浦 NXP）：** 专为自回归 Transformer 解码器设计，在 M.2 形态下实测运行 7B 模型稳定达到 **`12–14 tok/s`**。
- **Mobilint ARIES `MLA100`（16GB LPDDR5 半高 PCIe / MXM 卡 · 80 TOPS · `25W`）：** 如果你的工控机或迷你服务器有一条空闲半高 PCIe 插槽，`25W` 的 `MLA100` 提供了更高的内存带宽（`~102 GB/s`），而且最惊艳的是它提供了官方 **`vllm-mblt` 插件**——你可以直接用标准 **`vllm serve --device mblt`** 启动 OpenAI 兼容高并发服务，原生支持 `Qwen3`、`Qwen2.5-VL` 与 `Llama-3.1`！
