#### 3. Reproducible Commands: Deploy 3-Tier vLLM NVMe KV Offload & Audit Disaggregated Prefill/Decode Nodes / 3. 可复现部署命令：启动 vLLM 三层 PCIe Gen5 KV 卸载与异构预填充/解码节点自检
Use `vLLM v0.33.0+` with `LMCacheConnectorV1` (mirroring the TRUSTA AI Scaler 3-tier hierarchy) to offload cold KV blocks onto a dedicated PCIe Gen5 NVMe mount, or split `NixlConnector` into `kv_producer` (GPU prefill) and `kv_consumer` (decode node) across your local RDMA network.
在单机服务器上可直接通过 `vLLM v0.33.0+` 的 `LMCacheConnectorV1` 复现 TRUSTA AI Scaler 同款三层持久化 KV 缓存池；在多机架构下则可通过 `NixlConnector` 将高算力 GPU 设为 `kv_producer`（预填充）并向大内存解码节点推送 KV 块。
```bash
# 1) Verify PCIe Gen5 x4 link speed (32GT/s) & Intel AMX BF16 support
sudo lspci -vv | grep -E 'Non-Volatile|LnkSta:' | head -n 12
grep -m1 -o 'amx_bf16' /proc/cpuinfo || true

# 2) Launch vLLM with 3-tier persistent KV offload (GPU -> 192GB DRAM -> TRUSTA T7P5 Gen5 NVMe)
export LMCACHE_USE_EXPERIMENTAL=True
export LMCACHE_LOCAL_CPU=True LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_CPU_SIZE=192
export LMCACHE_LOCAL_DISK="file:///mnt/trusta-t7p5-kv/" LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_DISK_SIZE=1024
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 --max-model-len 131072 --enable-prefix-caching \
  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"LMCacheConnectorV1","kv_role":"kv_both"}' --port 8100

# 3) On a MiTAC G4520G6 decode node: confirm all 32x HTX301 PCIe endpoints (8 cards x 4 chips)
lspci | grep -ciE 'Skymizer|HTX301'
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: Can TRUSTA AI Scaler / PCIe Gen5 SSD KV offloading let a 24GB GPU run a 120B model that does not fit in VRAM? / 有了 TRUSTA AI Scaler 和 13.5 GB/s 的 PCIe Gen5 固态卸载 KV 缓存后，24GB 显卡能直接跑 120B 大模型吗？
  **A**: No—keep **weight residency** and **KV cache tiering** strictly separate. PCIe Gen5 SSDs (`13.5 GB/s`) are great for saving and reloading **multi-turn / multi-agent KV caches** so you never recompute `64K–128K` prompts when switching users or restarting the server. Active **model weights** are read on *every single token*, so streaming `70 GB` of weights from a `13.5 GB/s` SSD would crawl at `<0.2 tok/s`. Weights must still sit in GPU VRAM, unified memory, or high-channel DDR5/MRDIMM. (不能——必须严格区分 **模型权重常驻** 与 **KV 缓存分层卸载**。`13.5 GB/s` 的 PCIe Gen5 固态非常适合持久化保存与秒级重载 **多用户/多轮 Agent 的长上下文 KV 缓存**（避免换人或重启后重算 64K–128K 提示词）；而活跃模型权重在生成**每一个字**时都要全量读取，若从 `13.5 GB/s` 固态流式读 70GB 权重，吐字速率会跌到不足 `0.2 tok/s`。权重仍必须留在显存、统一内存或多通道 DDR5/MRDIMM 中。)
- **Q**: Why does Skymizer HTX301-4S use 4 chips per card with commodity DRAM instead of one giant HBM die? / 为什么 Skymizer HTX301-4S 选择在单张卡上放置 4 颗小芯片配普通 DRAM，而不是做一颗超大 HBM 芯片？
  **A**: Token generation (decode) for trillion-parameter MoEs like **Kimi K3.1 Pro (`1.56 TB` MXFP4)** is starved for **memory capacity per dollar and per watt**, not peak FP16 matrix FLOPS. Splitting a card into `4x` independent `HTX301` decode engines surrounded by dense commodity DRAM reaches `256 GB` per `~155W` PCIe card (`2 TB` in one air-cooled 4U chassis) without CoWoS/HBM packaging bottlenecks—leaving the expensive high-FLOPS GPU strictly for the short, compute-intensive prefill burst. (对于 **Kimi K3.1 Pro（`1.56 TB` MXFP4）** 这类万亿级稀疏 MoE，解码阶段真正卡脖子的是**每元/每瓦所能买到的内存总容量**，而非峰值矩阵算力。单卡拆为 4 颗独立 `HTX301` 解码引擎并联大容量经济型 DRAM，彻底避开了 CoWoS 与 HBM 封装产能瓶颈，在单卡 `~155W` 功耗下实现 `256 GB`（4U 风冷整机 `2 TB`），把昂贵的高算力 GPU 留给纯算力密集型的短时预填充阶段。)

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- Unsloth Desktop XDNA 2 NPU inference requires models in the specialized Q4NX binary format (converted locally from GGUF on CPU via Unsloth’s Export utility) and runs through Lemonade + FastFlowLM—standard raw GGUF files cannot execute directly on /dev/accel/accel0 without Q4NX conversion.
- Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B supports 2-minute MP4 video and RGB images via its C-RADIO v4-H vision encoder, plus 1M context via Mamba-2 state-space layers—verify your llama.cpp / vLLM build includes both the Mamba-2 hybrid cache and C-RADIO mmproj projector before feeding multimodal inputs.
- While GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro allows up to 160GB VRAM allocation from its 192GB LPDDR5X-8533 pool, leaving <32GB for Linux/Windows OS + NPU Q4NX host buffers triggers swap stutter; cap iGPU model + KV budgets at <=135–145GB when running dual iGPU + NPU engines concurrently.

- [ZH] Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B 依托 Mamba-2 状态空间层实现 1M 上下文并内置 C-RADIO v4-H 视觉/2 分钟视频编码器——喂入图片或视频前需确保 llama.cpp / vLLM 版本完整支持 Mamba-2 混合状态缓存与 C-RADIO mmproj 投影权重。
- [ZH] 尽管 GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro 支持从 192GB 统一内存中划拨高达 160GB 给核显，但若同时启用 XDNA 2 NPU（Q4NX 驻留）+ 核显大模型，务必为操作系统与 NPU 缓冲区保留至少 32–40GB 系统内存，建议将核显占用控制在 135–145GB 以内以防触发 Swap 卡顿。

#### 1. NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (120B-A12B) & Lightning (30B-A3B): Why Mamba-2 + MoE Loves 192GB Unified Memory / 1. NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (120B-A12B) 与 Lightning (30B-A3B)：为何 Mamba-2 混合 MoE 是 192GB 统一内存绝配
Released under NVIDIA’s permissive **OpenMDW-1.1** license alongside **SC26 Nemotron for Science**, the **Nemotron 3.5** lineup solves the two biggest pain points of desktop unified-memory machines (`273 GB/s` bandwidth ceiling & long-context KV explosion):

- **Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B**: Combines **Mamba-2 state-space layers** interleaved with sparse Transformer Attention and **512 routed MoE experts** (`120B` total, only **`12B` active** per token), paired with the **C-RADIO v4-H** vision encoder (text + RGB images + up to 2-minute MP4 video), **1M context**, **native Multi-Token Prediction (`MTP`)** speculative heads, and runtime reasoning toggles (`enable_thinking=True/False` or `off / medium / on`). At `Q4_K_M` (`~75 GB`) or `Q8_0` (`~131 GB`), it fits completely inside **GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro’s `160GB` allocatable VRAM** with negligible Mamba-2 KV growth at `64K–128K` context.
- **Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B**: Only **`3B` active parameters** (`~18.7 GB` at `Q4_K_M`) with native MTP—flying past `50–70 tok/s` on `273 GB/s` unified memory or `24GB` discrete GPUs for always-on coding/tool agents.
伴随 SC26 **Nemotron for Science** 一并开源的 **NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5** 系列（采用商业友好的 **OpenMDW-1.1** 许可），精准命中了桌面统一内存工作站的两大命门——`273 GB/s` 物理带宽上限与长上下文 KV 显存膨胀：

- **Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B**：采用 **Mamba-2 状态空间层 + 稀疏注意力 + 512 路由专家 MoE** 混合骨架（总参 `120B`，每字仅激活 **`12B`**），集成 **C-RADIO v4-H** 视觉编码器（原生支持文本、图像与最长 2 分钟 MP4 视频）、**1M 超长上下文**、原生 **多词预测（`MTP`）投机解码头** 及动态思考开关（`enable_thinking=True/False` 或 `off / medium / on`）。`Q4_K_M`（约 `75 GB`）甚至近无损 `Q8_0`（约 `131 GB`）都能完整装入 **GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro 的 `160GB` 可划拨显存**，且 `64K–128K` 上下文下 KV 增长极低。
- **Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B**：总参 `30B`、激活仅 **`3B`**（`Q4_K_M` 约 `18.7 GB`），自带 MTP 加速，在 `273 GB/s` 统一内存或 `24GB` 独显上均可轻松跑出 `50–70+ tok/s`，适合全天候高频工具调用。

#### 2. GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro (192GB) + Unsloth Desktop Native XDNA 2 NPU (Q4NX): Dual-Engine Sizing & Benchmarks / 2. GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro（192GB）+ Unsloth Desktop 原生 XDNA 2 NPU（Q4NX）：双引擎并发与性能推算

#### 3. Reproducible Setup: Serve Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on 160GB UMA & Connect Unsloth XDNA 2 NPU (Q4NX) / 3. 可复现部署：在 160GB 核显拉起 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 并联动 Unsloth XDNA 2 NPU（Q4NX）
Verify `192GB` memory + Linux `7.4` `amdgpu.iommu_perfopt=1` and `/dev/accel/accel0` first, then run **Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B** on port `8080` (`Radeon 8065S`) alongside **Unsloth Desktop’s Lemonade + FastFlowLM (`Q4NX`)** OpenAI endpoint on port `8081` (`XDNA 2 NPU`), controlling reasoning depth per request with `enable_thinking`.
先核验 `192GB` 内存、Linux `7.4` `amdgpu.iommu_perfopt=1` 与 `/dev/accel/accel0` NPU 节点，再将 **Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B** 部署在 `8080` 端口（`Radeon 8065S` 核显），同时将 **Unsloth Desktop（Lemonade + FastFlowLM `Q4NX`）** 部署在 `8081` 端口（`XDNA 2 NPU`），按任务复杂度通过 `enable_thinking` 动态切换思考预算。
```bash
# 1) Verify 192GB RAM, Linux 7.4 AMD IOMMU PerfOpt, and /dev/accel/accel0 XDNA 2 NPU
free -h && ls -l /dev/accel/accel* /dev/kfd

# 3) Serve NVIDIA Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B on Radeon 8065S 160GB UMA (64K Mamba-2 ctx)

  -ngl 99 -fa on --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 -c 65536 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: How does GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro (192GB) compare to a 128GB Strix Halo box like Minisforum MS-S1 Max for Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B? / 跑 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B 时，192GB 的 GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro 相比 128GB Strix Halo（如 MS-S1 Max）核心优势在哪？
  **A**: On a `128GB` box (`~96–108GB` usable UMA), `Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B` at `Q4_K_M` (`~78 GB`) leaves only `~20–25 GB` for OS, browser, Docker RAG, and an NPU Q4NX model—making `Q8_0` (`~134 GB`) impossible. **GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro’s `192GB` LPDDR5X-8533 (`273 GB/s`, `+6.6%` higher bandwidth + `+64GB` RAM)** lets you either run near-lossless `Q8_0` (`~134 GB`) comfortably, **or** run `Q4_K_M` (`~78 GB`) on the Radeon 8065S **simultaneously** with a `22 GB` Q4NX MoE model on the XDNA 2 NPU plus Dual `10GbE` NAS indexing with zero memory pressure. (在 `128GB` 机器（可用显存约 `96–108GB`）上，装入 `Q4_K_M` 版 `Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B`（约 `78 GB`）后仅剩 `20–25 GB` 留给系统、Docker RAG 与 NPU 模型，完全塞不下 `Q8_0`（约 `134 GB`）。**GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro 凭借 `192GB` LPDDR5X-8533（`273 GB/s` 带宽与多出的 `64GB` 物理内存）**，既可以单机跑近无损 `Q8_0`，也可以在核显常驻 `Q4_K_M` 的同时，让 XDNA 2 NPU 并发驻留 `22 GB` Q4NX MoE 模型并叠加双万兆 NAS 检索而游刃有余。)
- **Q**: Why does Unsloth Desktop convert GGUF to Q4NX instead of running GGUF directly on AMD XDNA 2 NPUs? / 为什么 Unsloth Desktop 要先把 GGUF 转成 Q4NX 格式，而不能直接拿 GGUF 在 AMD XDNA 2 NPU 上推理？
  **A**: Standard `GGUF` super-block layouts (`Q4_K_M`) are tuned for GPU SIMT warps and CPU AVX-512/NEON vector lanes. AMD’s **XDNA 2** is a spatial dataflow AIE (AI Engine) tile array with fixed SRAM scratchpads per tile. **FastFlowLM’s `Q4NX` format** pre-packs quantized weights, scales, and tiling alignments to stream cleanly through XDNA 2 AIE tiles without CPU dequantization stalls—delivering `<15W` sustained token generation while leaving the CPU and Radeon iGPU 100% idle. (标准 `GGUF` 的量化块布局（如 `Q4_K_M`）是为 GPU SIMT 线程束与 CPU AVX-512/NEON 矢量指令设计的，而 AMD **XDNA 2** 是带有片上固定 SRAM 阵列的空间数据流 AIE 架构。**FastFlowLM 的 `Q4NX` 格式** 预先将量化权重、缩放因子与分块边界对齐到 XDNA 2 硬件瓦片尺寸，避免 CPU 反量化拖累，从而在 `<15W` 极低功耗下实现稳定吐字，同时让 CPU 与核显保持 100% 空闲。)

## SC26 Non-HBM Memory Wall Breakers: Intel GPU D270 (160GB/480GB Xe3P LPDDR5X) & Qualcomm Dragonfly AI200 (768GB LPDDR) vs Phison NPU Computational Storage SSD (64GB · 130 GB/s)
### SC26 绕开 HBM 内存墙三大新硬件拆解：Intel GPU D270（160GB/480GB Xe3P LPDDR5X）、高通 Dragonfly AI200（768GB LPDDR）对决群联内置 NPU 计算存储 SSD（64GB · 130 GB/s）

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- Spec-derived engineering analysis (not lab-benchmarked yet): Intel GPU D270, Qualcomm Dragonfly AI200, and Phison’s NPU-SSD were detailed at SC26 (Nov 15–20, 2026) and are not yet retail shelf parts for HomeLab purchase.
- Phison quoted 36,800 DMIPS for its computational storage drive—DMIPS is a legacy CPU scalar integer metric rather than modern neural TOPS, indicating companion scalar control cores rather than GPU-class dense prefill throughput; treat the SSD as a near-data RAG pre-filter/reranker, not a primary LLM generator.
- Qualcomm Dragonfly AI200 requires a 140–160 kW OCP ORv3 direct liquid-cooled rack for its 56-card (~43TB) configuration and focuses on memory capacity + TCO rather than per-chip HBM3e peak bandwidth (higher near-memory bandwidth is deferred to the AI250 roadmap).
- Intel GPU D270 strips out all legacy graphics/ray-tracing blocks (headless compute only) and relies on Intel’s oneAPI / vLLM-XPU ecosystem rather than CUDA—verify custom FP4/FP8 kernel parity before migrating CUDA-specific extensions.

#### 1. SC26 Non-HBM Memory Wall Matrix: Capacity, Bandwidth & Power Envelopes / 1. SC26 非 HBM 破墙硬件横评：容量、带宽与功耗边界
By late 2026, two realities dominate local and on-premise AI infrastructure: HBM3e supply remains severely price-inflated, and long-context agentic loops (`128K–1M` tokens, multi-turn KV caches, and terabyte-scale RAG corpora) hit **memory capacity walls** long before they saturate GPU FLOPS. At **SC26 in Chicago (Nov 15–20, 2026)**, Intel, Qualcomm, and Phison showcased three sharply different escapes from the HBM tax.

Compare the key engineering ratios below—especially **usable capacity per slot**, **memory bandwidth**, and **bandwidth-to-capacity ratio (`GB/s per GB`)**, which directly determines whether a card shines at fast single-stream decode or high-concurrency long-context residency (`[Spec-Est.]` marks vendor-spec derived projections):
到 2026 年底，私有化 AI 算力最痛的瓶颈已从「算力不足」彻底转向「容量太贵」：HBM3e 封装溢价居高不下，而 `128K–1M` 长上下文 Agent、多轮持久化 KV 缓存与 TB 级企业 RAG 语料往往在吃满 GPU 算力前就先撞上**显存容量墙**。在 **2026 年 11 月芝加哥 SC26 大会** 上，Intel、高通与群联分别交出了三条截然不同的非 HBM 破局方案。

下表将三款 SC26 新硬件与常见的 96GB GDDR7 工作站卡并列对比，重点关注**单卡容量、显存带宽与带容比**——这一比值直接决定它适合单路高速吐字，还是多并发长上下文驻留（`[Spec-Est.]` 为基于公开规格推算值）：

| Hardware (SC26 / Baseline) (硬件平台（SC26 新秀 / 基线）) | Memory & Bandwidth (显存/内存容量与带宽) | Compute & Precision (算力与精度特性) | Power & Form Factor (功耗与物理形态) | Primary Engineering Sweet Spot (核心工程甜点场景) |

#### 2. Intel GPU D270 vs Qualcomm Dragonfly AI200: Bandwidth-to-Capacity Reality / 2. Intel GPU D270 对决高通 Dragonfly AI200：LPDDR5X 的带容比账本
Intel’s **GPU D270** (formerly codenamed *Crescent Island*) answers the single biggest complaint about mid-tier enterprise GPUs: `96GB` GDDR7 still forces you to split `120B–235B` MoE models across two PCIe cards when running long contexts. By wiring **`160GB` of LPDDR5X at `1.5 TB/s`** inside a standard **`350W` air-cooled PCIe 5.0 card** (with partner ODM variants scaling to **`480GB`**), a single D270 holds a `Q4_K_M` or `FP8` `120B–235B` sparse MoE plus `64K–128K` KV cache without cross-card PCIe/NCCL overhead. Even more unusually, Intel stripped out all display/ray-tracing silicon to fund **full-rate FP64** alongside FP4/FP8 (`1.3 PFLOPS` FP8)—letting HPC and quant teams claim up to **`5.9x` higher throughput than RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition** on financial Monte Carlo / Black-Scholes simulations at `350W` vs `600W`.

**Qualcomm Dragonfly AI200** pushes the LPDDR5X capacity bet to its logical extreme: **`768GB` per accelerator card**, scaling to **`~43TB` across `56` liquid-cooled cards** inside a single OCP ORv3 rack (`140–160 kW`) now entering customer cloud evaluations via **Cirrascale’s AI Innovation Cloud**. Instead of chasing peak single-user `tok/s` on dense models, `768GB` per card eliminates tensor-parallel sharding across 8+ GPUs for frontier MoE weights and giant persistent agent KV caches—cutting interconnect power and rack TCO dramatically. If your bottleneck is ultra-low latency per single user rather than memory capacity per dollar, note that Qualcomm explicitly reserves its next-gen High Bandwidth Compute near-memory tier for the upcoming **AI250**.
正式定名的 **Intel GPU D270**（原代号 Crescent Island）直击 `96GB` GDDR7 显卡的最大痛点：在长上下文场景下，`120B–235B` 级 MoE 依然被迫拆成双卡承担 PCIe 跨卡同步开销。D270 在标准 **`350W` 风冷 PCIe 5.0 单卡**中塞入 **`160GB` LPDDR5X（`1.5 TB/s` 带宽）**，合作 OEM 方案甚至可扩展至 **`480GB`**，单卡即可完整装下 `Q4_K_M` / `FP8` 的 `120B–235B` 稀疏 MoE 与 `64K–128K` KV 缓存。更罕见的是，Intel 彻底剔除图形与光追单元，在保留 `1.3 PFLOPS` FP8 / FP4 的同时提供了**全速 FP64 双精度**——SC26 上 Intel 公布预量产实测在金融蒙特卡洛 / Black-Scholes 模拟中以 `350W` 对 `600W` 取得最高 **`5.9` 倍于 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition** 的吞吐。

**高通 Dragonfly AI200** 则把 LPDDR5X 大容量路线推向极致：**单卡 `768GB` LPDDR5X**，单个 OCP ORv3 直接液冷机柜塞入 `56` 卡、聚合 **约 `43TB` 内存**（`140–160 kW`），并在 SC26 期间联合 **Cirrascale AI Innovation Cloud** 开放客户云测。它的核心价值不是拼单并发极速，而是让 `671B–1T+` 参数大模型与海量多 Agent KV 缓存免于跨 8 卡甚至跨机切分，大幅压降互联功耗与机柜 TCO。如果你的核心指标是极低单路延迟，高通已明确将更高近存带宽留给下一代 **AI250**。

#### 3. Phison NPU Computational Storage SSD: Brilliant RAG Pre-Filter, Not a GPU Replacement / 3. 群联内置 NPU 计算存储 SSD 冷静拆解：极佳的近数据 RAG 过滤器，但别当主推理卡用
Phison’s SC26 preview enterprise SSD integrates an **onboard NPU plus `64GB` of local memory at `130 GB/s`** and demonstrates running standard **PyTorch, vLLM, OpenVINO, and llama.cpp** directly on the drive—no proprietary storage DSL required. Why does `130 GB/s` inside an SSD matter? A PCIe Gen5 x4 NVMe link maxes out around `14 GB/s` per drive. When a RAG pipeline scans tens of gigabytes of parquet chunks, embeddings, or log shards across `8–24` NVMe bays, streaming raw data over the PCIe root complex saturates CPU memory channels before a single token is generated. Filtering, embedding, or small-model reranking *inside* each drive cuts host PCIe transfer volume by **`10x–100x`**.

However, do not fall for headline hype: Phison’s published compute figure is **`36,800 DMIPS`** (Dhrystone Million Instructions Per Second)—a legacy scalar CPU integer benchmark, not a modern matrix-math TOPS rating—and `130 GB/s` is roughly one-twelfth of Intel GPU D270’s `1.5 TB/s`. Even on a small `7B–8B Q4_K_M` model (`~4.8 GB`), `130 GB/s` caps theoretical memory-bound decode around `~15–18 tok/s` before compute limits kick in. The winning architecture is **hierarchical**: let NPU-SSDs execute local vector filtering, metadata extraction, and small-model triage near flash, while handing curated context windows to a `160GB` D270 or `96GB` GPU for heavy reasoning.
群联在 SC26 展示的企业级计算存储概念盘在 SSD 内部集成了 **NPU 与 `64GB` 板载内存（`130 GB/s` 内部带宽）**，并主打无需专有存储编程语言、直接在盘内运行 **PyTorch、vLLM、OpenVINO 与 llama.cpp**。为什么盘内 `130 GB/s` 极具工程意义？单条 PCIe Gen5 x4 NVMe 总线的极限吞吐约 `14 GB/s`；当 `8–24` 块盘组成的企业 RAG 集群扫描几十 GB 向量分片或日志时，把原始数据全拉进宿主机内存会直接打满 PCIe 根复合体与内存通道。在盘内直接完成向量筛选、嵌入或小模型重排，可将跨 PCIe 搬运量压降 **`10–100` 倍**。

但必须保持工程清醒：群联公布的算力数字是 **`36,800 DMIPS`**——这是传统标量 CPU 整数指标，并非现代 NPU 的矩阵 TOPS 算力；且 `130 GB/s` 仅为 Intel GPU D270（`1.5 TB/s`）的约十二分之一，即便跑 `7B–8B Q4_K_M`（约 `4.8 GB`），纯带宽理论上限也仅在 `15–18 tok/s` 左右。真正合理的架构是**分层协同**：用计算存储 SSD 在闪存侧完成近数据检索、清洗与轻量重排，再把浓缩后的高价值上下文喂给 `160GB` D270 或大显存 GPU 执行深度推理。

#### 4. Reproducible Host Readiness Audit: PCIe 5.0 Topology, vLLM-XPU & Near-Data NVMe Baseline / 4. 可复现宿主机预检与演练：PCIe 5.0 拓扑核查、vLLM-XPU 与近数据 NVMe 基线测试
Before evaluating Intel GPU D270 / Xe3P PCIe 5.0 cards or benchmarking whether your RAG pipeline is actually bottlenecked by PCIe NVMe ingestion (making computational storage worthwhile), run the audit below to measure PCIe link width/speed, NUMA locality, Intel XPU / vLLM container readiness, and raw NVMe-to-RAM transfer ceiling:
在引入 Intel GPU D270 等 PCIe 5.0 无头大内存加速卡，或评估现有企业 RAG 是否真的卡死在 NVMe-to-Host PCIe 吞吐（从而值得关注计算存储盘）之前，先执行以下预检脚本，核查 PCIe 5.0 速率、NUMA 亲和性、Intel XPU / vLLM 容器环境与原始 NVMe 吞吐基线：
```bash
# 1) Verify PCIe 5.0 x16 (32GT/s) accelerator slots & NVMe Gen5 x4 link status
lspci -vv 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Display|Processing accelerators|Non-Volatile|LnkSta:' | head -n 24

# 2) Check NUMA node topology so 160GB-480GB cards & NVMe bays share the same CPU socket
numactl --hardware | grep -E 'available|node [0-9]+ cpus|node [0-9]+ size'

# 3) Launch Intel oneAPI / vLLM-XPU OpenAI server (Xe3P / Arc Pro XPU compatible stack)
docker run --rm --device=/dev/dri -p 8000:8000 \
  -e ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0 -e VLLM_USE_V1=1 \
  intel/vllm-xpu:latest \
  --model Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 \
  --dtype bfloat16 --max-model-len 65536 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90

# 4) Measure raw NVMe -> Host RAM scan ceiling to quantify near-data RAG payoff
fio --name=rag-seq-scan --filename=/mnt/nvme-corpus/test.bin --size=8G \
  --rw=read --bs=1M --iodepth=32 --ioengine=io_uring --direct=1 --group_reporting
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: How is Intel GPU D270 different from the earlier “Crescent Island” preview? / SC26 公布的 Intel GPU D270 与此前传闻的 “Crescent Island” 有何关系？
  **A**: **Intel GPU D270** is the official product name for the Xe3P accelerator formerly codenamed **Crescent Island**. SC26 locked in its detailed spec sheet: **32 Xe3P cores, 256 XMX matrix engines, 160GB LPDDR5X at 1.5 TB/s** on Intel’s 350W air-cooled PCIe 5.0 card (scalable to **480GB** in ODM partner designs), **1.3 PFLOPS FP8**, and **full-rate FP64** for converged HPC + agentic AI workloads. (**Intel GPU D270** 就是原代号 **Crescent Island** 的正式商用定名。SC26 进一步明确了其完整工程规格：**32 个 Xe3P 核心、256 个 XMX 矩阵引擎、公版 350W 风冷 PCIe 5.0 配备 160GB LPDDR5X（1.5 TB/s 带宽）**、合作 OEM 款可扩展至 **480GB**，同时支持 **1.3 PFLOPS FP8** 与**全速 FP64** 双精度。)
- **Q**: Can Phison’s 64GB NPU-integrated SSD replace a GPU for running 70B local LLMs? / 群联这块带 64GB 内存和 NPU 的计算存储 SSD，能直接替代显卡跑 70B 本地大模型吗？
  **A**: No. Even though `64GB` onboard memory can physically hold a quantized `70B Q4_K_M` file (`~42 GB`), its **`130 GB/s`** internal bandwidth caps memory-bound decode of a dense 70B model to roughly **~2 tok/s**, and Phison’s quoted `36,800 DMIPS` reflects scalar control compute rather than GPU-grade prefill FLOPS. Its real breakthrough is **near-data RAG**: filtering, indexing, and running compact `1B–8B` rerankers/extractors directly inside storage so only tiny, high-signal snippets cross PCIe to your main GPU. (不能。尽管 `64GB` 板载内存物理上塞得下 `70B Q4_K_M`（约 `42 GB`），但 **`130 GB/s`** 带宽跑稠密 70B 的解码速度理论上限仅约 **2 tok/s**，且 `36,800 DMIPS` 是标量整数指标而非 GPU 级 Prefill 算力。它真正的杀手锏是**近数据 RAG**：在盘内运行轻量检索、向量过滤与 `1B–8B` 级重排/摘要模型，把跨 PCIe 传输的原始数据量压降 10–100 倍，再交由主力推理卡生成最终回答。)

- **Pinned Versions**: Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B-A3B · 48 Logical Passes · Apache 2.0 · NVFP4/MXFP8), Tencent WeMM-Video-35B-A3B (tencent/WeMM-Video-35BA3B · Apache 2.0 · BF16/FP8/NVFP4/GGUF), vLLM (Day-0 Looped KV + DSpark MTP Speculator) / SGLang / llama.cpp + Unsloth GGUF / MLX, Windows 11 Pro on Arm64 + WSL2 CUDA / Linux CUDA 12.8+ (Blackwell Native NVFP4)
- **Verified Date**: 2026-11-23

- **Offline Boundary**: 100% Local Offline Execution (Text, Vision, Audio & Video) — Both Inkling 2 Mini and WeMM-Video-35B-A3B ship under Apache 2.0 with ungated Hugging Face weights; once cached locally, long-context coding agents and bilingual audio-visual video analysis run fully offline with zero cloud API fees.

**Direct Summary (EN)**: Hands-on sizing and deployment guide for the mid-November 2026 retail NVIDIA RTX Spark (N1X) Windows-on-Arm mini PCs—ASUS ProArt GR1X (1.15L, 140W, dual Gen5/Gen4 M.2, $4,499–$6,999) and MSI EdgeMesa N AI+ (1.3L vapor chamber, 140W, $4,699+)—paired with two breakthrough Apache 2.0 models dropped on Nov 20, 2026: Thinking Machines Lab’s Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B-A3B Looped Transformer executing 24 physical layers as 48 logical KV passes, 1M context, native NVFP4/MXFP8 + DSpark speculator) and Tencent Hunyuan’s WeMM-Video-35B-A3B bilingual audio-visual MoE.
**核心结论 (ZH)**: 拆解 2026 年 11 月中下旬正式开售的零售级 NVIDIA RTX Spark（N1X）Windows-on-Arm 迷你主机——华硕 ProArt GR1X（1.15L、140W、双 Gen5/Gen4 M.2、$4,499–$6,999）与微星 EdgeMesa N AI+（1.3L 均热板、140W、$4,699 起）——并给出 11 月 20 日同日发布的两大 Apache 2.0 破局开源模型部署方案：Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 2 Mini（26.4B-A3B 循环 Transformer，24 层物理权重循环执行 48 逻辑 KV 层、1M 上下文、原生 NVFP4/MXFP8 + DSpark 投机解码）与腾讯混元 WeMM-Video-35B-A3B 中英双语音画全模态 MoE。

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- Looped Transformer KV cache trap on Inkling 2 Mini: although the checkpoint has only 24 physical decoder layers (~20 GB NVFP4/MXFP8), its middle 12 layers loop 3x with independent per-pass KV caches (48 logical KV layers total)—budget KV cache as a 48-layer model or you will silently OOM on 32GB machines beyond 64K–128K context.
- Retail RTX Spark OEM pricing ($4,499 base to $6,499–$6,999 for maxed 128GB ProArt GR1X) is steep vs DGX Spark GB10 Linux developer units and 192GB AMD Strix Halo boxes (~273 GB/s); Windows 11 on Arm also requires verifying native Arm64 CUDA/WSL2 wheel availability for bleeding-edge vLLM/SGLang builds.
- WeMM-Video-35B-A3B GGUF splits weights into separate language.gguf, mmproj.gguf, and audio.gguf components—standard single-file llama-cli cannot ingest joint audio+video tracks without Tencent’s multi-encoder loader or patched vLLM FP8/NVFP4 serving.
- 300 GB/s unified memory bandwidth on RTX Spark N1X excels at sparse MoE models (3B–12B active params like Inkling 2 Mini and WeMM-Video-35B-A3B) and Blackwell NVFP4 prefill, but still trails discrete RTX 5090 (1,792 GB/s) by ~5x on dense 24B–32B token generation.
- [ZH] Inkling 2 Mini 的循环层 KV 缓存陷阱：虽然物理权重仅 24 层（原生 NVFP4/MXFP8 约 20 GB），但中间 12 层循环执行 3 次且每次循环维护独立 KV 缓存（共 48 个逻辑 KV 层）——显存预算必须按 48 层计算，否则 32GB 机器拉到 64K–128K 上下文会直接 OOM。
- [ZH] 零售 RTX Spark 整机溢价较高（ProArt GR1X 起步约 $4,499，128GB 顶配达 $6,499–$6,999），对比 Linux 版 DGX Spark GB10 或 192GB Strix Halo 工作站需权衡性价比；且 Windows 11 on Arm 跑前沿 vLLM/SGLang 须核验 Arm64 原生或 WSL2 CUDA 轮子可用性。
- [ZH] WeMM-Video-35B-A3B 的 GGUF 包拆分为 language.gguf + mmproj.gguf + audio.gguf 三部分，标准单文件 llama-cli 无法直接喂入音画同步视频，需使用官方多编码器加载脚本或带 ModelOpt/Marlin 补丁的 vLLM FP8/NVFP4 服务。
- [ZH] RTX Spark N1X 的 300 GB/s 统一内存带宽非常契合激活参数仅 3B–12B 的稀疏 MoE（如 Inkling 2 Mini 与 WeMM-Video-35B-A3B）及 NVFP4 预填充，但跑稠密 24B–32B 生成速度仍落后 RTX 5090（1,792 GB/s）约 5 倍。

Every N1X system pairs a 20-core Grace CPU with a **`6,144`-CUDA-core Blackwell GPU (`1 PFLOP` FP4)** over NVLink-C2C sharing up to **`128GB` LPDDR5X at `300 GB/s`**.

Where do these `$4.5K–$7K` compact desktops actually make sense versus a Linux DGX Spark GB10, a `192GB` GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro, a `64GB` Mac mini M5 Pro, or a discrete `32GB` RTX 5090? Check the real memory-capacity vs bandwidth vs OS trade-offs below:

#### 2. Looped Transformer Math: Why Inkling 2 Mini’s 26.4B Weights Behave Like 48 Layers / 2. 循环 Transformer 显存账本：为什么 Inkling 2 Mini 的 26.4B 权重必须按 48 层算 KV？
Released under **Apache 2.0 on November 20, 2026**, Thinking Machines Lab’s **Inkling 2 Mini** introduces a major architectural shift for local hardware: instead of stacking `48–64` distinct layers that double VRAM requirements, it packs **`~26.4B` physical parameters** across **`24` physical decoder layers** (`128` experts/layer, `8` active, `~3.1B` unique weights per token), structured into three stages: **Prelude (layers `0–5`, run `1x`)** → **Loop Core (layers `6–17`, run `3x` sequentially with cross-pass gated messaging)** → **Coda (layers `18–23`, run `1x`)**. That gives every token **`48` logical layer passes** of iterative internal reasoning inside a compact **`~20 GB` mixed `NVFP4` (experts) + `MXFP8` (final layers)** checkpoint—plus a bundled **DSpark** multi-token speculator (`mtp.safetensors`) and native **1-million-token context**.

Here is the critical engineering gotcha most early adopters miss: **each of the 3 loop passes stores its own separate KV cache**. With `48` logical KV layers, `8` GQA KV heads, and `head_dim=128`, a `65,536`-token context consumes **`~12.9 GB` at FP16 KV** (or **`~6.8 GB` at `Q8_0` KV**). Add the `~20 GB` checkpoint and `~2 GB` compute buffers and a `32GB` MacBook Pro or `32GB` RTX 5090 is already tight at `64K–128K`! On a **`128GB` RTX Spark (ProArt GR1X / EdgeMesa N AI+)**, however, `~108 GB` usable unified memory easily holds Inkling 2 Mini + DSpark + **`256K–1M` context** with Blackwell native NVFP4 acceleration.
2026 年 11 月 20 日以 **Apache 2.0** 开源的 Thinking Machines Lab **Inkling 2 Mini** 为本地大模型带来了架构级革新：它没有靠线性堆叠 `48–64` 层把权重撑爆显存，而是仅用 **`24` 层物理权重（总参约 `26.4B`**，每层 `128` 选 `8` 专家，单 Token 独立激活权重约 `3.1B`）拆成三段：**前导段（`0–5` 层，执行 `1` 次）→ 循环核心段（`6–17` 层，带跨轮门控消息传递循环执行 `3` 次）→ 尾段（`18–23` 层，执行 `1` 次）**。每个 Token 实际穿过 **`48` 个逻辑层**完成深度隐式推理，但整个原生 **`NVFP4`（专家）+ `MXFP8`（末层）** 权重包仅约 **`20 GB`**，还随库附带 **DSpark** 多词投机头（`mtp.safetensors`）与原生 **100 万 Token 上下文**。

但必须警惕最容易踩坑的显存细节：**`3` 次循环的每一轮都维护独立的 KV Cache**。按 `48` 个逻辑 KV 层、`8` 个 KV 头、`head_dim=128` 核算，`65,536` 上下文在 FP16 KV 下就要吃掉 **约 `12.9 GB`**（开启 `Q8_0` KV 减半至 **约 `6.8 GB`**）；叠加 `~20 GB` 权重与计算缓冲后，`32GB` MacBook Pro 或 RTX 5090 在 `64K–128K` 就已逼近红线！而在 **`128GB` RTX Spark（ProArt GR1X / EdgeMesa N AI+）** 上，`~108 GB` 可用统一内存不仅原生吃满 Blackwell NVFP4 加速，还能轻松承载 Inkling 2 Mini + DSpark 与 **`256K–1M` 超长上下文**。

#### 3. Bilingual Audio-Visual Omni-Model: Sizing Tencent WeMM-Video-35B-A3B / 3. 中英双语音画全模态：腾讯混元 WeMM-Video-35B-A3B 量化档位与显存实算
Dropped on the exact same day (**November 20, 2026**, Apache 2.0, `tencent/WeMM-Video-35BA3B`), **WeMM-Video-35B-A3B** (alongside compact `2B`/`4B`/`9B` siblings) solves a classic local-AI gap: understanding **video frames + native soundtrack audio + speech + text simultaneously** across a **`256K` context window** using only **`3B` active parameters** out of `~35B` total (`40` layers, `2` KV heads, `head_dim=128`). Because GQA uses only `2` KV heads, its KV cache grows remarkably slowly—only `~2.7 GB` at `64K` FP16 (`~1.4 GB` at `Q8_0`), leaving almost all VRAM for weights and dense video-frame token bursts.

Choose your weight format strictly by available memory: **BF16 safetensors (`~68–72 GiB`)** runs natively on a **`128GB` RTX Spark** or `80GB+` datacenter GPU; **FP8 Block128 (`~36–39 GiB`)** fits `48GB–64GB` workstations; and **NVFP4 W4A16 (`~24.1 GiB`)** squeezes onto a **`32GB` RTX 5090** with `~6 GB` left for encoders and short-to-medium video clips. If using the GGUF bundle (`tencent/WeMM-Video-35BA3B-GGUF`), remember it separates `language.gguf`, `mmproj.gguf`, and `audio.gguf`—use Tencent’s multi-encoder loader rather than a bare single-file `llama-cli` call.
同日（**2026 年 11 月 20 日**）以 Apache 2.0 开源的腾讯混元 **WeMM-Video-35B-A3B**（同系列还有 `2B`/`4B`/`9B`）补齐了本地离线全模态的一大空白：同时喂入**视频画面、原声音轨、语音与文本**，支持 **`256K` 上下文**，总参约 `35B` 但每 Token 仅激活 **`3B`**（`40` 层、`2` 个 KV 头、`head_dim=128`）。得益于仅 `2` 个 KV 头的极简 GQA 设计，其 `64K` 上下文 FP16 KV 仅约 `2.7 GB`（`Q8_0` 仅约 `1.4 GB`），把绝大部分显存让给了权重与多帧视频视觉编码器。

量化档位按硬件对号入座：**BF16 原版（约 `68–72 GiB`）**可在 **`128GB` RTX Spark** 或 `80GB+` 服务器卡上无损直跑；**FP8 Block128（约 `36–39 GiB`）**契合 `48GB–64GB` 工作站；**NVFP4 W4A16（约 `24.1 GiB`）**正好压进 **`32GB` RTX 5090** 并留出约 `6 GB` 处理编码器与短视频上下文。若下载 GGUF 包（`tencent/WeMM-Video-35BA3B-GGUF`），务必注意它拆分为 `language.gguf`、`mmproj.gguf` 与 `audio.gguf` 三个文件，必须通过项目配套的多编码器加载脚本启动。

#### 4. Reproducible Launch Commands: vLLM DSpark Speculator, llama.cpp/MLX & WeMM-Video / 4. 可复现一键启动命令：vLLM + DSpark 投机解码、llama.cpp/MLX 与 WeMM-Video 全模态服务
Use the three validated invocation patterns below depending on whether you are running native Blackwell NVFP4 + DSpark speculative decoding on an RTX Spark / RTX 5090, GGUF/MLX on a `32GB` MacBook Pro, or WeMM-Video-35B-A3B audio-visual serving:
根据你的硬件环境（RTX Spark / RTX 5090 原生 Blackwell NVFP4 + DSpark 投机解码、`32GB` MacBook Pro 的 llama.cpp/MLX，或 WeMM-Video-35B-A3B 音视频服务），直接套用以下三组命令：
```bash
# 1) RTX Spark (WSL2 Arm64 CUDA) / RTX 5090: vLLM + Inkling 2 Mini NVFP4 + DSpark MTP Speculator
vllm serve thinking-machines/Inkling-2-Mini \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-model-len 131072 \
  --speculative-config '{"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}' \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --port 8000

# 2) 32GB MacBook Pro / Desktop GPU: llama.cpp GGUF with Q8_0 KV (critical for 48 logical loop layers!)
llama-server -m ./Inkling-2-Mini-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -ngl 99 -fa on --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 \
  -c 65536 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080

# 3) RTX Spark 128GB (FP8) or RTX 5090 32GB (NVFP4): Tencent WeMM-Video-35B-A3B via vLLM
vllm serve tencent/WeMM-Video-35BA3B-NVFP4 \
  --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-model-len 65536 --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"video": 2, "audio": 2}' \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 --port 8001
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: Why does a 128GB ASUS ProArt GR1X cost ~$6,500–$7,000 when a 192GB AMD Strix Halo mini PC is around $3,000–$3,600? / 为什么 128GB 华硕 ProArt GR1X 卖到 $6,500–$7,000，比 192GB AMD Strix Halo 迷你主机贵近一倍？
  **A**: You are paying a steep premium for **NVIDIA Blackwell CUDA + native 1 PFLOP FP4 Tensor Cores** inside a `1.15L` silent Windows desktop. On models distributed in native **NVFP4** (like Inkling 2 Mini, WeMM-Video-35B-A3B-NVFP4, and Nemotron 3.5), Blackwell’s FP4 Tensor Cores crush RDNA 3.5 on prompt **prefill latency (TTFT)** and deliver Day-0 vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT-LLM compatibility. However, if your top priority is raw memory capacity per dollar (`160GB` VRAM ceiling + x86_64 Linux compatibility) and you mostly run `GGUF Q4/Q8`, a 192GB Strix Halo workstation (like GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro) delivers dramatically better value. (高溢价主要来自 `1.15L` 静音 Windows 桌面形态下的 **NVIDIA Blackwell CUDA 与原生 1 PFLOP FP4 Tensor Core**。面对原生 **NVFP4** 发布的模型（如 Inkling 2 Mini、WeMM-Video-35B-A3B-NVFP4、Nemotron 3.5），Blackwell 在长上下文 **Prefill 首字延迟（TTFT）** 与 vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT-LLM 首日支持上大幅领先 RDNA 3.5；但如果你更看重每美元显存容量（`160GB` 可用显存 + 原生 x86_64 Linux）且主要跑 `GGUF Q4/Q8`，192GB Strix Halo 工作站（如 GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro）性价比高得多。)
- **Q**: Does looping middle layers 3 times make Inkling 2 Mini 3x slower than a normal 26B-A3B MoE? / 把中间 12 层循环执行 3 次，会让 Inkling 2 Mini 比普通 26B-A3B MoE 慢 3 倍吗？
  **A**: Not 3x slower—roughly **~1.7x–2.0x** more weight reads per token (`~5.4B` effective active reads vs `~3.1B` unique weights, since the 6 prelude + 6 coda layers only run once while the 12 middle layers run 3x). In exchange, Thinking Machines Lab pairs the looped core with the bundled **DSpark** multi-token speculator, which recovers much of that decode throughput while delivering deeper internal reasoning without burning thousands of visible chain-of-thought tokens. (不会慢 3 倍——前导 6 层与尾段 6 层只执行 1 次，仅中间 12 层循环 3 次，因此每 Token 等效读取权重约 `5.4B`（相对 `3.1B` 独立激活权重约增加 **1.7–2.0 倍**内存带宽开销）。作为补偿，官方随模型内置了 **DSpark** 多词投机头，在拉回吐字速度的同时，用隐式循环深度替代冗长的显式思维链输出，综合端到端完成任务反而更快。)

## SC26 Optical, CXL & NVMe-oF KV Cache Pooling vs Deskside GB300 Towers: Penguin MemoryAI Photonic (576GB HBM3E + 16TB DDR5), SK hynix MARS CMM-DDR5 & AIC F2026 26-Bay Gen5 JBOF vs MSI WS300 / GIGABYTE W775-V10 Running Inkling 2 Small (594B-A17B)

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- Spec-derived engineering analysis: Penguin MemoryAI Photonic Appliance, SK hynix MARS CXL KV pools, AIC F2026 JBOF, and OEM GB300 towers (MSI WS300 / GIGABYTE W775-V10-L01) were showcased at SC26 (Nov 15–20, 2026); performance figures reflect vendor SC26 technical disclosures and memory-bandwidth modeling.
- On MSI XpertStation WS300 / GIGABYTE W775-V10-L01 (748GB total = 252GB HBM3e @ 7.1 TB/s + 496GB LPDDR5X ECC @ 396 GB/s), a 594B model like Inkling 2 Small (~320 GB in NVFP4 or ~352 GB in Q4_K_M) exceeds the 252GB HBM3e pool—active router/attention layers must stay pinned in HBM3e while cold routed experts spill over the 900 GB/s NVLink-C2C bus into Grace LPDDR5X.
- Penguin Solutions’ MemoryAI Photonic Appliance relies on Marvell Photonic Fabric (Celestial AI silicon photonics) PF-NICs with PCIe 6.0 / CXL 3.1 host interfaces, making it an enterprise multi-rack appliance rather than a drop-in card for legacy PCIe 4.0/5.0 HomeLab motherboards.
- Offloading KV caches to AIC F2026 26-bay PCIe Gen5 JBOF over NVMe-oF saves multi-turn recomputation FLOPS, but network transport still requires 200GbE/400GbE RDMA (RoCEv2 / DPU offload) to avoid saturating host CPU interrupts during bursty 128K–1M context recalls.
- [ZH] 本文为基于 SC26（2026 年 11 月 15–20 日）厂商公开规格与技术白皮书的工程推算：Penguin MemoryAI 硅光内存盒、SK hynix MARS、AIC F2026 JBOF 与微星/技嘉 GB300 量产整机均属企业级新品，相关吞吐数据带 `[Spec-Est.]` 标注。
- [ZH] 在微星 XpertStation WS300 / 技嘉 W775-V10-L01（总相干内存 748GB = 252GB HBM3e @ 7.1 TB/s + 496GB LPDDR5X ECC @ 396 GB/s）上运行 594B 的 Inkling 2 Small（NVFP4 约 320 GB，Q4_K_M 约 352 GB）时，总权重超过 252GB HBM3e 容量上限——必须将高频共享层与 KV 缓存锁在 HBM3e，让低频路由专家通过 900 GB/s NVLink-C2C 驻留于 Grace LPDDR5X。
- [ZH] Penguin MemoryAI 硅光内存盒依赖 Marvell Photonic Fabric（源自 Celestial AI 硅光技术）的 PCIe 6.0 / CXL 3.1 PF-NIC 光互联网卡，面向多机柜数据中心内存池化，无法直接插在普通 PCIe 4.0/5.0 消费级主板上使用。
- [ZH] 使用 AIC F2026（26 盘位 PCIe Gen5 JBOF）通过 NVMe-oF 卸载海量多轮 KV 缓存时，宿主机侧必须配备 200GbE/400GbE RoCEv2 RDMA 或 DPU 硬件卸载，否则百万上下文并发召回会瞬间打满宿主机 CPU 中断。

#### 1. SC26 Memory-Tier Spectrum: Optical HBM/DDR5 Pooling vs CXL CMM-DDR5 vs Gen5 JBOF vs Deskside GB300 / 1. SC26 四级内存破壁矩阵：硅光 HBM/DDR5 内存池、SK hynix CXL、AIC Gen5 全闪 JBOF 与桌边 GB300 超算
When serving frontier sparse MoE models (`500B–1T` parameters) alongside persistent multi-turn agentic KV caches (`128K–1M` tokens across dozens of concurrent sessions), standard `80GB–192GB` HBM GPUs hit a brutal wall: **evicting and recomputing a 256K-token prompt takes 60–90 seconds of pure prefill compute**, while buying extra HBM GPUs just to park idle KV tensors ruins cluster TCO. At **SC26 in Chicago (Nov 15–20, 2026)**, hardware vendors attacked this bottleneck across four distinct tiers—from **optical HBM3E+DDR5 appliances** down to **quiet 45 dBA deskside GB300 towers**.

Compare the four SC26 hardware tiers below on memory hierarchy, aggregate bandwidth, interconnect latency, and multi-turn KV recovery speed (`[Spec-Est.]` denotes vendor-spec derived projections):
在运行 `500B–1T` 级超大稀疏 MoE 模型并同时维持数十路 `128K–1M` 长上下文多轮 Agent 会话时，传统 `80GB–192GB` 显存的 GPU 会遭遇残酷的「KV 缓存驱逐惩罚」：**一旦多轮历史 KV 因显存不足被踢出，下一轮对话重新做 256K 上下文 Prefill 往往要傻等 60–90 秒**；而单纯为了存静态权重与闲置 KV 去堆砌昂贵的 HBM GPU 又会让成本失控。在 **2026 年 11 月芝加哥 SC26 大会** 上，业界给出了从**跨机柜硅光内存盒**到**办公室 45 分贝静音 GB300 塔式工作站**的四级破局方案。

#### 2. Optical vs CXL vs NVMe-oF KV Tiering: Penguin Photonic Fabric, SK hynix MARS & AIC F2026 / 2. 硅光 vs CXL vs NVMe-oF 三层远程 KV 池化拆解：Penguin、SK hynix 与 AIC F2026
Why did SC26 feature three seemingly competing memory-expansion fabrics at once? Because each targets a different **latency-vs-capacity knee** in the LLM KV cache lifecycle:

1. **Optical HBM3E + DDR5 Disaggregation (Penguin MemoryAI Photonic Appliance)**: Built on **Marvell Photonic Fabric** (originating from Celestial AI silicon photonics), Penguin’s appliance connects to host servers via **PF-NICs supporting PCIe 6.0 and CXL 3.1** over optical fibers instead of copper. Each appliance pools **`576GB` of HBM3E** (acting as a high-speed remote cache tier) backed by **`16TB` of DDR5** at an aggregate optical bandwidth of **`57.6 Tbps` (`7.2 TB/s`)**. Unlike copper CXL cables that degrade past a single chassis, silicon photonics lets multiple racks share a unified memory pool with near-local memory bandwidth.
2. **CXL Computational & Hybrid Memory (SK hynix MARS)**: For single-rack and 2U server deployments (like AIC’s dual-Xeon 6 `SB201-SU`), SK hynix’s **Memory-centric AI Rack System (MARS)** pairs 2nd-generation **`256GB` CMM-DDR5 modules (`80 GB/s` per module, double Gen1 bandwidth)** with **CXL Hybrid Memory (DRAM + NAND flash on a CXL bus)**. Predictive prefetching promotes active conversation turns from flash into CMM-DDR5 before the GPU requests them—slashing multi-turn **Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) by over 80% (`~80s` recomputation down to `~15s` CXL fetch)** in SK hynix + Intel SC26 validations, while embedded near-memory compute handles lightweight token filtering inside the pool.
3. **DPU-Accelerated PCIe Gen5 JBOF (AIC F2026 & HA2026-HC)**: When retaining weeks of agent context across a cluster, DRAM remains too expensive per terabyte. AIC’s 2U **F2026 JBOF** packs **`26` hot-swap dual-port PCIe Gen5 NVMe bays** and up to **four DPUs** (powering turn-key appliances like MangoBoost’s *Mango KESAR-E*), streaming KV chunks directly into GPU memory over **NVMe-oF / GPUDirect Storage** without taxing host CPUs.
为什么 SC26 会同时涌现硅光、CXL 与 NVMe-oF 三种看似重叠的扩展方案？因为它们分别卡位了大模型 KV 缓存在生命周期中完全不同的**「延迟-容量-每 TB 成本」拐点**：

1. **硅光 HBM3E + DDR5 远程内存池（Penguin MemoryAI Photonic Appliance）**：基于 **Marvell Photonic Fabric**（收购自 Celestial AI 的硅光互联技术），通过支持 **PCIe 6.0 与 CXL 3.1 的硅光网卡（PF-NIC）** 以光纤替代铜缆。单台设备内部整合 **`576GB` HBM3E 高速缓存层**与 **`16TB` DDR5 容量层**，聚合光带宽高达 **`57.6 Tbps`（`7.2 TB/s`）**。它打破了传统铜缆 CXL 无法跨机柜的距离枷锁，让多机柜 GPU 共享准 HBM 级远程内存池。
2. **机柜级 CXL 混合内存与计算内存池（SK hynix MARS）**：面向单机柜与标准 2U 服务器（如 AIC 双路至强 6 `SB201-SU`），SK hynix **MARS（以内存为中心的 AI 机柜系统）** 采用第二代 **`256GB` CMM-DDR5 模组（单模组带宽翻倍至 `80 GB/s`）** 配合 **CXL 混合内存（DRAM + 闪存同挂 CXL 总线）**。通过预测算法提前将即将复用的历史会话从闪存预热至 CMM-DDR5，SK hynix 与 Intel 在 SC26 联合验证中将多轮对话 **首字延迟（TTFT）大幅压降 80% 以上（从重算所需的约 `80 秒` 降至约 `15 秒`）**，并支持在内存池内完成轻量级预处理。
3. **DPU 硬件卸载的 26 盘位 PCIe Gen5 JBOF（AIC F2026 / HA2026-HC）**：当企业需要将多轮 Agent 状态跨天甚至跨周持久化时，DRAM 的每 TB 成本依然过高。AIC **F2026** 在 2U 空间内塞入 **`26` 块热插拔双端口 PCIe Gen5 NVMe** 并支持内置 **4 颗 DPU**（已被 MangoBoost 选为 *Mango KESAR-E* 上下文缓存柜底座），通过 **NVMe-oF 与 GPUDirect Storage** 将全闪 KV 块直传 GPU，彻底解放宿主机 CPU。

#### 3. OEM Deskside GB300 Towers (MSI XpertStation WS300 & GIGABYTE W775-V10-L01) + Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Small (594B-A17B) / 3. 桌边静音塔式超算（微星 WS300 / 技嘉 W775-V10-L01）单机跑通 Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Small (594B-A17B)
What if your security policy forbids data-center racks altogether and demands a **single air-gapped box under an engineer’s desk**? At SC26, **MSI (`XpertStation WS300`)** and **GIGABYTE (`W775-V10-L01`)** unveiled production OEM tower workstations built on the **NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip**. Check the engineering details that distinguish these retail/enterprise OEM towers from early reference briefs:

- **Coherent Memory & 20 PFLOPS FP4**: `252GB` HBM3e (`7.1 TB/s`) + up to `496GB` LPDDR5X ECC (`396 GB/s`) = **`748GB` coherent memory** unified by a **`900 GB/s` NVLink-C2C** link between the 72-core Grace CPU and Blackwell Ultra GPU.
- **ConnectX-8 800GbE + Dual PCIe Gen6 x4 M.2 Scratch Bays**: Beyond two Grace-attached PCIe Gen5 x4 M.2 boot drives (RAID 1), both boards wire **two M.2 2280 PCIe Gen6 x4 slots directly to the onboard NVIDIA ConnectX-8 SuperNIC (dual `400Gb/s` QSFP112 = `800Gb/s`)**—creating an ultra-low-latency local NVMe scratch tier for LMCache KV offloading or RDMA cluster staging.
- **Office-Friendly 1600W & 44–46 dBA Acoustics**: A full-coverage closed-loop liquid cold plate (cooling CPU, GPU, LPDDR5X, and ConnectX-8) keeps full-load noise around **`44–46 dBA`** off a single `1600W` 80 PLUS Platinum PSU, managed via an **ASPEED AST2600 BMC** (IPMI 2.0 / Redfish).

That `748GB` coherent ceiling is a textbook match for **Thinking Machines Lab’s `Inkling 2 Small` (`594B` total / `17B` active parameters, released Nov 2026)**—the big sibling to `Inkling 2 Mini`. Routing each token to **`8 of 384` experts** across a **48-layer hybrid local/global attention** backbone with native multimodal vision and a **`1M`-token context window**, `Inkling 2 Small` weighs **`~320 GB` in native `NVFP4`** (or `~352 GB` in `Q4_K_M`, `~615 GB` in `MXFP8`). On a single MSI WS300 or GIGABYTE W775-V10, the entire `NVFP4` or `MXFP8` checkpoint fits in one box with **`130GB–400GB` of headroom left over for 256K–1M KV caches**; and because only **`17B` parameters activate per token**, coherent HBM3e + NVLink-C2C sustains roughly **`38–58 tok/s` `[Spec-Est.]`** without multi-node tensor parallelism.
如果团队处于高敏研发环境、根本没有液冷数据中心机房，只想在**办公室工位旁放一台单相插座就能跑 500B–1T 大模型的物理隔离主机**呢？在 SC26 上，**微星（`XpertStation WS300`）**与**技嘉（`W775-V10-L01`）**正式展出了基于 **NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip** 的量产级塔式工作站，其工程细节极具亮点：

- **748GB 硬件相干内存 + 20 PFLOPS FP4 算力**：`252GB` HBM3e（`7.1 TB/s`）与最高 `496GB` LPDDR5X ECC（`396 GB/s`）通过 **`900 GB/s` NVLink-C2C** 与 72 核 Grace CPU 紧耦合，形成 **`748GB` 统一寻址空间**。
- **ConnectX-8 双 400GbE + 直连双路 PCIe Gen6 x4 M.2 暂存盘**：除直连 Grace CPU 的 2 个 PCIe Gen5 x4 M.2 系统盘（支持 RAID 1）外，主板还将 **2 个 M.2 2280 PCIe Gen6 x4 插槽直接挂在板载 NVIDIA ConnectX-8 SuperNIC（双口 `400Gb/s` QSFP112，聚合 `800Gb/s`）** 下——专为本地极速 LMCache KV 缓存落盘与跨机 RDMA 数据暂存而生。
- **单 1600W 办公电源与 44–46 dBA 静音水冷**：定制全覆盖闭环水冷头同时覆盖 CPU、GPU、内存与 ConnectX-8 网卡，满载噪音控制在 **`44–46 dBA`**，自带 **ASPEED AST2600 BMC**（支持 IPMI 2.0 / Redfish 远程带外管理）。

这套 `748GB` 桌边塔式超算恰好完美承接 **Thinking Machines Lab 于 2026 年 11 月发布的 `Inkling 2 Small`（总参数 `594B` / 每 Token 仅激活 `17B`）**。作为 `Inkling 2 Mini` 的主力大哥，`Inkling 2 Small` 采用 **48 层混合局部/全局注意力 + `384 选 8` 稀疏专家路由**，原生支持图文多模态与 **`1M` 百万上下文**。在原生 **`NVFP4`** 下其权重约 **`320 GB`**（`Q4_K_M` 约 `352 GB`，原生 `MXFP8` 约 `615 GB`）：单台微星 WS300 或技嘉 W775-V10 即可在单机内装下完整模型，并留出 **`130GB–400GB` 余量容纳 256K–1M 长上下文 KV 缓存**；由于每 Token 仅需读取 **`17B` 激活参数**，依托 HBM3e + 900 GB/s NVLink-C2C 预计可达 **`38–58 tok/s` `[Spec-Est.]`**，彻底省去多机分布式切分的运维噩梦。

#### 4. Reproducible Deployment: GB300 Deskside NVFP4 Serving & LMCache CXL / Gen6 NVMe KV Tiering / 4. 可复现部署演练：桌边 GB300 原生 NVFP4 启动 Inkling 2 Small 与 LMCache CXL / Gen6 NVMe 多级 KV 卸载
Use the commands below on an MSI XpertStation WS300 / GIGABYTE W775-V10-L01 or a CXL/NVMe-oF server to audit NUMA/CXL memory tiers, verify ConnectX-8 400GbE and Gen6 M.2 scratch mounts, and launch **Thinking Machines `Inkling 2 Small` (`594B-A17B`)** with vLLM + LMCache multi-tier KV pooling:
在微星 XpertStation WS300 / 技嘉 W775-V10-L01 或配备 CXL 内存池 / NVMe-oF 的服务器上，可执行以下命令核查 HBM3e + LPDDR5X / CXL 内存拓扑、ConnectX-8 网卡与 Gen6 M.2 挂载状态，并拉起 **Thinking Machines `Inkling 2 Small` (`594B-A17B`)** 的 vLLM NVFP4 服务或 LMCache 多级 KV 缓存池：
```bash
# 1) Audit HBM3e + Grace LPDDR5X / CXL NUMA nodes, ConnectX-8 400GbE & Gen6/Gen5 NVMe links
numactl --hardware | grep -E 'available|node [0-9]+ size|node distances'
lspci -vv 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'CXL|ConnectX-8|Non-Volatile|LnkSta:' | head -n 20

# 2) Serve Inkling 2 Small (594B-A17B, ~320GB NVFP4) on single 748GB MSI WS300 / GIGABYTE W775-V10
vllm serve thinking-machines/Inkling-2-Small-NVFP4 \
  --quantization nvfp4 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-model-len 262144 --enable-prefix-caching \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --port 8000

# 3) Enable 3-Tier LMCache KV Offloading (GPU HBM3e -> CXL / Host DRAM -> Gen6 M.2 / AIC NVMe-oF)
export LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_CPU_SIZE="256.0"
export LMCACHE_LOCAL_DISK="file:///mnt/gen6-kv-scratch/"
export LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_DISK_SIZE="2048.0"
vllm serve thinking-machines/Inkling-2-Small-NVFP4 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 524288 \
  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"LMCacheConnectorV1","kv_role":"kv_both"}' \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 --port 8000
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: How does Penguin Solutions’ MemoryAI Photonic Appliance differ from standard CXL 2.0 memory expanders like Micron CZ120 or SK hynix CMM-DDR5? / Penguin Solutions 在 SC26 展示的 MemoryAI 硅光内存盒与普通 CXL 2.0 内存扩展卡（如美光 CZ120、SK hynix CMM-DDR5）有什么本质区别？
  **A**: Standard **CXL 2.0 E3.S expanders** (like Micron CZ120 or SK hynix `256GB` CMM-DDR5 at `80 GB/s`) plug into PCIe/CXL copper slots inside a single server or tray to add `512GB–2TB` of DRAM locally. **Penguin’s MemoryAI Photonic Appliance** uses **Marvell Photonic Fabric (silicon photonics)** over optical fibers via **PCIe 6.0 / CXL 3.1 PF-NICs** and embeds **`576GB` of HBM3E** in front of **`16TB` of DDR5** at **`57.6 Tbps` (`7.2 TB/s`)** aggregate bandwidth—allowing accelerators across *multiple racks* to share an HBM-tiered remote memory pool over meters of fiber without copper signal loss. (标准 **CXL 2.0 E3.S 扩展模组**（如美光 CZ120 或单条 `80 GB/s` 的 SK hynix `256GB` CMM-DDR5）通过铜线插在单台服务器内部，主要为单机或单托盘补充 `512GB–2TB` 内存；而 **Penguin MemoryAI 硅光内存盒**基于 **Marvell Photonic Fabric 硅光互联技术**，通过 **PCIe 6.0 / CXL 3.1 光网卡（PF-NIC）** 走光纤传输，且设备内部自带 **`576GB` HBM3E 高速缓存层 + `16TB` DDR5 容量层**（聚合光带宽达 **`57.6 Tbps` / `7.2 TB/s`**），能够跨多个机柜实现准 HBM 级远程内存共享。)
- **Q**: Can a single MSI XpertStation WS300 or GIGABYTE W775-V10-L01 really run the 594B Inkling 2 Small off a normal office wall outlet? / 单台微星 XpertStation WS300 或技嘉 W775-V10-L01 真的靠普通办公室插座就能流畅跑 594B 的 Inkling 2 Small 吗？
  **A**: Yes. Both deskside GB300 towers use a single **`1600W` 80 PLUS Platinum PSU** (`44–46 dBA` closed-loop liquid cooling) and expose **`748GB` of coherent memory** (`252GB` HBM3e + `496GB` LPDDR5X). Because **Inkling 2 Small (`594B-A17B`)** compresses to **`~320 GB` in native `NVFP4`** (or `~352 GB` in `Q4_K_M`) and activates only **`17B` parameters (`8 of 384` experts) per token**, the entire checkpoint loads inside one tower with over `350 GB` free for long-context KV cache, delivering smooth interactive agent speeds without data-center 3-phase power. (完全可以。这两款量产 GB300 塔式工作站均采用单颗 **`1600W` 80 PLUS 白金电源**与 **`44–46 dBA` 闭环水冷**，提供 **`748GB` 硬件相干内存**（`252GB` HBM3e + `496GB` LPDDR5X）。由于 **Inkling 2 Small（`594B-A17B`）** 在原生 **`NVFP4`** 下权重仅约 **`320 GB`**（`Q4_K_M` 约 `352 GB`），且每生成一个 Token 仅激活 **`17B` 参数（384 选 8 专家）**，单台主机无需机房三相电即可全量装入模型并留出逾 `350 GB` 空间给长上下文 KV 缓存。)

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- Spec-derived engineering analysis: Tencent Hy4-Flash (Nov 17, 2026) and Ant Group LingSante-3.1-air-VL / LingSante-3.1-flash (Nov 24, 2026) are brand-new late-November 2026 releases; throughput ranges reflect active-parameter bandwidth modeling and vendor technical reports.
- Hy4-Flash’s ~224B total checkpoint includes a ~64B Engram n-gram lookup table alongside the routed MoE backbone—if you load all 224B in Q4_K_M (~131 GB) flat into a 128GB device, it will OOM; use llama.cpp -ot "engram\..*=CPU" to pin the sparse hash lookup tables in system DDR5 while keeping the 12B active transformer/LatentMoE weights in GPU VRAM.
- To achieve Tencent’s 150+ tok/s decode benchmark on Hy4-Flash, you must load the companion 0.85B 5-layer DFly2 speculative drafter (trained with AngelSpec to reuse the main model’s sparse KV indices) and pass --reasoning-parser hy_v4 in vLLM.
- Ant Group LingSante-3.1-air-VL and LingSante-3.1-flash are strictly open-source medical research prototypes (powering scenarios behind Ant’s Afu health assistant)—any hospital or clinic pilot must keep a human clinician in the loop and enforce HIPAA/PIPL air-gapped logging.
- [ZH] 本文为基于腾讯混元 Hy4-Flash（2026 年 11 月 17 日发布）与蚂蚁集团 LingSante-3.1 系列（2026 年 11 月 24 日发布）官方技术报告与激活参数带宽模型的工程推算，性能区间标注 `[Spec-Est.]`。
- [ZH] Hy4-Flash 的 ~224B 总参数中包含约 64B 的 Engram 多头哈希 N-Gram 静态记忆表——若在 128GB 设备上无差别全量加载 224B Q4_K_M（约 131 GB）会直接爆显存；本地部署应利用 llama.cpp 的 `-ot "engram\..*=CPU"` 将仅做 O(1) 哈希查表的 64B Engram 留在系统 DDR5 内存，仅把高频计算层与 LatentMoE 放进显存。
- [ZH] 若要在服务端复现 Hy4-Flash 超过 150+ tok/s 的吐字速度，必须在 vLLM/SGLang 中同时挂载随模型发布的 0.85B 5 层 DFly2 投机草稿头（复用主模型稀疏 KV 索引）并启用 `--reasoning-parser hy_v4`。

#### 1. Architecture & Memory Matrix: Hy4-Flash (224B-A12B) vs LingSante-3.1-air-VL (124B-A5.5B) vs LingSante-3.1-flash (560B-A25B) / 1. 架构与显存账本横评：混元 Hy4-Flash (224B-A12B) 对决蚂蚁 LingSante-3.1-air-VL (124B-A5.5B) 与 Flash (560B-A25B)
Late November 2026 cemented a major shift in open-weight multimodal LLM design: **decoupling knowledge capacity from per-token active FLOPS and KV cache growth**. On **November 17, 2026**, Tencent Hunyuan released **`Hy4-Flash` (`~224B` total / `12B` active)** alongside **`AngelSlim`** FP8 and GGUF toolchains; one week later on **November 24, 2026**, Ant Group open-sourced its **MIT-licensed `LingSante-3.1` medical family** (`inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL` at **`124B` total / `5.5B` active** and `inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-flash` at **`560B` total / `25B` active**).

Look at how these three models compare on total vs active parameters, quantized weight footprints, long-context KV cache scaling, and minimum local hardware tiers (`[Spec-Est.]` marks spec-derived throughput projections):
2026 年 11 月中下旬的两场重量级开源发布，将「**百亿/千亿级知识总容量与极低单 Token 激活开销解耦**」推向了新高度：**11 月 17 日**，腾讯混元发布 **`Hy4-Flash`（总参约 `224B` / 激活仅 `12B`）** 及配套 **`AngelSlim`** 压缩工具链；**11 月 24 日**，蚂蚁集团在 Hugging Face（`inclusionAI`）以 **MIT 协议**开源了支撑「阿福（Afu）」健康应用的 **`LingSante-3.1` 医疗大模型双星**——轻量全模态 **`LingSante-3.1-air-VL`（总参 `124B` / 激活仅 `5.5B`）** 与深度循证旗舰 **`LingSante-3.1-flash`（总参 `560B` / 激活 `25B`）**。

#### 2. Inside Tencent Hy4-Flash: 64B Engram Hash Tables, LatentMoE (3072->1536), 1/6 KV Cache & DFly2 Speculator / 2. 深度拆解腾讯混元 Hy4-Flash：64B Engram 哈希记忆表、LatentMoE 降维、1/6 KV 缓存与 DFly2 投机头
Why does a `224B`-parameter model like **Tencent Hunyuan `Hy4-Flash`** run with the memory-bandwidth agility of a `12B` model while holding `1M` tokens of context? Four engineering mechanisms work together:

1. **`~64B` Engram N-Gram Hash Memory (Inserted at Layers 1, 11, 21, and 31)**: Instead of forcing every factual lookup through dense FFN matrix multiplications, `Hy4-Flash` stores `~64B` parameters in external **learned bigram/trigram multi-head hash tables** at layers 1, 11, 21, and 31. Because an Engram lookup is an $O(1)$ index gather rather than a dense GEMM, **local `llama.cpp` users (`AngelSlim/Hy4-flash-GGUF`) can pin the `~38 GB` (`Q4_K_M`) Engram tensors in system DDR5 RAM (`-ot "engram\..*=CPU"`) with almost zero latency penalty**, shrinking the GPU VRAM requirement from `~131 GB` down to **`~93 GB`**!
2. **LatentMoE (`3,072 -> 1,536` Latent Projection)**: Before routing tokens to **`16 routed experts + 1 shared expert`**, `Hy4-Flash` projects hidden states from `3,072` dimensions down to a `1,536`-dimensional latent bottleneck. This cuts expert weight reads and multi-GPU all-to-all traffic in half while preserving fine-grained 17-expert combinatorics.
3. **1:3 Hybrid Sparse & Sliding-Window Attention (`512`-Token SWA)**: Three out of every four layers use a tight `512`-token sliding window while every fourth layer performs indexed sparse attention across the `1M` context—shrinking the KV cache footprint to **1/6th of Hy4 and 1/24th of Hy3**.
4. **`0.85B` DFly2 Speculative Drafter + `AngelSlim`**: Trained with Tencent’s *AngelSpec* toolkit, the 5-layer `0.85B` **DFly2** drafter shares the main model’s sparse KV indices to draft multiple tokens in parallel, pushing vLLM/SGLang 4-bit/FP8 throughput past **`150+ tok/s`**.
为什么总参数高达 `224B` 的 **腾讯混元 `Hy4-Flash`** 能够拥有 `12B` 小模型的吐字敏捷度，同时轻松撑起 `1M` 百万上下文？核心在于四项环环相扣的架构创新：

1. **外挂 `~64B` Engram 多头哈希 N-Gram 记忆表（插入第 1、11、21、31 层）**：`Hy4-Flash` 没有把所有长尾百科知识都塞进需要全量乘加的 FFN 专家层，而是将约 `64B` 参数做成基于二元/三元词组的多头哈希查找表，仅在第 1、11、21、31 层按索引做 $O(1)$ 查表。这对本地玩家意味着一个神级技巧：**使用 `AngelSlim/Hy4-flash-GGUF` 配合 `llama.cpp` 时，可通过 `-ot "engram\..*=CPU"` 将约 `38 GB`（`Q4_K_M`）的 Engram 静态哈希表直接锁在宿主机 DDR5 内存里，几乎不损失解码速度**，从而把 GPU 显存需求从 `131 GB` 一举压到 **`93 GB` 左右**（单张 `96GB` RTX PRO 6000 或 `128GB` 统一内存主机即可吃下）！
2. **LatentMoE 潜在空间降维路由（`3,072 -> 1,536` 维）**：在把 Token 分发给 **`16 个路由专家 + 1 个共享专家`** 之前，先将隐藏层维度从 `3,072` 压缩至 `1,536` 维潜在空间，使多卡 All-to-All 通信量与专家访存带宽直接减半。
3. **1:3 稀疏注意力与 `512` 窗口滑动注意力（SWA）交织**：每 4 层中有 3 层仅维护 `512` Token 的局部滑动窗口，仅 1 层执行全局稀疏索引注意力，将长上下文 KV 缓存体积暴砍至 **Hy4 的 1/6、Hy3 的 1/24**。
4. **`0.85B` DFly2 投机解码草稿头 + `AngelSlim` 工具链**：基于 *AngelSpec* 训练的 5 层 `0.85B` **DFly2** 投机头直接复用主模型的稀疏 KV 索引并行起草多个 Token，在 vLLM/SGLang 下配合 4-bit/FP8 算子可突破 **`150+ tok/s`**。

#### 3. Ant Group LingSante-3.1-air-VL (124B-A5.5B) & Flash (560B-A25B): Air-Gapped MIT Medical AI on Local Workstations / 3. 蚂蚁开源医疗大模型 LingSante-3.1-air-VL (124B-A5.5B) 与 Flash (560B-A25B)：96GB–128GB 本地全离线部署
Healthcare is the single most privacy-sensitive domain for AI: hospital radiology departments, dermatology clinics, and clinical research teams cannot upload raw patient X-rays or electronic health records (PHI) to third-party cloud APIs. On **November 24, 2026**, Ant Group’s healthcare team released **`LingSante-3.1-air-VL`** and **`LingSante-3.1-flash`** on Hugging Face (`inclusionAI`) under a permissive **MIT License**.

- **`LingSante-3.1-air-VL` (`124B` total / `5.5B` active · `256K` context)**: Built atop *Ling-3.0-flash-VL*, this multimodal MoE ingests **text, high-resolution medical images, and video**. It is trained for chest X-ray multi-finding reporting (pneumonia, pleural effusion, cardiomegaly), dermatological triage across **120+ skin conditions**, lab report & nutritional analysis, and **medical GUI agent automation**. Because only **`5.5B` parameters activate per token** and its `Q4_K_M` checkpoint is **`~72.6 GB`**, a single **`96GB` RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell** (`95–135 tok/s`), **`128GB` MacBook Pro M5 Max / RTX Spark** (`48–75 tok/s`), or **`192GB` GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro** runs it 100% offline with ample headroom for `64K–128K` multimodal context.
- **`LingSante-3.1-flash` (`560B` total / `25B` active · `1M` context)**: Engineered for deep evidence-based clinical reasoning, multi-guideline cross-referencing, and resolving conflicting clinical evidence across up to **1 million tokens** of medical literature and longitudinal patient histories. At `~328 GB` (`Q4_K_M`), it slots cleanly into a single **`512GB` Mac Studio M5 Ultra** or **`748GB` MSI XpertStation WS300 / GIGABYTE W775-V10 GB300 tower**.
医疗健康是对数据隐私与物理隔离要求最严苛的行业：医院影像科、皮肤科门诊与临床科研团队绝不可能将患者原始胸片（DICOM/X-ray）或电子病历（PHI）上传至外部公有云 API。**2026 年 11 月 24 日**，蚂蚁集团医疗 AI 团队在 Hugging Face（`inclusionAI`）以极其宽松的 **MIT 开源协议**发布了 **`LingSante-3.1-air-VL`** 与 **`LingSante-3.1-flash`**：

- **`LingSante-3.1-air-VL`（总参 `124B` / 每 Token 仅激活 `5.5B` · `256K` 上下文）**：基于 *Ling-3.0-flash-VL* 打造的原有多模态 MoE，同时支持**文本、高分辨率医学图像与视频**输入，覆盖胸部 X 光多病灶辅助读片（肺炎、胸腔积液等）、**120 余种皮肤病视觉识别**、检验单解读、膳食营养评估及**医疗系统 GUI Agent 自动化操作**。由于其 **`Q4_K_M` 权重仅约 `72.6 GB`** 且每 Token 仅激活 **`5.5B` 参数**，单张 **`96GB` RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell**（`95–135 tok/s`）、**`128GB` MacBook Pro M5 Max / RTX Spark**（`48–75 tok/s`）或 **`192GB` 极摩客 EVO-X5 Pro** 即可在科室本地 100% 断网流畅运行。
- **`LingSante-3.1-flash`（总参 `560B` / 激活 `25B` · `1M` 百万上下文）**：专攻复杂临床循证推理、跨科室指南冲突核验与长周期病历深度综合分析。其 `Q4_K_M` 权重约 `328 GB`，单台 **`512GB` Mac Studio M5 Ultra** 或 **`748GB` 微星 WS300 / 技嘉 W775-V10 GB300 塔式工作站**即可全量驻留内存。

#### 4. Reproducible Local Launchers: vLLM Hy4-Flash + DFly2, llama.cpp Engram CPU Offload & Air-Gapped LingSante-3.1-air-VL / 4. 可复现本地部署命令：vLLM Hy4-Flash + DFly2 投机加速、llama.cpp Engram 内存卸载与 LingSante-3.1 全离线启动
Run the commands below to serve **Tencent `Hy4-Flash`** either via official vLLM FP8 + `DFly2` speculative decoding or via `llama.cpp` (`AngelSlim/Hy4-flash-GGUF`) with `-ot "engram\..*=CPU"` to fit `96GB–128GB` machines, or launch **Ant Group’s `LingSante-3.1-air-VL` (`124B-A5.5B`)** in strict air-gapped mode (`HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`):
使用以下命令即可通过官方 vLLM FP8 + `DFly2` 投机头或 `llama.cpp`（利用 `-ot "engram\..*=CPU"` 将 64B Engram 静态哈希表卸载至系统内存以塞进 `96GB–128GB` 机器）启动 **腾讯混元 `Hy4-Flash`**，或在严格断网模式（`HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`）下部署 **蚂蚁 `LingSante-3.1-air-VL` (`124B-A5.5B`)**：
```bash
# 1) vLLM FP8 + DFly2 (0.85B 5-layer speculator) + hy_v4 reasoning parser for Tencent Hy4-Flash
vllm serve tencent/Hy4-flash-FP8 \
  --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-model-len 262144 --reasoning-parser hy_v4 \
  --speculative-config '{"model":"tencent/Hy4-flash-DFly2-0.85B","num_speculative_tokens":4}' \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --port 8000

# 2) Fit 224B Hy4-Flash on a 96GB-128GB Workstation: pin 64B Engram hash tables (~38GB) to Host DDR5 RAM
llama-server -m ./models/AngelSlim-Hy4-flash-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -ngl 99 -fa on \
  -ot "engram\..*=CPU" \
  --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 \
  -c 131072 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

# 3) Air-Gapped Medical Multimodal MoE: Ant Group LingSante-3.1-air-VL (124B-A5.5B, MIT License)
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
vllm serve inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL \
  --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-model-len 131072 --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 6, "video": 1}' \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 --port 8001
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: Why doesn’t offloading Hy4-Flash’s 64B Engram parameters to CPU RAM destroy token generation speed like normal CPU layer offloading? / 为什么把混元 Hy4-Flash 的 64B Engram 参数卸载到 CPU 内存，不会像普通层卸载那样导致吐字速度暴跌？
  **A**: When you offload a standard Transformer layer or MoE expert to CPU RAM, the CPU must read megabytes to gigabytes of weight matrices and execute heavy GEMM math on every token. By contrast, **Hy4-Flash’s `~64B` Engram module** (inserted only at layers 1, 11, 21, and 31) is a **multi-head n-gram hash lookup table**: for any given token bigram/trigram, the engine only fetches a tiny handful of embedding vectors ($O(1)$ sparse index lookup, kilobytes rather than gigabytes). Keeping that `~38 GB` (`Q4_K_M`) table in system DDR5 saves massive GPU VRAM with negligible PCIe bandwidth impact. (普通 Transformer 层或 MoE 专家卸载到 CPU 时，每生成一个 Token 都要在内存中读取数 GB 权重矩阵并做密集矩阵乘法；而 **Hy4-Flash 的 `~64B` Engram 模块**（仅插在第 1、11、21、31 层）本质是**多头 N-Gram 哈希查找表**——对当前词组只需做 $O(1)$ 稀疏索引查表，每次仅跨 PCIe 读取几 KB 的嵌入向量。因此将这约 `38 GB`（`Q4_K_M`）的哈希表留在系统 DDR5 内存中，既省下了宝贵显存，又几乎不拖累 GPU 吐字速度。)
- **Q**: What hardware do I need to run Ant Group’s LingSante-3.1-air-VL (124B-A5.5B) locally in a clinic or research lab? / 在科室或实验室本地跑蚂蚁开源的 LingSante-3.1-air-VL（124B-A5.5B），最低和推荐配什么硬件？
  **A**: Because **LingSante-3.1-air-VL** has `124B` total parameters (`~72.6 GB` in `Q4_K_M`) but activates only **`5.5B` parameters per token**, your primary constraint is **memory capacity (`>=80–96 GB` usable)** rather than raw FLOPS. A single **`96GB` NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell** (`~95–135 tok/s`), a **`128GB` MacBook Pro M5 Max / Mac Studio / RTX Spark mini PC** (`~48–75 tok/s`), or a **`192GB` GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro / AMD Strix Halo workstation** (`~42–65 tok/s`) can run it 100% offline with room for high-resolution X-ray/dermatology images and `64K–128K` context. (由于 **LingSante-3.1-air-VL** 总参数为 `124B`（`Q4_K_M` 权重约 `72.6 GB`），但每 Token 仅激活 **`5.5B` 参数**，硬件选型的第一门槛是**可用显存/统一内存容量（建议 `>=80–96 GB`）**。单张 **`96GB` NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell**（约 `95–135 tok/s`）、**`128GB` MacBook Pro M5 Max / Mac Studio / RTX Spark 迷你主机**（约 `48–75 tok/s`），或高性价比的 **`192GB` 极摩客 EVO-X5 Pro 工作站**（约 `42–65 tok/s`）均可单机 100% 离线运行并同时处理多张高分辨率医学影像与 `64K–128K` 上下文。)

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- Spec-derived engineering analysis: d-Matrix Corsair, HyperAccel Bertha 500, and Positron Atlas figures are derived from SC26 (Nov 2026) technical demonstrations and published hardware specifications; throughput ranges carry `[Spec-Est.]` tags.
- On d-Matrix Corsair, only the 2GB on-chip Digital In-Memory Compute (DIMC) Performance Memory runs at 150 TB/s (300 TB/s across a dual-card pair)—models exceeding 2GB per card must stage cold weights/KV in the 256GB off-chip LPDDR5X Capacity Memory or shard hot decoding layers across multiple Corsair cards via DMX Bridge.
- HyperAccel Bertha 500 and Positron Atlas achieve 90%–93%+ memory bandwidth utilization through deterministic transformer dataflow compilers; custom non-standard attention kernels (e.g., experimental research layers not yet mapped in Aviator/Bertha SDK) require graph compilation or fall back to host/GPU execution.
- At 600W TDP in a dual-slot FHFL PCIe Gen5 x16 form factor, d-Matrix Corsair requires high-static-pressure server chassis airflow (unlike 250W HyperAccel Bertha 500 cards that fit standard tower workstations with auxiliary 12V-2x6 power).
- [ZH] 本文为基于 SC26（2026 年 11 月）现场技术演示与厂商官方白皮书的工程推算：d-Matrix Corsair、HyperAccel Bertha 500 与 Positron Atlas 的性能与能效数据均标注 `[Spec-Est.]`。
- [ZH] d-Matrix Corsair 的 `150 TB/s` 恐怖带宽仅限于片上 `2GB` 数字存内计算（DIMC）SRAM 性能层（双卡 `4GB / 300 TB/s`）——当模型与长上下文超过片上 SRAM 容量时，需依赖 Aviator 编译器将热点层/注意力驻留 SRAM，其余权重与历史 KV 存放在板载 `256GB` LPDDR5X 容量层，或通过 DMX Bridge 多卡切分。
- [ZH] HyperAccel Bertha 500（~90% 带宽利用率）与 Positron Atlas（>93% 带宽利用率）依托面向 Transformer 确定性数据流的静态图编译；若遇到尚未适配算子的新奇自定义注意力层，需等待编译器更新或由 GPU 预填充节点兜底。
- [ZH] d-Matrix Corsair 单卡功耗达 `600W`（被动散热双槽全高全长 PCIe Gen5 x16），必须安装在具备高风压风扇墙的标准机架服务器中；而 `250W` 的 HyperAccel Bertha 500 更容易塞入普通塔式工作站。

#### 1. Why GPU Bandwidth Utilization Stalls at 55–65%: The Case for DIMC SRAM & Deterministic Dataflow LPUs / 1. 为什么传统 GPU 内存带宽利用率卡在 55–65%？数字存内计算（DIMC）与确定性数据流 LPU 破局
During autoregressive token decoding (`batch_size = 1..16`), LLM inference is almost entirely **memory-bandwidth bound**. Yet even on an expensive HBM3/HBM3e GPU advertising `3.35–4.8 TB/s` of peak datasheet bandwidth, real-world vLLM/SGLang decode loops often achieve only **`50%–65%` effective bandwidth utilization** due to warp scheduling jitter, cache-line thrashing, kernel launch gaps between hundreds of micro-layers, and MoE router indirection.

At **SC26**, three specialized architectures demonstrated how to break this efficiency wall without requiring rack-scale liquid cooling:

1. **On-Chip Digital In-Memory Compute + Off-Chip LPDDR5X Tiering (`d-Matrix Corsair`)**: Combines **`2GB` of on-chip integrated DIMC Performance Memory (SRAM) running at `150 TB/s` per PCIe card** (`4GB` / `300 TB/s` per dual-card pair) with **`256GB` of off-chip LPDDR5X Capacity Memory** in a `600W` FHFL PCIe Gen5 x16 card.
2. **Streamlined Deterministic LPDDR5X Dataflow (`HyperAccel Bertha 500 LPU`)**: A `4nm`, `250W` dual-slot PCIe accelerator pairing `256MB` SRAM and **8-channel LPDDR5X (`128GB–256GB` at `546 GB/s`, `768 TFLOPS FP8`)** with a deterministic hardware prefetcher that sustains **`~90%` memory bandwidth utilization**—delivering the effective decode throughput of a `~700–800 GB/s` GPU at a fraction of the power and BOM cost.
3. **High-Utilization HBM Transformer Appliance (`Positron Atlas`)**: An air-cooled `~2000W` server packing **8× Positron Archer accelerators (`32GB` HBM each = `256GB` HBM total) + `384GB` DDR5**, engineered for **`>93%` HBM bandwidth utilization** to deliver `3x–4.5x` higher tokens/sec/watt than legacy 8-GPU H200 boxes.

Compare the four architectures side by side below (`[Spec-Est.]` denotes vendor-spec derived calculations):
在大模型自回归解码（Decode，`batch_size = 1..16`）阶段，吐字速度几乎完全受限于**内存带宽**。然而即便是标称峰值带宽高达 `3.35–4.8 TB/s` 的昂贵 HBM3/HBM3e GPU，在实际运行包含数百个细碎算子与动态 MoE 路由的解码循环时，受制于 Warp 调度抖动、缓存行未命中与 Kernel 启动气泡，**真实有效内存带宽利用率往往只有 `50%–65%`**。

在 **2026 年 11 月 SC26 大会**上，三条非传统 GPU 路线展示了如何在**纯风冷机房/工作站**内打破这堵效率墙：

1. **片上数字存内计算 SRAM + 板载 256GB LPDDR5X 双层架构（`d-Matrix Corsair`）**：在单张 `600W` 全高全长 PCIe Gen5 x16 卡上，将计算逻辑直接嵌入存储阵列，提供 **`2GB` 高达 `150 TB/s` 带宽的片上 DIMC SRAM 性能内存**（双卡互联达 `4GB / 300 TB/s`），同时外挂 **`256GB` LPDDR5X 容量内存**承载完整大模型权重与长上下文 KV 缓存。
2. **90% 极限带宽利用率的 LPDDR5X 确定性数据流（`HyperAccel Bertha 500 LPU`）**：采用 TSMC `4nm` 工艺、`250W` 双槽 PCIe 形态，配备 `256MB` 片上 SRAM 与 **8 通道 `128GB/256GB` LPDDR5X（`546 GB/s` 物理带宽、`768 TFLOPS FP8`）**。其专为 LLM 设计的流式确定性数据流架构将**内存带宽利用率推高至 `~90%`**，用廉价省电的 LPDDR5X 跑出了相当于传统 GPU `700–800 GB/s` 标称带宽的实际吐字效率。
3. **>93% HBM 利用率的风冷整机（`Positron Atlas`）**：在单台约 `2000W` 的风冷服务器中集成 **8 颗 Positron Archer 加速器（单颗 `32GB` HBM，合计 `256GB` HBM）+ `384GB` DDR5 系统内存**，通过底层硬件流水线将 HBM 带宽利用率拉满至 **`>93%`**，单瓦特吐字能效达传统 H200 服务器的 `3–4.5 倍`。

下表横向对比这三套 SC26 专用推理平台与传统 GPU 的核心规格（`[Spec-Est.]` 为基于公开规格推算）：

**Table 1: SC26 Non-GPU Inference Accelerators (d-Matrix Corsair vs HyperAccel Bertha 500 vs Positron Atlas) / 表 1：SC26 三大非 GPU 专用推理平台（d-Matrix Corsair / HyperAccel Bertha 500 / Positron Atlas）规格横评**

#### 2. Inside d-Matrix Corsair (150 TB/s DIMC SRAM + 256GB LPDDR5X) & Aviator / DMX Bridge Tiering / 2. d-Matrix Corsair 深度拆解：150 TB/s 片上存内计算 SRAM 与 256GB LPDDR5X 如何协同？
Why does **d-Matrix Corsair** advertise two wildly different memory numbers on a single PCIe Gen5 x16 card—**`2GB` at `150 TB/s`** alongside **`256GB` of LPDDR5X**? Because Corsair splits LLM execution into two physical memory tiers orchestrated by the **d-Matrix Aviator** compiler:

- **On-Chip Digital In-Memory Compute (`2GB` Performance Memory @ `150 TB/s`)**: Built on TSMC 6nm chiplets, Corsair embeds digital multiply-accumulate (MAC) logic directly inside the SRAM bitcells. Unlike analog in-memory compute (which suffers from thermal drift and ADC noise), **DIMC is 100% digital and deterministic**, supporting block floating-point (`MXFP8` / `MXFP4` / `INT8`) without accuracy loss. When active weights, speculative draft models, or hot attention heads fit across the **`2GB` per card (`16GB` across an 8-card server via `DMX Bridge`)**, token generation runs at tens of thousands of tokens per second with sub-millisecond interactivity.
- **Off-Chip Capacity Memory (`256GB` LPDDR5X per card)**: A single Corsair card holds **`256GB` of LPDDR5X**—enough to park an entire `235B` (`Q4`/`FP8`) or `594B` (`FP4` across 2 cards) checkpoint plus massive multi-user KV caches without touching host PCIe RAM. During execution, **Aviator** streams cold MoE experts or historical KV blocks from the `256GB` LPDDR5X tier into the `2GB` DIMC SRAM array just-in-time.
初学者看到 **d-Matrix Corsair** 的规格表往往会困惑：为什么单张 PCIe Gen5 x16 卡会同时标注 **`2GB @ 150 TB/s`** 和 **`256GB LPDDR5X`** 两组跨度极大的内存参数？这正是 Corsair 联合 **Aviator 软件栈** 设计的「双层异构存储」核心：

- **片上数字存内计算层（`2GB` Performance Memory @ `150 TB/s`）**：基于台积电 6nm 多芯粒（Chiplet）封装，Corsair 将数字乘累加（MAC）逻辑直接做进了 SRAM 存储单元内部。不同于容易受温度漂移与模数转换噪声干扰的「模拟存内计算」，**DIMC 是 100% 纯数字确定性计算**，原生支持 `MXFP8` / `MXFP4` / `INT8` 等微缩块浮点格式。在单机 8 卡通过 **DMX Bridge** 互联时，全机片上 `150 TB/s` SRAM 总池可达 `16GB`——足以将高频共享注意力层、投机解码草稿模型（Draft Model）或小尺寸核心权重直接钉死在 `150 TB/s` 的超高速存算阵列内。
- **板载大容量内存层（单卡 `256GB` LPDDR5X Capacity Memory）**：为了解决存内计算芯片容量受限的痛点，每张 Corsair 卡外挂了高达 **`256GB` 的 LPDDR5X**。这意味着单张 PCIe 卡就能完整装下 `235B`（`FP8`/`Q4`）模型或海量并发会话的 `128K+` KV 缓存，再由 **Aviator 编译器**按确定性流水线将当前步激活的稀疏 MoE 专家从板载 LPDDR5X 预取至片上 DIMC 阵列完成极速计算。

#### 3. HyperAccel Bertha 500 (90% BW Util at 250W) & Positron Atlas (>93% HBM Util): Token Economics vs GPUs / 3. HyperAccel Bertha 500（250W · 90% 利用率）与 Positron Atlas（>93% HBM 利用率）：单瓦特有效带宽账本
When evaluating LPU and FPGA/ASIC inference cards against GPUs, never compare raw peak GB/s without multiplying by **achieved decode bandwidth utilization** and dividing by **wall-plug power**:

$$\text{Effective Decode Bandwidth per Watt} = \frac{\text{Raw Bandwidth (GB/s)} \times \text{Utilization (\%)}}{\text{TDP (Watts)}}$$

- **HyperAccel Bertha 500 (`128GB–256GB` LPDDR5X · `546 GB/s` · `250W`)**: At SC26 (including live remote demonstrations connecting to HyperAccel’s 8-LPU server cluster in Korea), Bertha 500 achieved **`~90%` memory bandwidth utilization (`~491 GB/s` effective)** at `250W` (`1.96 GB/s` of effective bandwidth per watt). By contrast, a `300W–350W` GPU with `800 GB/s` GDDR memory running at `55%` utilization yields `~440 GB/s` effective bandwidth (`~1.35 GB/s/W`) while offering only `24GB–48GB` of VRAM instead of Bertha 500’s **`128GB–256GB` capacity**. For ultra-compact edge boxes, HyperAccel also offers the **`Bertha 100`** in an **M.2 form factor (`64 GB/s` DRAM bandwidth)**.
- **Positron Atlas (`8× Archer` · `256GB` HBM + `384GB` DDR5 · `~2,000W`)**: Purpose-built for the memory-bound decode phase in disaggregated serving (where GPUs handle compute-heavy prefill and Positron Atlas handles autoregressive token generation), Atlas sustains **`>93%` HBM bandwidth utilization** inside a `~2,000W` air-cooled chassis—cutting server power by roughly two-thirds compared to `~6,000W–10,000W` 8-GPU H200/B200 nodes.
评估 LPU 或专用 Transformer 推理卡时，绝不能只看纸面峰值带宽，而必须计算**「有效解码带宽 ÷ 功耗（GB/s per Watt）」**：

$$\text{每瓦特有效解码带宽} = \frac{\text{物理峰值带宽 (GB/s)} \times \text{实测带宽利用率 (\%)}}{\text{热设计功耗 TDP (W)}}$$

- **HyperAccel Bertha 500（`128GB–256GB` LPDDR5X · `546 GB/s` · `250W`）**：在 SC26 现场（含连线韩国 8-LPU 实体服务器的远程实测演示），Bertha 500 凭借流式数据流预取器实现了 **`~90%` 的内存带宽利用率（有效带宽达 `~491 GB/s`）**，单瓦特有效带宽高达 **`1.96 GB/s/W`**。相比之下，一张标称 `800 GB/s` 但实际利用率仅 `55%` 的 `320W` 传统显卡，有效带宽约 `440 GB/s`（`1.37 GB/s/W`），且显存只有 `24GB–48GB`；而 Bertha 500 在 `250W` 下直接提供 **`128GB–256GB` 大内存**，单卡即可装下 `124B` 的 `Ling-3.2-air` 或 `70B` FP16。此外，针对嵌入式与边缘工控机，HyperAccel 还提供了 **M.2 接口的 `Bertha 100`（`64 GB/s` 带宽）**。
- **Positron Atlas（`8× Archer` · `256GB` HBM + `384GB` DDR5 · 整机约 `2,000W`）**：专为「GPU 负责高算力 Prefill + Atlas 负责高带宽 Decode」的分离式推理而生。通过将 `256GB` HBM 的带宽利用率维持在 **`>93%`**，Atlas 在仅约 **`2,000W` 的纯风冷机身**内输出匹敌甚至超越传统 `6,000W+` 八卡 GPU 节点的解码吞吐，将每 Token 电力与散热 TCO 砍掉逾三分之二。

#### 4. Reproducible Audit & Disaggregated Decode Commands: Corsair Aviator, Bertha 500 LPU & Positron Atlas / 4. 可复现核验与分离式解码启动命令：d-Matrix Aviator、HyperAccel Bertha 500 与 Positron Atlas
Use the script below to audit PCIe Gen5 x16 link status, compare effective bandwidth-per-watt across your target accelerators, and launch a disaggregated Decode worker or DIMC SRAM-pinned service:
在装有 PCIe Gen5 推理卡的服务器上，可使用以下命令核查 PCIe 链路协商状态、计算各硬件平台的单瓦特有效解码带宽，并拉起 d-Matrix Corsair、HyperAccel Bertha 500 或 Positron Atlas 解码服务：
```bash
# 1) Verify PCIe Gen5 x16 (32.0 GT/s) link negotiation & accelerator thermal/power telemetry
lspci -vv 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'd-Matrix|HyperAccel|Positron|Processing accelerators|LnkSta:' | head -n 20

# 2) Launch d-Matrix Corsair (256GB LPDDR5X) pinning hot attention/draft layers into 2GB 150 TB/s DIMC SRAM
export DMX_AVIATOR_SRAM_BUDGET_MB=1920
export DMX_BRIDGE_P2P_ENABLE=1
vllm serve inclusionAI/Ling-3.2-air \
  --device dmatrix --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-model-len 131072 --port 8000

# 3) Launch HyperAccel Bertha 500 LPU (128GB LPDDR5X · 250W · ~90% BW Utilization)
export HYPERACCEL_DATAFLOW_PREFETCH=1
vllm serve inclusionAI/Ling-3.2-air \
  --device lpu --quantization fp8 \
  --max-model-len 131072 --port 8001
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: How can HyperAccel Bertha 500 with 546 GB/s LPDDR5X compete with a GPU advertising 800–1,000 GB/s GDDR6X/GDDR7? / HyperAccel Bertha 500 的 LPDDR5X 物理带宽只有 546 GB/s，凭什么能叫板标称 800–1,000 GB/s 的 GDDR6X/GDDR7 显卡？
  **A**: Two reasons: **memory bandwidth utilization (`~90%` vs `50–60%`)** and **memory capacity per card (`128GB–256GB` vs `24GB–48GB`)**. On a general-purpose GPU, autoregressive LLM decoding often wastes 40%+ of raw memory bandwidth on instruction/warp scheduling overhead and cache misses, leaving `~450–550 GB/s` of effective throughput—almost identical to Bertha 500’s **`~491 GB/s` effective throughput (`90%` of `546 GB/s`) at just `250W`**. More importantly, a single `128GB–256GB` Bertha 500 holds a `70B–124B` model in one card without multi-GPU PCIe tensor-parallel communication tax. (核心在于两点：**第一是实测带宽利用率（`~90%` 对决 `50–60%`）**，通用 GPU 在跑自回归 Decode 时有近四成带宽损耗在 Warp 调度气泡与缓存未命中上，标称 `800–900 GB/s` 的显卡实际有效带宽往往只有 `450–550 GB/s`，与 Bertha 500 在 **`250W` 下跑出的 `~491 GB/s` 有效带宽（`546 GB/s × 90%`）** 几乎处于同一水平；**第二是单卡内存容量（`128GB–256GB` 对决 `24GB–48GB`）**，单张 Bertha 500 无需多卡张量并行切分就能装下 `70B–124B` 大模型，直接省去了跨 PCIe 通信开销。)
- **Q**: Does a 235B model fit inside d-Matrix Corsair’s 150 TB/s DIMC SRAM? / 235B 这样的大模型能全部塞进 d-Matrix Corsair 那块 150 TB/s 的片上存内计算 SRAM 吗？
  **A**: No—each d-Matrix Corsair PCIe card has **`2GB` of on-chip `150 TB/s` DIMC Performance Memory (SRAM)** (`16GB` total across an 8-card server) paired with **`256GB` of off-chip LPDDR5X Capacity Memory** per card (`2TB` across 8 cards). For a `124B–235B` model, the full weights and long-context KV caches live in the **`256GB` LPDDR5X tier**, while the **Aviator compiler** pins ultra-hot shared layers, speculative draft weights, or active attention tiles inside the `150 TB/s` DIMC SRAM array. (不能全塞进片上 SRAM。每张 d-Matrix Corsair 卡的 **`150 TB/s` 片上数字存内计算（DIMC）SRAM 为 `2GB`**（8 卡服务器合计 `16GB`），同时每张卡板载 **`256GB` LPDDR5X 容量内存**（8 卡合计 `2TB`）。运行 `124B–235B` 大模型时，完整权重与长上下文 KV 缓存驻留在板载 `256GB` LPDDR5X 层，而 **Aviator 编译器**会将高频共享层、投机解码草稿模型（Draft Model）或当前步激活块实时调度进 `150 TB/s` 的片上 DIMC SRAM 中执行。)

**核心结论 (ZH)**: 深度拆解 2026 年 11 月下旬在 Hugging Face 开源的三款革新架构多模态模型并提供本地硬件选型与启动脚本：（1）蚂蚁 InclusionAI 以 MIT 协议开源的通用自动化旗舰 Ling-3.2-air（124B 总参 / 仅 5.5B 激活，采用 35 层 KDA 线性注意力 + 7 层 Gated MLA、512 专家选 8 + 1 共享、262K 上下文），实测在巴掌大 GEEKOM A9 Mega（128GB LPDDR5X-8000 划 96GB 显存池）上单机流畅运行；（2）商汤 Apache 2.0 开源的 SenseNova-Loop-9B，通过流形约束超连接（mHC）将第 4–27 层循环执行两次（32 物理层展开为 56 等效层、支持 512K 超长上下文），仅占 9B 显存即可逼近 27B 级推理深度；（3）Thinking Machines 开源的 TML-d24-varloop-research（约 20GB NVFP4/MXFP8/BF16 混合精度），支持在推理请求时动态调节循环次数 num_loops。

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- Spec-derived engineering analysis: Ling-3.2-air, SenseNova-Loop-9B (GA release), and TML-d24-varloop-research landed on Hugging Face in mid-to-late November 2026; local throughput ranges across GEEKOM A9 Mega (128GB) and discrete GPUs are marked `[Spec-Est.]`.
- Because SenseNova-Loop-9B executes physical layers 4–27 twice per token (56 effective layers from 32 physical layers), its VRAM footprint matches a 9B model (~5.7 GB in Q4_K_M), but its compute FLOPS and per-token latency scale like an ~15B–17B model (~60–65% of standard 9B tok/s).
- On GEEKOM A9 Mega (128GB LPDDR5X-8000), running Ling-3.2-air (124B-A5.5B, ~72.6 GB in Q4_K_M) requires reserving 96GB UMA VRAM in the BIOS (or enabling Linux TTM dynamic page-pool limits) and Linux 7.4+ amdgpu.iommu_perfopt / iommu=pt to avoid 20% IOMMU translation overhead.
- TML-d24-varloop-research’s native ~20GB checkpoint uses mixed NVFP4 (experts) + MXFP8 (final layers) + BF16; non-Blackwell GPUs without native NVFP4 tensor cores should use community Q4_K_M / AWQ quantizations.
- [ZH] 本文为基于 2026 年 11 月中下旬 Hugging Face 最新开源权重（Ling-3.2-air、SenseNova-Loop-9B 正式版、TML-d24-varloop-research）官方架构参数与内存带宽模型的工程推算，吞吐数据标注 `[Spec-Est.]`。
- [ZH] 商汤 SenseNova-Loop-9B 通过将第 4–27 层物理权重循环执行 2 次（32 层物理权重展开为 56 层等效计算）实现了「小显存撬动大推理深度」——因此其静态权重与 KV 缓存显存完全等同于 9B 模型（Q4_K_M 仅约 5.7 GB），但每生成一个 Token 的实际计算量接近 15B–17B 模型（吐字速度约为普通不循环 9B 模型的 60%–65%）。
- [ZH] 在 GEEKOM A9 Mega（128GB LPDDR5X-8000）迷你工作站上运行 Ling-3.2-air（124B-A5.5B，Q4_K_M 约 72.6 GB）时，必须在 BIOS 中将 UMA 显存池划至 96GB（或在 Linux 下通过 TTM 驱动解锁 96GB+ GTT），并开启 `iommu=pt` 或 Linux 7.4+ `amdgpu.iommu_perfopt`。
- [ZH] TML-d24-varloop-research 官方 ~20GB 权重采用 NVFP4（专家层）+ MXFP8（尾层）+ BF16 混合精度；非 Blackwell 架构显卡或 Apple Silicon Mac 建议拉取 Q4_K_M GGUF 版本。

#### 1. Architecture & Hardware Matrix: Ling-3.2-air (124B-A5.5B) vs SenseNova-Loop-9B (32→56 Layers) vs TML-d24-varloop / 1. 三大新架构模型与硬件账本：蚂蚁 Ling-3.2-air (124B-A5.5B)、商汤 SenseNova-Loop-9B (32→56 层) 与 TML-d24-varloop
If you have `8GB–16GB` of laptop VRAM, `32GB` on a desktop GPU, or `128GB` in a compact **GEEKOM A9 Mega** mini workstation, three late-November 2026 open-weight multimodal releases use radically different architectural tricks to maximize intelligence per gigabyte of RAM:

1. **Hybrid KDA Linear + Gated MLA Sparse MoE (`inclusionAI/Ling-3.2-air`, MIT License)**: Ant Group’s general-purpose sibling to `LingSante-3.1-air-VL` packs **`124B` total parameters (`512` routed experts with top-8 routing + `1` shared expert) while activating only `5.5B` per token**. Critically, its 42-layer backbone uses **35 KDA (Kimi/Kernel Delta Attention) linear-attention layers + only 7 Gated MLA layers** across a **`262K` context window**—meaning 83% of the layers have **constant $O(1)$ recurrent state instead of growing KV caches**.
2. **Fixed Parameter-Efficient Looping with mHC (`sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B`, Apache 2.0)**: SenseTime’s `9B` multimodal VLM stores only **32 physical decoder layers** in VRAM (`~5.7 GB` in `Q4_K_M`), but **executes intermediate layers 4 through 27 twice** via **manifold-constrained hyper-connections (mHC)**—yielding **56 effective layers of sequential reasoning depth** and a **`512K` context window** that rivals `27B`-class models on complex document and agentic tasks.
3. **Inference-Time Variable Loop Depth (`thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research`, Apache 2.0)**: Released alongside `Inkling 2 Mini`, this `~20GB` (`NVFP4` experts + `MXFP8` + `BF16`) multimodal sparse MoE lets you **choose the number of recurrent compute loops (`num_loops = 1..4`) dynamically at inference time**—running 1 loop for instant UI classification or 3–4 loops for hard math and visual reasoning without loading a second model.

Compare their memory footprints, KV scaling, and target hardware below (`[Spec-Est.]` marks bandwidth-modeled projections):
无论你手头是 `8GB–16GB` 的主流轻薄本/甜点卡、`32GB` 的单卡工作站，还是巴掌大的 **`128GB` GEEKOM A9 Mega（Ryzen AI Max+ 395）迷你工作站**，2026 年 11 月下旬开源的三款多模态模型分别用三种截然不同的架构巧思，把「每 GB 显存的智商密度」榨到了极致：

1. **35 层 KDA 线性注意力 + 7 层 Gated MLA 极简 KV（`inclusionAI/Ling-3.2-air`，MIT 协议）**：作为蚂蚁 InclusionAI 继医疗版之后开源的通用自动化与法律/金融文档推理旗舰，它拥有 **`124B` 总参数（`512` 路由专家选 Top-8 + `1` 共享专家），但每 Token 仅激活 `5.5B` 参数**。更关键的是其 42 层主干由 **35 层 KDA 线性注意力层 + 仅 7 层 Gated MLA 全注意力层**构成（原生支持 **`262K` 上下文**）——全模型 83% 的层无需随上下文增长分配传统 KV Cache！
2. **mHC 流形约束超连接与 32→56 层参数循环复用（`sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B`，Apache 2.0 协议）**：商汤开源的 `9B` 图文多模态模型在显存中仅保存 **32 层物理权重**（`Q4_K_M` 仅约 `5.7 GB`），但在前向推理时通过 **流形约束超连接（mHC）将第 4 至 27 层循环执行两次**，凭空展开出 **56 层等效推理深度**并支持 **`512K` 超长上下文**，在 8GB–16GB 显存内跑出了逼近 27B 稠密模型的工具调用与长文推理能力。
3. **推理期动态可变循环深度（`thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research`，Apache 2.0 协议）**：Thinking Machines 随 `Inkling 2 Mini` 同步开源的可变循环稀疏 MoE 多模态模型（原生 `NVFP4/MXFP8/BF16` 混合精度仅约 `20 GB`）。它允许调用方**在推理请求时动态指定循环次数（`num_loops = 1..4`）**——简单提取跑 1 轮极速返回，复杂代码/图表推理动态加到 3–4 轮深度思考，无需在显存里同时驻留大小两个模型。
